jobs.title: Osoba do pracy na stanowisku księgowy
jobs.description:
Zakres obowiązków: 1. sporządzanie wniosków o dokonanie zmian w planie wydatków w układzie tradycyjnym
i zadaniowym,
2. sporządzanie wniosków o dokonanie zmian w planie remontów,
3. sporządzanie analizy z wykonania planu finansowego,
4. sporządzanie: zapotrzebowania na środki finansowe, prognozy rozkładu wydatków
i harmonogramu rocznego wydatków,
5. sporządzanie sprawozdania z wykonania budżetu zadaniowego,
6. wprowadzanie, kompletowanie sprawozdań budżetowych, finansowych oraz innych dokumentów
w systemie Trezor,
7. sporządzanie projektów pism w zakresie spraw związanych z wykonywaniem budżetu jednostki,
8. prowadzenie spraw dotyczących Zakładowego Funduszu Świadczeń Socjalnych,
9. weryfikację dowodów księgowych pod względem formalno-rachunkowym,
10. dekretację wyciągów bankowych i dowodów księgowych zgodnie procedurami wewnętrznymi,
11. księgowanie dowodów księgowych w systemie finansowo-księgowym,
12. uzgadnianie i rozliczanie kont w systemie finansowo-księgowym,
13. rejestrowanie i prowadzenie spraw obowiązujących na danym stanowisku pracy w Systemie
Informatycznym Prokuratury w zakresie zgodnym z rzeczowym wykazem akt,
14. archiwizację dokumentów gromadzonych i wytwarzanych w ramach zajmowanego stanowiska.
Pełna treść ogłoszenia, zasady rekrutacji dostępne są na stronie BIP jednostki https://www.gov.pl/web/po-czestochowa/oferta-pracy-3013-4111132026
Wymagania:
- wykształcenie: wyższe (w tym licencjat) - konieczne
- pozostałe: 1. wykształcenie wyższe, co najmniej na poziomie pierwszego stopnia (preferowane wykształcenie z zakresu finansów, rachunkowości lub ekonomii),
2. pełna zdolność do czynności prawnych,
3. niekaralność za przestępstwo lub przestępstwo skarbowe,
4. przeciwko kandydatowi nie może być prowadzone postępowanie o przestępstwo ścigane
z oskarżenia publicznego lub przestępstwo skarbowe,
5. nieposzlakowana opinia,
6. stan zdrowia powalający za zatrudnienie na stanowisku księgowego,
7. znajomość przepisów o finansach publicznych, rachunkowości i sprawozdawczości budż

In the Global Products Group, we are dedicated to excellence in the design and engineering of Lam's etch and deposition products. We drive innovation to ensure our cutting-edge solutions are helping to solve the biggest challenges in the semiconductor industry.

As a Wet Chemistry Hardware Engineer (Mechanical Engineer) at Lam, you're designing and defining cutting-edge mechanical and electro-mechanical systems. * Define requirements, perform engineering analyses and execute testing to validate chamber, fluidic and thermal performance

* Generate technical documentation, FMEA and specifications to deliver safe, manufacturable and cost-effective solutions

* Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional teams while providing technical leadership and mentorship in wet process hardware and chamber design

Who we're looking for

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field with 5+ years of experience; or Master's degree with 3+ years; or equivalent experience

* Excellent communication, both written and verbal, and technical presentation skills

* Highly proficient in 3D CAD tools such as CREO, Siemens NX, ProE, SolidWorks, and others

* Hands-on experimental and design background coupled with solid engineering skills

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience in Semiconductor industry is a plus

* Experience in leading projects, or problem solving while managing time and multiple priorities

jobs.title: Installation Lead
jobs.description:
Bring the Future of Wind Propulsion Onboard

About Us

Wind helped us discover our planet, and now it can help us preserve it. Our vision is to provide wings for a shipping revolution, and we have two strong mother companies to back us up: Alfa Laval and Wallenius.

Would you like to contribute to this change, then join our fast-growing, highly competent and passionate team. AlfaWall Oceanbird AB is a 50/50 joint venture, owned by Alfa Laval and Wallenius but operated as an independent company. We are developing wing sail technology for the global shipping market and are now looking for an Installation Lead to join our team. Help us bring wind propulsion from shore to ship!

The role

As Oceanbird moves from a prototype stage into commercial customer delivery, successful installation is becoming one of our most important capabilities.

As Installation Lead, you will turn plans and technical solutions into safe, efficient and wellcoordinated installations at shipyards and onboard vessels. You will also be responsible for our demonstrator wing in Landskrona, coordinating its operation, maintenance and test readiness so that it provides the data needed for our continued development.

You will be part of the Project Management Office and work closely with our project managers. During installations, you will lead a cross-functional team of approximately 3–8 people, including electricians, service engineers, technical specialists and external contractors.

The Project Manager retains overall responsibility for the customer project, while you lead the dayto-day installation activities and safe execution at the shipyard, in harbor or at sea.

Your main responsibilities:

• Plan, prepare and lead installation and commissioning activities at shipyards/harbour and onboard vessels.

• Translate project and engineering requirements into practical installation plans, work sequences, resource needs and schedules.

• Coordinate the on-site installation team and act as Oceanbird’s operational interface with shipyards, vessel crews, customers and subcontractors.

• Lead the safe execution of installation work, ensuring that risk assessments, work permits, toolbox talks and agreed safety procedures are in place and followed.

• Monitor progress, quality and safety, resolve practical issues and escalate risks or decisions when required.

• Develop and maintain installation procedures, method statements, SOPs, checklists and installation manuals.

• Capture lessons learned and use them to improve future installations, documentation and ways of working.

• Coordinate the operation, maintenance, inspection and test readiness of the demonstrator wing and its supporting equipment in Landskrona.

• Plan activities together with the Landskrona team and work closely with our teams in Flemingsberg to incorporate experience from installations and testing into our continued development.

Who are you?

You are a practical and confident installation leader who can bring people from different disciplines together, create structure and maintain focus on safety and delivery—even when conditions change.

You are likely to have:

• Experience leading installations, commissioning, service or major maintenance involving complex mechanical or electromechanical equipment.

Classified by Alfa Laval as: Business

• Experience from commercial vessels and shipyards, ideally involving bulk carriers, tankers or similar vessel types.

• Experience from newbuild projects and working closely with shipyards in Asia is highly valuable.

• A relevant engineering qualification within mechanical, marine, electrical or a related technical field. This could be a vocational, college or bachelor-level qualification, or equivalent experience.

• A strong understanding of safe working practices in shipyard, industrial or onboard environments.

• Experience coordinating multidisciplinary teams, contractors and external stakeholders.

• The ability to produce clear and practical technical documentation, including SOPs and installation manuals.

• Professional proficiency in English and the willingness to travel internationally and work onboard vessels.

You are safety-conscious, structured and calm under pressure. You communicate clearly across technical disciplines and cultures and are comfortable moving between planning, documentation and hands-on execution.

Location and travel

We are open to discussing the location for the right candidate, although proximity to either Flemingsberg or Landskrona is preferred.

Regular international travel and periods of work at shipyards and onboard vessels are an integral part of the role.

What we offer

At Oceanbird, you will help turn a bold vision into working technology at sea. You will see the direct result of your work as our wing sail technology moves from development and testing to installation onboard commercial vessels—and ultimately into operation at sea.

This is an opportunity to shape not only how our first commercial installations are delivered, but how Oceanbird will install wing sails around the world in the future. Working alongside highly skilled and passionate colleagues, you will influence our installation methods, safety standards and ways of working—and contribute directly to making wind a powerful part of cleaner shipping.

Join us in redefining the future of clean shipping.

Apply today and be part of a journey that truly makes a difference!

We review applications continually so please send in your application as soon as possible.

We don't accept applications sent directly via email.

A businesspartner for growth and maintainance, www.briljantin.se

jobs.title: Dispute and Chargebacks, Program Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Role Summary

Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Disputes and Chargeback Program Manager at Replit, you’ll be part of our Trust and Safety Operations team, who owns customer-facing workflows that handle sensitive and policy-driven interactions across the Support organization. This includes areas such as privacy requests, DMCA and intellectual property claims, law enforcement requests, and abuse appeals.

You'll own Replit's disputes and chargeback function end-to-end: from the individual case in front of you to the policies, playbooks, and automation that let it hold up as we scale to millions of users. This role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution: you'll determine dispute and chargeback strategy, and build the systems that make those decisions repeatable at scale, working closely with Engineering, Legal and Finance.

 

In this role you will…

 - Own the full dispute lifecycle: investigate incoming chargebacks and disputes, decide whether and how to represent, gather evidence, and respond within network deadlines.

 - Design and maintain the policies, decision trees, and SOPs that govern how disputes and chargebacks are handled.

 - Define the key metrics, health targets, and goals for the disputes program and track performance against them, reporting to leadership.

 - Monitor chargeback rates and dispute trends to identify the underlying drivers of volume, and partner with Engineering and Finance to address root causes.

 - Partner with Engineering and Support Operations to automate manual parts of the workflow (evidence gathering, decisioning logic, etc).

 - Build training, documentation, and escalation paths that enable frontline support teams to handle dispute-related inquiries confidently and consistently as the program scales.



Required Skills and Experience:

 - 6+ years of hands-on experience owning disputes/chargebacks operations, ideally where you built or significantly leveled up the function rather than just running an existing one.

 - Deep familiarity with major card network dispute rules and reason codes (e.g., Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Discover), including compelling-evidence frameworks and network monitoring/excessive-dispute programs (e.g., Visa's VDMP/VFMP, Mastercard's ECP)

 - Experience building or improving SOPs, playbooks, or workflows in a support or operations environment.

 - Experience partnering with Engineering to scope and prioritize automation, even if you're not writing the code yourself.

 - Comfort operating as both a hands-on operator and systems builder in a scaling environment.

 - Strong judgment and decision-making skills when handling sensitive or ambiguous customer situations.

 - Experience translating policy or legal requirements into clear, repeatable processes or customer-facing guidance.

 - Strong written communication skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, empathetically, and precisely in high-stakes situations.

 - Proven track record working cross-functionally to deliver impactful results.

 

Nice to Have:

 - Hands-on experience with Stripe's dispute tooling specifically, including submitting evidence and managing dispute workflows through Stripe.

 - Experience in customer support, trust & safety, support operations, or similar roles within a technology company.

 - Experience in a high-growth or usage-based SaaS environment, where dispute patterns and volume can shift quickly with product changes.

 - Familiarity with fraud detection tooling and how it intersects with the disputes function.

 - Experience managing outsourced or contract support as programs scale, in case this function grows beyond a single person down the line.

Qualifikation

  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast bereits Erfahrungen im Bereich Design gesammelt, sei es im Studium, durch Praktika oder im Job. Entscheidender als dein Werdegang sind deine kreative Stärke und Begeisterung für gutes Design.
  • Branchenbezug: Erste Berührungspunkte mit Grußkarten, Papeterie oder Geschenkartikeln sind Voraussetzung, sei es durch Berufserfahrung oder durch eigene kreative Projekte. Wenn du Freude an der Gestaltung dieser Produkte hast, bist du bei uns richtig.
  • Ausbildung: Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, Visuelle Kommunikation oder Mediengestaltung abgeschlossen oder eine Ausbildung, z. B. als Mediengestalter/in, Gestaltungstechnische/r Assistent/in, Produktdesigner/in oder Medientechnologe/-in Druck, gemacht. Alternativ bringst du entsprechende praktische Berufserfahrung mit.

  • Teamarbeit: Du fühlst dich in einem kleinen, familiären Team wohl und bist gerne ein wichtiger Teil davon.
  • Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und idealerweise gute Englischkenntnisse.

Benefits

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: In Abstimmung kannst du deine Arbeitszeiten, im Rahmen unserer Kernarbeitszeit zwischen 09:00 und 16:00 Uhr, flexibel gestalten.
  • Unsere Arbeitsweise: Wir sind ein kleines, eingespieltes Team und arbeiten bewusst gemeinsam vor Ort. Der direkte Austausch macht uns kreativ und erfolgreich, deshalb ist Homeoffice bei uns nicht vorgesehen.
  • Kreative Freiheit: Du bekommst Raum für deine Ideen, Eigenverantwortung und die Möglichkeit, deine Handschrift in unsere Produkte einzubringen.
  • Unsere Arbeitsweise: Wir sind ein kleines, eingespieltes Team mit Leidenschaft für Gestaltung, das effizient, familiär und auf Augenhöhe zusammenarbeitet.
  • Wertschätzung: Wir leben eine offene Feedbackkultur und feiern Erfolge gemeinsam – ob bei lockeren Mittagspausen oder inspirierenden Teamevents.
  • Individuelle Entwicklung: Wir fördern deine Stärken und bieten dir die Chance, dich mit uns fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln – ganz ohne steile Hierarchien.
  • Dein Arbeitsplatz: Dich erwartet ein modernes, hochwertig eingerichtetes Büro mit kreativer Atmosphäre in zentraler Lage mit Anbindung an den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.
  • Attraktives Vergütungspaket: Wir bieten dir eine unbefristete und sichere Anstellung mit einem attraktiven Gehaltspaket.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Product Marketing Manager to grow Replit’s core creation products, including Design and Slides.

These products already give people new ways to turn an idea into something they can see, share, and use. Your job is to help more people discover them, understand when to use them, and make them part of their regular workflow.

You’ll own the connection between the product and its audiences: developing positioning grounded in customer needs, leading launches, finding channels that can drive sustained adoption, tracking the competitive landscape, and bringing market feedback back to Product.

This role sits at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Growth, Brand, and Creative. It is a hands-on role for someone who can develop the strategy, write the narrative, and get the work into the market.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Own the positioning and growth strategy for Replit’s core products, including Design and Slides. Develop audience-focused narratives, identify new use cases and channels, bring product improvements to market, and build programs that drive adoption, engagement, and conversion. Track competitors and customer needs, then translate those insights into sharper messaging, stronger go-to-market decisions, and actionable feedback for Product and Engineering.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - Self-starter: You take ownership, work through ambiguity, and move from strategy to execution without waiting for a perfect brief.

 - Audience-focused: You turn customer insight into clear positioning, relevant narratives, and campaigns built for specific audiences.

 - Growth-minded: You find creative ways to expand adoption, test new channels and tactics, and turn successful experiments into repeatable programs.

 - Deep product background: You understand complex products, work closely with Product and Engineering, and translate product capabilities into meaningful customer value.

 - Strong product marketer: You bring 4+ years of experience growing product-led, consumer, prosumer, creative, or developer-focused products.

jobs.title: SEO Specialist
jobs.description:
SEO Specialist

Work tasks: Company for Business OÜ is looking for an SEO specialist to develop and promote the company’s web projects. The specialist’s primary objective is to increase the organic visibility of the company’s websites in Google Search.
Key Responsibilities • Developing and implementing an SEO strategy for the company’s websites. • Promoting websites in Google for commercial and informational search queries. • Conducting technical SEO audits and monitoring the resolution of identified issues. • Analysing website structure, URLs, indexation, canonical tags, robots.txt, sitemaps and internal links. • Working with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Collecting and clustering the semantic core / keyword set. • Conducting keyword research and analysing search intent. • Analysing competitors and their SEO strategies. • Developing content plans together with editors and writers. • Preparing SEO briefs and technical specifications for new pages and articles. • Optimising existing content and landing pages. • Working with title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H3 headings, internal linking and page structure. • Monitoring the indexation and search visibility of newly published content. • Identifying opportunities to increase the websites’ topical authority. • Developing and implementing an off-page SEO and link-building strategy. • Analysing the backlink profiles of the company’s websites and competitors. • Monitoring rankings, organic traffic, CTR and conversions from organic search. • Preparing regular SEO reports.

We offer: • Flexible working arrangements (full-time or part-time).
• Remote work opportunities. • Long-term cooperation. • Competitive remuneration depending on experience and qualifications. • High salary.

Other requirements: Who We Are Looking For
We are looking for a person who can work systematically with technical SEO, content, semantics, backlink profiles, analytics and search visibility. We are not looking for a specialist whose role is limited to placing keywords or purchasing links, but for a team member who wants to develop together with the company. The key result of the role is sustainable growth in high-quality organic traffic, rankings for commercially important queries and the company website’s overall search visibility. What We Expect from the Candidate • Practical SEO experience. • A strong understanding of how Google Search works. • Experience conducting technical SEO audits. • Experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics. • Ability to conduct keyword research and competitor research. • Understanding of on-page and off-page SEO. • Understanding of link-building principles. • Experience working with large content-driven websites will be an advantage. Tools Experience with some of the following tools is preferred: • Google Search Console; • Google Analytics; • Ahrefs / Semrush; • Screaming Frog; • Google Keyword Planner; • PageSpeed Insights.

Option to work from home: Yes

jobs.title: Ratkaisuomistaja, Automaatio
jobs.description: Automaatio-tiimin ratkaisuomistaja. Siinä on energiaa - Tule meille näyttämään kykysi ja rakentamaan puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää! Me Helenissä tarjoamme helpompaa ja mutkattomampaa arkea kaikkialla Suomessa. Lämmön, jäähdytyksen ja sähkön lisäksi tarjoamme ratkaisuja alueelliseen ja uusiutuvaan energiaan sekä sähköiseen liikenteeseen. Kehitämme fiksumpaa ja puhtaampaa energiajärjestelmää, jonka avulla pidämme huolta, että asiakkaamme voivat tuottaa, käyttää ja säästää energiaa ympäristöä kunnioittaen. Vähennämme suunnitelmallisesti päästöjämme ja tavoitteemme on irtautua polttamiseen perustuvasta energiantuotannosta vuoteen 2040 mennessä. Etsimme nyt ratkaisuomistajaa uuteen Automaatio-tiimiin. Tässä uudessa roolissa pääset varmistamaan, että Helenin energiajärjestelmän operoinnin kannalta keskeiset integraatiot toimivat luotettavasti, turvallisesti ja ennakoitavasti. Työsuhde on vakituinen. Automaatiotiimi vastaa siitä, että IT/OT-rajapintojen tietovirrat laitosten, verkkojen ja valvomojärjestelmien välillä toimivat keskeytyksettä. Tiimi toimii useiden IT- ja automaatiokumppaneiden kanssa ja varmistaa omalta osaltaan huoltovarmuuskriittisen toimintavarmuuden 24/7. Automaatiokerroksen tietoturva on yksi tiimin keskeisistä vastuualueista. Roolissasi Johdat Automaatio-tiimin työtä ja sen omistamia digitaalisia ratkaisuja.Vastaat IT/OT-rajapintojen arkkitehtuurista ja elinkaaren hallinnasta.Varmistat ratkaisujen jatkuvuutta, teknisten riskien hallintaa ja palveluiden palauttamista poikkeustilanteissa.Johdat tiimiä tukevien kumppaneiden työtä.Vastaat tiimin talouden suunnittelusta, seurannasta ja tavoitteiden mukaisesta ohjauksesta.Uudistat toimintamalleja yhdessä liiketoimintojen kanssa Helen-tasoista tehokkuutta tavoitellen.Vastaat pidemmän aikavälin suunnittelusta, priorisoinnista ja roadmap-työstä.Vastaat työn, nykytilan, päätösten ja kehityssuunnan läpinäkyvyydestä sidosryhmille.Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä liiketoiminnan automaatioasiantuntijoiden, SCADA-tiimin, tietoturvatiimin, kumppaneiden sekä Digitaalisten ratkaisujen johdon kanssa.Toivomme sinulta Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemusta kriittisten automaatiojärjestelmien tiedonhallinnasta, teollisuusautomaatiojärjestelmien periaatteista ja tiedonsiirtoprotokollista.Kokemusta teknisenä johtajana toimimisesta ja sidosryhmien johtamisesta.Ymmärrystä järjestelmäarkkitehtuureista, tietovirroista ja laajoista end-to-end-kokonaisuuksista.Kykyä arvioida teknisten ratkaisujen kustannuksia, hyötyjä ja liiketoiminta-arvoa.Kokemusta ketterien menetelmien ja työkalujen hyödyntämisestä käytännön työssä.Huolellista, jämäkkää ja innostavaa työotetta myös tilanteissa, joissa pienillä muutoksilla voi olla laajoja vaikutuksia.Erinomaisia kirjallisia ja suullisia viestintätaitoja suomeksi ja englanniksi.Aiempi kokemus energiatoimialalta ei ole välttämätöntä, mutta siitä on tehtävässä hyötyä.Tarjoamme sinulle Tarjoamme sinulle merkityksellisen roolin Helenin energiajärjestelmän ytimessä. Pääset vaikuttamaan liiketoiminnalle kriittisiin kokonaisuuksiin, joiden toimivuus näkyy suoraan operoinnin sujuvuudessa, muutosten ennakoitavuudessa ja päätöksenteon luotettavuudessa. Pääset rakentamaan uutta tiimiä ja sen käytänteitä, kehittämään IT/OT-rajapintojen arkkitehtuuria ja vahvistamaan Helenin kykyä johtaa energiajärjestelmää datan, automaation ja kumppaniverkoston avulla. Lisäksi pääset nauttimaan henkilöstöeduistamme, kuten henkilöstösähköstä, hyväntekeväisyystyöpäivästä, mahdollisuudesta etätyöhön ulkomailla sekä hyvinvointiedusta. Toimistomme sijaitsee Ruoholahden We Landissa, ja työskentelemme joustavasti hybridimallilla. Tehtävän palkka määräytyy tehtävän vaativuuden sekä osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Voit kysyä meillä työskentelystä tai tehtävästä tarkemmin tulevalta esihenkilöltäsi (Henri Ihalainen / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi) ja ratkaisualueen päälliköltä (Janne Piispanen / etunimi.sukunimi@helen.fi). Huomioithan, että käsittelemme hakemuksia jo hakuaikana. Toivottavasti kuulemme sinusta pian!

jobs.title: Vil du bygge bedriftsmarkedet for Skalde?
jobs.description:
Skalde søker en selvstendig B2B-selger som vil være med på å gjøre dokumentert kompetanse til et konkurransefortrinn for norske bedrifter.

Mange bedrifter har langt mer kompetanse enn de klarer å dokumentere. Kursbevis ligger i permer og innbokser, CV-er er ikke oppdatert siden ansettelsen, og viktig erfaring finnes bare i hodene på medarbeiderne.

Så kommer anbudsfristen. Kunden ber om dokumentasjon. Et sertifikat har utløpt. Ingen vet sikkert hvem som oppfyller kravene. Det er dette Skalde løser.

Vi har utviklet en norsk plattform som samler kompetansestyring, kurs og anbudsarbeid i én løsning. Nå søker vi en selvstendig salgskonsulent som kan hjelpe oss med å bygge bedriftsmarkedet.

Et produkt som løser et konkret problem

Skalde gjør bedriftens kompetanse synlig, dokumentert og anvendelig.

Skalde Styring gir bedriften samlet oversikt over medarbeidere, kompetansekrav, kurs, sertifikater og utløpsdatoer. Bedriften ser hvem som kan hva, hvor det finnes kompetansegap, og hva som må fornyes. Eksisterende CV-er kan lastes opp og leses inn automatisk, slik at kunden slipper å starte med et tomt system.

Skalde Anbud finner relevante offentlige konkurranser i Doffin, tolker kravene og vurderer dem opp mot bedriftens kompetanse, erfaring og kapasitet. Kunden får raskt vite om virksomheten har forutsetningene for å levere, og får hjelp til å utarbeide hele tilbudsbesvarelsen.

AI Rådgiver og AI Kursbygger foreslår tiltak når kompetanse mangler, og gjør det mulig for bedriften å utvikle egne interne kurs og opplæringsløp.

Skalde Kurs gir tilgang til en voksende kurskatalog med enkel tildeling, gjennomføring og dokumentasjon. Kunden kan kjøpe kurs uten abonnement eller bindingstid, noe som gir en lav terskel for å starte samarbeidet.

Bedrifter bruker i dag ofte flere separate systemer til kurs, kompetanse, CV-er, dokumentasjon og anbud. Skalde samler hele arbeidsflyten.

Om oppdraget

Du får ansvar for å utvikle din egen kundeportefølje og følge kundene gjennom hele salgsprosessen, fra første kontakt til avtale og videre oppfølging.

Arbeidet vil blant annet bestå av å:

  • finne og kontakte aktuelle bedriftskunder

  • kartlegge hvordan kunden arbeider med kompetanse, kurs, dokumentasjon og anbud i dag

  • gjennomføre møter og produktdemonstrasjoner

  • utforme forslag og følge opp beslutningstakere

  • inngå avtaler om Skalde Styring og aktuelle tilleggsmoduler

  • utvikle langsiktige kunderelasjoner og identifisere nye salgsmuligheter

  • bidra med innsikt som gjør produktet og salgsarbeidet enda bedre


Vi retter oss i første omgang mot bedrifter innen bygg og anlegg og håndverk samt rådgivende virksomheter og konsulentselskaper. Salgsarbeidet er likevel ikke begrenset til disse markedene.

Du selger derfor ikke bare et system. Du hjelper kunden med å få bedre kontroll, redusere risiko og bruke kompetansen sin mer aktivt i markedet.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du vil lykkes i oppdraget dersom du:

  • har erfaring med B2B-salg og er komfortabel med å kontakte nye kunder

  • kan drive en salgsprosess selvstendig fra prospektering til signert avtale

  • forstår at gode bedriftsavtaler ofte krever tillit, oppfølging og flere samtaler

  • er god til å avdekke behov før du presenterer en løsning

  • kan snakke med en daglig leder om drift, lønnsomhet og risiko, ikke bare om funksjoner

  • arbeider strukturert og følger opp det du starter

  • trives med frihet, ansvar og korte beslutningsveier

Erfaring fra bygg og anlegg, håndverk, rådgivning, konsulentvirksomhet, kurs eller HR-teknologi er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Det viktigste er at du forstår bedriftsmarkedet og kan skape tillit hos beslutningstakere.

Dette får du fra Skalde

Du får et gjennomarbeidet produkt, tydelige målgrupper og tett støtte i salgsarbeidet.

Skalde stiller med:

  • grundig opplæring i produktet, markedet og kundebehovene

  • tilgang til CRM med bedriftsdata, prospektlister og relevante kjøpssignaler

  • materiell og støtte til møter, demonstrasjoner og tilbud

  • direkte samarbeid med gründeren og korte veier fra tilbakemelding til beslutning

  • stor frihet til å styre arbeidstid, arbeidsform og arbeidssted

  • mulighet til å påvirke hvordan salgsarbeidet bygges opp

  • anledning til å kombinere oppdraget med andre kunder og salgsoppdrag


Dette passer særlig godt for deg som ønsker stor selvstendighet og motiveres av å bygge opp noe, ikke bare overta en ferdig kundeportefølje.

Oppdragsform og betingelser

Dette er et provisjonsbasert konsulentoppdrag. Du arbeider gjennom eget foretak og fakturerer opptjent provisjon etter avtalte betingelser.

Oppdraget kan kombineres med andre oppdrag. Vi er også åpne for samarbeid med etablerte salgsselskaper som ønsker å ta Skalde inn i produktporteføljen. For den rette personen kan dette bli et langsiktig samarbeid med en sentral rolle i Skaldes videre vekst.

Interessert?

Send noen linjer om deg selv, salgserfaringen din og hvorfor du tror Skalde kan være et godt produkt for deg å representere. Du kan også ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om produktet, markedet og betingelsene.

Kontaktperson

Audun Andreassen

+47 99 03 88 00

audun@skalde.no

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Skalde er en norsk plattform for kompetansestyring, kursadministrasjon og anbudsarbeid. Kundene er bedrifter i alt fra bygg og anlegg til rådgivning, der dokumentert kompetanse avgjør om de får oppdraget. Et tillegg som selger seg selv. Du får tilgang til et prospektregister med norske bedrifter, der du velger selv hvem du vil jobbe med.

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ABOUT THE ROLE

Replit is investing seriously in paid media — TV, CTV, online video, out-of-home, audio, social, and search — and we need the person who makes that investment work. This role is the internal owner of our media program: you'll direct our external media agencies, pressure-test their plans, steward the budget, and hold every dollar accountable for reaching the right audiences on the right channels at the right time.

You'll report to the VP of Marketing and act as the connective tissue between our brand and growth teams and our agency partners. This is not a hands-on-keyboard activation role. You won't be living in Ads Manager — you'll be the person who briefs the agency, challenges the channel mix, catches the pacing problem before it becomes a budget problem, and translates campaign performance into decisions leadership can act on.

This is the right role if you've sat on the brand side (or want to move there from a media agency), you know what a great media plan looks like and what a lazy one looks like, and you get energy from being the sharpest media mind in the room without needing to touch the platforms yourself.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Agency leadership: Serve as the primary day-to-day partner to our media agencies. Set strategy direction, write clear briefs, run planning cycles and QBRs, and hold partners accountable for performance, optimization, quality, and business results.

 - Plan interrogation: Review and challenge agency recommendations across every channel — TV, CTV, OLV, OOH, audio, social, search, programmatic. Catch weak rationale, frequency saturation risks, and budget misallocations before plans get approved.

 - Budget stewardship: Own media budget pacing, forecasting, authorizations, and reconciliation in partnership with Finance. Monitor spend and delivery mid-flight, flag risks early, and drive reallocations when the data says to.

 - Media strategy & planning: Lead annual, quarterly, and campaign-level planning with the agency. Make sure plans reflect our audiences, product moments, competitive pressure, and business goals — not just what's easy to buy.

 - Measurement & accountability: Define campaign KPIs and measurement frameworks with the agency and our analytics team. Own wrap reports, drive a test-and-learn agenda (incrementality, brand lift, MMM as we scale), and go beyond CPMs and impressions to reach efficiency and cost-per-outcome.

 - Executive reporting: Distill campaign and channel performance into clear recommendations for marketing leadership. Tell us what worked, what didn't, and what we should do differently — with numbers behind it.

 - Cross-functional alignment: Partner with Brand, Growth, Creative, Product Marketing, Social, and Comms so media plans amplify what the rest of marketing is building, and so creative assets fit the placements we're buying.



REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

 - 5+ years of media planning and strategy experience, either brand-side managing external agencies or at a media agency serving major consumer brands

 - Demonstrated experience independently reviewing and challenging agency media plans, not just executing against them

 - Experience managing multi-million dollar media budgets across concurrent campaigns, including pacing, forecasting, and mid-flight reallocation

 - Fluency across the full channel landscape: TV/CTV, online video, OOH, audio/podcasts, paid social, search, and programmatic — you can evaluate rates, rationale, and audience fit in any of them

 - Strong command of media measurement: reach and frequency, brand lift, incrementality testing, and marketing mix modeling

 - Sharp analytical skills; you can work from raw campaign data to find performance trends and budget inefficiencies, and you're at home in Excel

 - Strong stakeholder management across Finance, Analytics, Creative, and agency teams; you write briefs people can actually work from

 - AI-native: actively using AI tools to speed up analysis, reporting, and planning work — you're not just aware of them, you're using them daily

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and at speed; you don't need committee consensus to make smart decisions



BONUS QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience at a high-growth consumer tech, B2C, or AI company

 - Agency alumni who've made (or want to make) the move to the client side

 - Experience standing up a media function or measurement framework from scratch

 - Experience with OOH and large cultural-moment buys (sponsorships, tentpole events)

 - A point of view on how AI is changing media planning and buying — and what most brands get wrong about it

 - Active Replit user; you've built and shipped something with the product

 - Based in or able to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area

jobs.description:
Director, Commercial Enablement

We're looking for a Director, Commercial Enablement to build and lead our Commercial Enablement function across 37 EMEA markets. Sitting at the heart of our EMEA Merchant organisation, you'll lead a multi-disciplinary pod spanning Commercial Learning & Development, Analytics and Commercial Incentives, equipping our Merchant Sales, Account Management, and Support teams with the insights, capabilities, tools, and incentives they need to execute consistently and deliver exceptional merchant outcomes.

This is a hands-on leadership role for a pragmatic senior operator who thrives on turning commercial strategy into scalable systems — someone who can build high-performing teams, navigate ambiguity, and drive measurable improvements in frontline productivity, training effectiveness, and incentive performance.

Get to know our Commercial team — what drives us, how we work, and what you can expect.

What You’ll Be Doing

Learning & Development: You'll oversee the design and delivery of learning programs that build the skills, knowledge, and confidence Sales, Account Management, and Support teams need to execute consistently across markets — from new hire onboarding and role-based learning paths to manager enablement and targeted capability-building tied to commercial priorities. You'll partner closely with commercial leaders and central People, HR, and L&D teams to ensure programs are practical, measurable, and integrated into the broader company learning agenda.

Commercial Incentives: You'll own the design, rollout, and operation of incentive programs that align frontline behaviour with selection, growth, quality, profitability, and merchant outcome goals — ensuring plans are commercially sound, easy to understand, and operationally scalable. You'll also drive continuous improvement in incentive governance, documentation, controls, dispute resolution, and performance measurement, with accurate tracking and on-time payouts throughout.

Analytics & Reporting: You'll be responsible for providing trusted, actionable performance insights to commercial leaders and frontline teams. You will ensure leaders and teams have access to clear dashboards, validated metrics, consistent definitions, and reporting that helps them identify priority merchants, performance gaps, execution opportunities, and areas requiring intervention. You will partner closely with Data Science, Engineering, Analytics, and business stakeholders to improve data availability, data quality, metric consistency, and reporting adoption.

What We're Looking For

We're seeking a seasoned commercial, strategy, operations, or enablement leader with a track record of operating at scale across complex, multi-country markets.

  • 8+ years' experience in strategy consulting, commercial strategy, revenue operations, sales operations, merchant operations, or a related field

  • A track record of leading multi-disciplinary, multi-country teams, ideally spanning analytics, learning & development, program management, and incentive design

  • Strong commercial judgment and a relentless drive to connect enablement work to measurable business outcomes

  • A bias for action — pragmatic, hands-on, and comfortable navigating ambiguity

  • Experience building scalable operating models, processes, governance, and performance management systems

  • A proven ability to design and deliver L&D programs for Sales, Account Management, and Support teams

  • Strong analytical fluency — defining metrics, challenging data quality, and turning insight into action

  • Hands-on experience with incentive programs, sales compensation, variable pay, or other performance-based reward mechanisms

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity and align diverse audiences around clear decisions

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

jobs.title: Talent Investor - Venture Studio
jobs.description:
About Founders Factory:

Founders Factory is a venture studio and accelerator. We build technology companies from scratch, working with leading corporate partners to identify opportunities, develop new products and businesses, and build the founding teams that turn them into independent companies.

Unlike a traditional VC, we don't just invest in companies that already exist. We help create them. That means our approach to talent is different too. We believe the right founder can fundamentally change the trajectory of a company.

About the Role:

As a Talent Investor, you'll sit at the intersection of venture, talent and company building, helping us identify the exceptional people who will build our next generation of companies.

Our ventures often start with a problem or opportunity, rather than a founder. Your job is to find the person who can turn that opportunity into an excellent business.

You'll work closely with our Venture Builders, Studio Leads and founders to:

  • Identify exceptional founders across our global network and beyond.

  • Build talent maps and develop a point of view on where the best founders and operators sit.

  • Assess individuals for founder-market fit, looking beyond CVs and conventional credentials to understand their potential to build a company.

  • Build relationships with exceptional people who aren't necessarily looking for their next role.

  • Convince them to take the leap into entrepreneurship and build with Founders Factory.

  • Help founders identify and recruit their early founding team across product, technology, commercial and growth.

  • Develop our approach to founder sourcing, assessment and talent intelligence as we build more ventures.

This isn't traditional recruitment. You won't be given a list of vacancies to fill. You'll be given venture theses and asked to work out who could build them.

You'll have significant autonomy to experiment with how we identify, assess and attract exceptional people, and your work will directly influence the quality and trajectory of the companies we build.

About You

At your core, you're obsessed with exceptional people and curious about how great companies are built.

You might come from VC, executive search, strategy consulting, investment banking, a high-growth startup, venture building or talent. You don't need to have worked in venture before.

What matters is that you can:

  • Spot exceptional people and develop a strong point of view on their potential.

  • Understand businesses, markets and what makes founders successful.

  • Build genuine relationships and influence people to make high-stakes career decisions.

  • Source talent creatively, particularly people who aren't actively looking.

  • Operate with limited information, ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy.

  • Balance instinct with evidence and be willing to change your mind.

  • Move quickly without compromising your judgement.

  • Communicate clearly and challenge assumptions when needed.

You don't need to be a founder or have a traditional career path. We care more about your judgement, curiosity, ambition and ability to identify exceptional people.

What You'll Be Measured On

  • Founder quality: Exceptional founders joining our ventures.

  • Founder-market fit: The quality of our decisions around who should build which company.

  • Speed: Moving from venture thesis to founder commitment quickly.

  • Founding teams: Helping founders build the teams they need to succeed.

  • Talent intelligence: Building a proprietary network and understanding of exceptional founders and operators.

  • Repeatability: Making our approach to talent investing better and more scalable over time.

A Career in Venture

Talent Investing sits at the intersection of people, company building and venture capital.

You'll develop an investor's perspective on founders and companies at the earliest possible stage, often before there is a company to invest in.

Over time, there is scope to develop into broader venture-building and investment responsibilities across Founders Factory, depending on your performance, interests and the needs of the business.

Our Culture

Working at Founders Factory is very different from working at a traditional company. We are resilient business builders, passionate about what we're creating and comfortable operating in uncertainty.

We:

  • Think big, act small, move fast

  • Value momentum over perfection

  • Embrace uncertainty and remain decisive

  • Suggest solutions, not problems

  • Prioritise diversity to strengthen our collective intelligence

  • Are polite, generous and show empathy to others

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary

  • Shares in the Founders Factory global portfolio

  • Hybrid working — typically Tuesdays and Thursdays in the London office

  • Up to 5 weeks working abroad each year

  • 25 days annual leave

  • 1 additional mental health day per quarter

  • Monthly calendar freedom day

  • Travel opportunities across our global Founders Factory offices

  • Access to our network of founders, investors, operators and corporate partners

Founders Factory is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where people can authentically be themselves, challenge assumptions, take risks and think creatively.

jobs.title: Senior Veterinary Surgeon - Small Animal
jobs.description:
Senior Vet Surgeon

Salary up to £75,000 DOE

Relocation Allowance up to £5,000 plus a Welcome Bonus of up to £5000

 

Dragon Vets, part of inspiring vet care, are seeking an enthusiastic Veterinary Surgeon to join our Rissington site as a Senior Vet, The role will require you to help shape the future of the branch by developing the staff and supporting senior management to ensure the site thrives.

 

We promote further growth and development within the team, giving you access to a large client base with a wide variety of cases, equipment, CPD and a supportive team. In this role you will be working with a large team of dedicated Vets, Nurses and support team members to deliver excellent client and patient care.

 
The role will be based at our Rissington branch and is a full-time position, working four days per week.
 

At inspiring vet care, our people are at the heart of everything we do. As the UK’s number one vet care provider, we're trusted with the care of over 2 million animals, delivering our purpose of healthier animals and happier owners.

 

Practice Highlights

 

Located in the heart of Cheltenham, renowned for horse racing and a thriving bar and restaurant scene, Dragon Vets is an established practice and has invested in specialist equipment including CT, DR, rigid and flexible endoscopy, high-end Doppler ultrasonography and well-equipped operating facilities including laparoscopic kits and TPLO kits, and much more.

 

We have a team of 16 vets, including certificate holders with Advanced Practitioner status in Small Animal Surgery, Cardiology and Medicine, and value evidence-based medicine with regular clinical discussions and readily available colleague support.

 

We function as more than a first-opinion practice, often performing complex surgeries and treating intensive medical cases that may otherwise have been referred. Having been established for decades, we have a huge client base which comes with lots of variety in caseload.

 

We have a dedicated, separate out-of-hours team – Vets Now – based within the same building, enabling 24-hour care. Our nursing team is made up of 17 RVNs and 4 SVNs in various stages of their training.

 

Working Pattern

 
* Average of 37 hours per week over 4 days
* 1 in 4 Saturday mornings
* No out-of-hours or on-call requirements
* Flexible options available for both part-time and full-time applicants
 

Here's what the team have to say

 

"I started at Dragon Vets nine years ago working after school as an ACA. After leaving to go to vet school, I was welcomed back into the team as a new graduate vet in 2023. Dragon have given me a supportive and exciting start to my career. We are lucky to have the facilities in house to advance diagnostics and care beyond first opinion. I enjoy working with all the team and am proud to be a part of it." – Sofia, Vet.

 

How You’ll Make a Difference

 

As Lead Veterinary Surgeon, you will be the most senior veterinary clinician within the practice, responsible for leading clinical standards, governance and the delivery of outstanding patient and client care.

 

You’ll provide clinical leadership to the veterinary team, oversee complex cases and act as the primary source of clinical guidance and decision-making within the practice. Working closely with the senior practice leadership team, you’ll support the strategic direction of the practice and drive continuous improvement in clinical quality, outcomes and ways of working.

 

You Might Be a Great Fit If...

 

You are a highly experienced veterinary surgeon with strong clinical expertise and a passion for leadership and clinical excellence. You’ll bring:

 
* A Veterinary degree and registration with the RCVS, with significant experience in small or mixed animal practice, including advanced surgical and medical capability
* Proven experience in mentoring, coaching and supporting veterinary colleagues
* Strong leadership, communication and decision-making skills
* Experience contributing to or leading clinical governance, audits and quality improvement initiatives
* The ability to manage clinical complaints and provide professional guidance in complex situations
* Professionalism, integrity and a commitment to the highest standards of patient and client care
 

How We’ll Support You

 

At inspiring vet care, we’re committed to supporting your ongoing development and wellbeing. When you join us, you’ll benefit from:

 
* Clear career pathways with progression opportunities across primary care, referral, leadership and specialist roles
* Funded learning and development including CPD allowance and access to IVC Academy training centres and role-relevant courses
* £1,250 annual Care Fund for every vet
* Access to mentors, regional clinical coaches and peer networks
* Support to develop clinical interests and expand your capabilities
* A collaborative, values-led culture focused on care, community and continuous improvement
 

What We Offer Our Team

 
* 6.6 weeks’ holiday including bank holidays
* Private medical insurance
* Enhanced family leave and pay across maternity, paternity, adoption and surrogacy
* BVA membership, VDS cover & RCVS fees
* Cycle to Work and Green Car schemes (eligibility applies)
* Retail discounts and cashback offers
* Reduced-cost veterinary care for your own pets
 

We’re committed to supporting our people through career development opportunities, wellbeing initiatives and access to world-class learning resources.

 

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take the next step in your career, inspiring vet care offers the support, opportunity and community to help you grow.

jobs.title: Rådgjevar/seniorrådgjevar (jurist) – barnevern
jobs.description:
Om stillinga

Statsforvaltaren i Vestland lyser ut éi fast stilling for jurist på barnevernsområdet. Vi søkjer ein engasjert og fagleg sterk medarbeidar som ønskjer å bidra til forsvarlege og trygge tenester for barn og unge.

Tilsyn med barnevernsinstitusjonar er ein sentral del av stillinga.

Helse-, sosial- og barnevernsavdelinga har ansvar for tilsyn, rettleiing, klagesaksbehandling og andre forvaltningsoppgåver innan barnevern, sosialtenester, helse og omsorg. Vi jobbar i skjeringspunktet mellom juss og barnevernsfag på velferdsområdet. Vi løyser oppgåvene med høg kvalitet, fagleg tyngde og er i kontinuerleg utvikling.

Stillinga ligg til kontorstad Leikanger.


Arbeidsoppgåver

Ein vesentleg del av arbeidet er tilsyn med barnevernsinstitusjonar, der du vil

  • planleggje, gjennomføre og følgje opp tilsyn
  • vurdere praksis opp mot barnevernslova og forskrifter
  • utarbeide rapportar og eventuelle pålegg
  • samarbeide tett med kommunar, institusjonar og andre aktørar

Andre sentrale oppgåver er

  • behandling av klager og andre forvaltningssaker
  • råd og rettleiing til tenester og brukarar
  • formidling av faglege vurderingar
  • deltaking i fagutvikling og kompetanseheving

Andre relevante oppgåver kan bli tildelte etter avtale med seksjonsleiar.


Kvalifikasjonar
  • Juridisk embetseksamen / master i rettsvitskap
  • Gjerne erfaring frå barnevernsfeltet
  • God innsikt i offentleg forvaltning
  • God munnleg og skriftleg framstillingsevne på nynorsk og bokmål
  • Evne til strukturert og sjølvstendig arbeid
  • Trygg i møte med komplekse faglege vurderingar
  • Det er ønskjeleg med førarkort klasse B

Personlege eigenskapar

Vi ser etter deg som

  • har gode samarbeidsevner og trivst i tverrfaglege miljø
  • er analytisk, grundig og fagleg trygg
  • kommuniserer klart og forståeleg
  • bidreg positivt til arbeidsmiljøet
  • er fleksibel, løysingsorientert og utviklingsretta

Personlege eigenskapar blir vektlagde.


Som tilsett hos Statsforvaltaren får du
  • interessante arbeidsoppgåver
  • eit kompetent og tverrfagleg arbeidsmiljø
  • ein arbeidsplass i utvikling
  • medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med god pensjonsordning, gunstig bustadlån og forsikringsordning
  • trening i arbeidstida
  • delvis heimekontor 
  • fleksibel arbeidstid
  • løn i samsvar med vår lokale lønspolitikk

Vil du jobbe hos oss? | Statsforvaltaren i Vestland

Kontora våre i Leikanger og Førde ligg i kommunar som er omfatta av den nye ordninga for sletting av studiegjeld. Det vil seie at etter eitt år som yrkesaktiv kan du få sletta 25 000 kroner av studielånet ditt.


Vi ønskjer mangfald

Statsforvaltaren ønskjer mangfald, og vil leggje til rette for eit inkluderande arbeidsliv. Aktuell tilrettelegging kan for eksempel vere tekniske hjelpemiddel, tilpassing av møblar eller endringar av rutinar, arbeidsoppgåver og arbeidstid. 

Vi meiner at inkludering og mangfald er ein styrke. Vi ønskjer tilsette med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjonar, livserfaring og perspektiv for å bidra til endå betre oppgåveløysing.

Vi oppmodar alle kvalifiserte kandidatar til å søkje utan omsyn til alder, kjønn, nasjonal eller etnisk bakgrunn, funksjonsevne eller hol i CV-en. Vi oppmodar om å krysse av i jobbsøkjarportalen dersom du har nedsett funksjonsevne, hol i CV-en eller innvandrarbakgrunn. Dersom det er kvalifiserte søkjarar frå desse gruppene kallar vi inn minst ein søkjar i kvar av gruppene til intervju. 


Vilkår

Alle som søkjer stillinga må søkje digitalt gjennom rekrutteringsportalen Jobbnorge. Du må laste opp relevante vitnemål og attestar. Vitnemål og/eller karakterutskrifter hentar du frå vitnemålsportalen i Jobbnorge. Har du utdanning frå utlandet legg du ved godkjenning frå HK-dir. 

Når søknadsfristen er ute, vurderer vi søknaden din på bakgrunn av informasjonen du har sendt oss. Det er derfor viktig at du både i søknadsbrevet og CV-en, viser korleis kompetansen din fyller krava som er sett i utlysinga. 

Stillinga er lønna i stillingskode 1434 rådgjevar/1364 seniorrådgjevar, frå kr 610 000–770 000 brutto per år ut frå kvalifikasjonar og lokal lønnspolitikk. Stilling som seniorrådgjevar har strenge krav til kompetanse. For særskilt kvalifiserte søkjarar kan vi vurdere høgare løn. 

Dei første seks månadane er prøvetid. Du kan lese meir om det i statens personalhandbok.

Tenestemålet til embetet er nynorsk.

Offentleg søkjarliste blir utarbeidd etter søknadsfrist. Dersom du ønskjer å reservere deg frå oppføring må du grunngje dette. Du får varsel om reservasjon i rekrutteringsportalen dersom reservasjon ikkje blir teken til følgje.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Statsforvaltaren har eit heilskapsansvar for all statleg verksemd i fylket, og skal følgje opp vedtak, mål og retningslinjer frå stortinget og regjeringa. Vi skal dessutan fremje fylket sine interesser, og kan dermed ta initiativ både lokalt og overfor sentrale styringsmakter.

Statsforvaltaren kjenner kommunane, og er i kontakt med mange enkeltmenneske i ulike situasjonar og livsfasar.

Vi jobbar heile tida for at omverda skal oppleve Statsforvaltaren som tilgjengeleg, nær og løysingsorientert.

Statsforvaltaren i Vestland er ein spennande arbeidsplass med seks avdelingar og kring 280 tilsette. Vi har delt lokalisering mellom Leikanger, Bergen og Førde – med hovudsete i Leikanger.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At CesiumAstro, we are developers and pioneers of out-of-the-box communication systems for satellites, UAVs, launch vehicles, and other space and airborne platforms. We take pride in our dynamic and cross-functional work environment, which allows us to learn, develop, and engage across our organization. If you are looking for hands-on, interactive, and autonomous work, CesiumAstro is the place for you. We are actively seeking passionate, collaborative, energetic, and forward-thinking individuals to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for low-level and high-level software in CesiumAstro’s products through all phases of the development process. Key projects will include Linux-based single-board computers and high-reliability microcontroller systems. CesiumAstro’s goal is to create an out-of-the-box hardware and software experience which enhances our customers’ ability to rapidly integrate our products into their systems.
 
As a CesiumAstro software team member, you will be responsible for software designs from concept through production, including product roadmaps, block diagrams, detailed design and coding, analysis, test, qualification, and in-orbit support. The ideal candidate will have development experience at nearly every level of the software stack, including microcontrollers, low-level drivers, board support packages (BSP), end-use applications, and user interfaces. Additionally, the ideal candidate will have experience in software testing and high-reliability qualification, as well as software engineering and software project management practices.
 
The successful candidate will present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Designing and implementing software for embedded devices and systems, from requirements to production and commercial deployment.
  • Designing, developing, coding, testing, debugging, and documenting system software.
  • Reviewing code and system designs.
  • Analyzing code for efficiency, stability, and scalability.
  • Integrating and validating new product designs.
  • Supporting software quality assurance and optimizing I/O performance.
  • Providing post-production/in-orbit customer support.
  • Interfacing with hardware design and development engineers.
  • Assessing third-party and open-source software.

    • JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
  • A Bachelor of Science (BS) or Master of Science (MS) degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or Computer Engineering.
  • 4+ years of industry experience in software development.
  • Experience in hands-on development and troubleshooting of embedded hardware. API design for interfacing with FPGAs.
  • Experience with products for aerospace applications.
  • Programming experience in C or C++.
  • Experience in embedded systems design with preemptive, multitasking real-time operating systems (experience with real-time Linux is desirable).
  • Familiarity with software configuration management tools, defect tracking tools, and peer review.
  • Excellent knowledge of real-time system coding techniques, IP protocols, interfaces, and hardware subsystems.
  • Excellent understanding of multi-threaded applications and resource management.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

    • PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
  • Adequate knowledge of reading electronics schematics and component data sheets.
  • Experience with ARM processors and fully-featured microcontrollers.
  • Experience in the design and development of a Software Development Kit (SDK).
    • CesiumAstro considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills.

    Please be aware that many roles will be subject to both security and export control restrictions. These restrictions mean that factors including new starter’s nationality, any previous or dual nationalities held, place of birth and country of residence may limit those roles that you can perform for the organisation.

    Please note: CesiumAstro does not accept unsolicited resumes from contract agencies or search firms. Any unsolicited resumes submitted to our website or to CesiumAstro team members not through our approved vendor list or Talent Acquisition will be considered property of CesiumAstro, and we will not be obligated to pay any referral fees.

elintarviketurvallisuuden, omavalvonnan, laadun ja hygienian varmistaminen.

Tehtävän pääpaino on keittiön päivittäisessä johtamisessa, lämpimässä ruoassa sekä aamiaisen ja brunssin tuotannossa. Croissant- ja konditoriaosaaminen muodostaa tärkeän osan yrityksen suunniteltua aamiainen- ja bakery-konseptia.

soveltuvaa ravintola-, kokki-, leipomo- tai konditoria-alan ammatillista tutkintoa tai vastaavaa työkokemuksella hankittua osaamista

Personliga assistenter sökes till lugn och trevlig man i Bankeryd
jobs.description:
Vi söker nu dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent till en av våra kunder – en varm och vänlig man som bor i hus tillsammans med sin fru. Deras vuxna barn kommer ofta på besök och ofta finns också en hund vid deras sida.

Om kunden

Vår kund lever med MS och har behov av stöd i vardagen. Arbetet innebär bland annat:

    

Hjälp med förflyttningar och personlig hygien

    

Stöd i hemmet och i det dagliga

    

Promenader, sociala aktiviteter och utflykter

Han uppskattar att vara aktiv och tycker om skytte, motorsport och att komma ut. Ibland är det även en hund som kommer på besök i hemmet – därför är det viktigt att du inte är allergisk.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som:

    

Är social, lugn och trygg

    

Har lätt för att skapa fina relationer

    

Är strukturerad, lyhörd och omtänksam

    

Har körkort

    

Är rökfri

    

Trivs med ett arbete där du gör skillnad – varje dag

Erfarenhet av personlig assistans eller förflyttningsteknik är ett plus, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är att du har rätt personlighet och en vilja att ge stöd på ett respektfullt och professionellt sätt.

Om rollen

Som assistent kommer du att vara ett stöd i alla delar av vardagen. Du är vår kunds armar och ben, men lika viktigt att vara dennes språkrör vilket gör att du måste kunna skriva samt tala svenska obehindrat då vi dokumenterar kundens vardag.  Ibland blir det också aktiviteter utanför hemmet, så du som söker får gärna tycka om att vara social och flexibel – din närvaro blir en viktig del av vår kunds trygghet och glädje i vardagen.



Vill du vara en del av vår kunds liv och skapa en glädjefylld och trygg tillvaro? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

Tjänstgöringsgrad: deltid/heltid, varierande arbetstider. dagpass kl 08-17, kvällspass kl 17-08 eller dygn kl 08-08.

Lön: Timlönen är fast enligt överenskommelse och övriga ersättningar sker enligt kollektivavtal.

Tillträde: Omgående enligt överenskommelse, löper så länge assistansuppdraget varar.



Vilka är vi?

Omsorg Assistans är ett assistansbolag med huvudkontor i Eskilstuna men våra kunderna finns över hela Sverige.

Målsättningen är att skapa de bästa förutsättningarna för en individanpassad personlig assistans. Vår värdegrund är engagemang, lyhördhet och tillgänglighet.

Att vara anställd hos oss innebär en trygghet genom kollektivavtal, marknadsmässig lön, pension, försäkringsskydd och friskvårdsbidrag.

Vi begär alltid ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister.

Vänligen kontakta oss för mer information.

jobs.title: Kokenut autonasentaja / seniorimekaanikko – työsuhde tai yrittäjäyhteistyö
jobs.description:
**KLX-Service hakee Helsingin Herttoniemeen kokenutta autonasentajaa / seniorimekaanikkoa vahvistamaan monimerkkikorjaamomme toimintaa.**

Etsimme ennen kaikkea henkilöä, jolla on riittävästi käytännön kokemusta siihen, että tavalliset huolto- ja korjaustyöt sekä haastavampi vianetsintä onnistuvat itsenäisesti.

Kyseessä ei ole työnjohto- tai kouluttajan tehtävä, vaan haemme ennen kaikkea **itse korjaamotöitä tekevää kokenutta asentajaa**.

**Työtehtäviä**

Työhön kuuluu: henkilö- ja pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjaustyöt

- mekaaninen vianetsintä

- sähkövikojen selvittäminen

- diagnostiikkalaitteiden käyttö

- jarru-, alusta-, moottori- ja voimansiirtotyöt

- haastavampien vikojen selvittäminen

- työmäärien ja korjaustarpeiden arviointi.

- Asiakaspalvelutehtäviä töidenvastaanotossa


**Mitä odotamme**

- useamman vuoden käytännön kokemusta autokorjaamotyöstä

- kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti

- hyvää vianetsintä- ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

- monimerkkiosaamista

- luotettavaa ja huolellista työotetta

- kykyä saattaa työ loppuun asti

- yhteistyökykyä muun korjaamohenkilökunnan kanssa.


Tutkinnot ovat eduksi, mutta käytännön ammattitaito ja kokemus ratkaisevat meille enemmän kuin paperit.

Myös pitkän työuran tehneet asentajat ovat erittäin tervetulleita hakemaan.

**Myös yrittäjä tai kevytyrittäjä kiinnostaa**

Vakituinen työsuhde ei ole ainoa mahdollinen yhteistyömalli.

Jos työskentelet esimerkiksi:

- omalla toiminimellä

- osakeyhtiön kautta

- kevytyrittäjänä

- itsenäisenä autoalan ammattilaisena


voimme keskustella myös toimeksiantopohjaisesta yhteistyöstä.

Yrittäjämallissa työn määrä, hinnoittelu, laskutus ja muut yhteistyön ehdot sovitaan erikseen.

Tämä voi sopia esimerkiksi kokeneelle asentajalle, joka haluaa tehdä töitä muutamana päivänä viikossa, yhdistää KLX:n työt omaan yritystoimintaansa tai ei halua enää sitoutua perinteiseen kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Yrittäjäyhteistyö toteutetaan aidosti itsenäisenä toimeksiantosuhteena.

**Mitä tarjoamme**

- vakituisen työmahdollisuuden tai joustavan yrittäjäyhteistyön

- mahdollisuuden lisäansioon hyvän tuotannon perusteella

- monipuolisia korjaamotöitä

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa korjaamon toimintatapojen kehittämiseen

- vakituisen korjaamotilan Helsingin Herttoniemessä

- pienen organisaation, jossa päätökset voidaan tehdä nopeasti.

jobs.title: Support Technician  Customer & Operations
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy helping customers, solving problems and understanding how things work?

We are looking for a service-minded and technically confident Support Technician who enjoys working with people just as much as solving practical problems.

You will be an important point of contact for our customers and partners and help them get the most out of our solutions. The role combines customer support, troubleshooting, coordination and hands-on operational tasks.

You do not need to be a developer or a deep technical specialist. What matters is that you are comfortable with technology, curious enough to investigate problems and confident communicating with customers when things do not work as expected.

About us

We are a Swedish technology company founded in 2008 focused on asset tracking and connected asset management.

Our platform combines software, location data and connected hardware to help customers track, manage and gain better control of equipment, vehicles and other mobile assets.

We work with customers and partners in multiple markets, and English is a natural part of our day-to-day business.

We are a small, experienced team where people work closely across technology, support, sales and operations. That means short decision paths, broad responsibility and the opportunity to make a real impact.

The role

Your main responsibility will be to support our customers and partners in their day-to-day use of our products and services.

You will answer questions, help solve problems and guide users when something is unclear or not working as expected.

Some issues will be straightforward. Others will require you to investigate further, check configurations, review available information or work together with colleagues in technology or operations.

An important part of the role is knowing how to communicate clearly and professionally — especially when a customer is frustrated, uncertain or needs help understanding a technical issue.

Because we are a small team, the role also includes some practical and operational tasks. You will work closely with fulfilment and may occasionally help with hardware preparation, configuration, shipments, returns and related administration.

What you will do

    Support customers and partners by email, phone and other support channels.
    Help users understand and use our products effectively.
    Troubleshoot technical and practical issues.
    Take ownership of support cases and follow them through to resolution.
    Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical users.
    Investigate issues before escalating them to colleagues.
    Work closely with technology, QA and fulfilment.
    Help with hardware preparation, configuration and operational tasks when needed.
    Document common questions and solutions.
    Identify recurring customer issues and help us improve our processes and product experience.

Who we think you are

You are someone who enjoys helping people and building good customer relationships.

You are patient, clear and professional in your communication, and you are comfortable dealing with both simple questions and more challenging situations.

At the same time, you have a good general understanding of technology and enjoy figuring things out.

You do not need to know everything from the start, but you should be comfortable learning new systems, asking the right questions and investigating a problem before passing it on.

You are also comfortable working in a small team where people help each other and where the role may vary from day to day.

We would like you to have

    Experience from customer support, technical support, IT support or a similar customer-facing role.
    Good general technical understanding and strong computer skills.
    A genuine interest in helping customers and providing a good service experience.
    Strong communication skills.
    Excellent English, both spoken and written.
    Good Swedish, both spoken and written.
    The ability to work independently and take responsibility for your tasks.
    A structured and solution-oriented way of working.
    The ability to stay calm and professional when dealing with difficult or urgent customer situations.

Nice to have

Experience in one or several of the following would be valuable, but is not required:

    Technical support or application support.
    Basic SQL or working with data.
    APIs or system integrations.
    IoT or connected devices.
    GPS, telematics or vehicle-related technology.
    Mobile connectivity and SIM-based devices.
    Hardware configuration or installation.
    Ticketing and support systems.

You do not need to be a developer or advanced technical specialist.

We are looking for someone who can combine good customer service, sound judgement and enough technical understanding to solve problems confidently.

What we offer

    A broad and varied role with real responsibility from day one.
    The opportunity to work closely with both customers and colleagues across the business.
    A small-team environment with short decision paths and plenty of room to influence how we work.
    The chance to build a strong understanding of both our products and our customers.
    A role where you can grow through practical experience rather than being limited to a narrow support function.
    30 days of annual leave.
    A generous wellness allowance and wellness package.
    An international working environment where both Swedish and English are part of everyday communication.

Why this role is different

This is a broad role with close contact with both customers and colleagues.

You will not simply process tickets. You will build relationships with customers, understand their needs and help make sure their issues are genuinely resolved.

At the same time, you will work close enough to our technology and products to develop a strong understanding of how everything fits together.

For the right person, this is an opportunity to build both technical knowledge and customer responsibility in a small team where your contribution matters.

This role could be a great fit if...

You enjoy customer contact and are good at creating trust.

You are technically comfortable without needing to be a specialist.

You like solving problems and taking ownership.

You enjoy variety and working closely with different parts of a business.

And you care about giving customers and partners a good experience — even when something has gone wrong.

If that sounds like you, we would like to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
About Eye Security

Eye Security is an international scale-up providing cyber security with embedded cyber insurance to SMBs in Europe. Our cyber security innovations, state-of-the-art automation and platforms are being built and maintained by our Product and Engineering Teams. Our engineers and product managers collaborate closely with cyber security experts to ensure that their hacker's mindset is embedded into our platform.

Our platform is a proprietary Open XDR (eXtended Detection Response) system that brings in security data from several market leading cyber security products into our centralised repository. From here cyber security experts can work their magic. This makes sure that our hundreds of customers experience the same value via automated systems, allowing us to scale in Europe.

About this role

We're looking for a Senior Engineer to join one of our stream-aligned engineering teams. At Eye, we organise engineering around streams: mission-driven groups with a clear outcome to drive, not a product area or a section of the codebase. You'll work in a small, full-stack team of 2-3 engineers contributing to your stream's goal, working across whatever systems and layers are needed to deliver it. This is a role for someone who wants real ownership, not a queue of tickets.

In this role

  • Own features end-to-end as Feature Lead: scope the problem, coordinate work within your team, make day-to-day technical decisions, and ship it to production.

  • Deliver high quality features both individually and with other team members, working full-stack across whatever the stream requires.

  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to design and develop features that deliver real-world value.

  • Contribute to technical decision-making within your stream, including surfacing tradeoffs and risks early.

  • Participate in creating a psychologically safe and happy environment within the team and the company.

  • The role is remote in the Netherlands or in Berlin, but you commit to travelling to the office (The Hague or Berlin) twice per week.

What you will need

  • 5+ years of development experience, including meaningful full-stack exposure. You are comfortable working across backend and frontend layers and you pick up new technologies independently.

  • Experience with strongly typed languages (i.e., Typescript, Java, dotnet, PHP). We operate in Go and React, and we back ourselves to get a seasoned engineer with strongly typed experience up to speed in our tech stack quickly.

  • Comfortable using AI coding tools as part of your daily development workflow, and curious about how AI can improve how we build.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and understanding of secure development principles to building safe, trusted systems

  • Fluency in English is a must.

What we offer

  • Work on genuinely hard problems in a complex domain: XDR, security data at scale, and tooling that empowers security analysts to protect hundreds of customers across Europe.

  • Real ownership in a small, autonomous team where every engineer is close to the work, close to the decision-making, and close to the impact.

  • A deliberate bet on AI-augmented engineering: we are building toward small teams that punch well above their weight through smart AI adoption, and you will be part of shaping how that works in practice.

  • Be at the forefront of innovation, shaping the future of our technology infrastructure.

  • Enjoy a competitive compensation package and comprehensive benefits.

  • Join a young and thriving scale-up which is on its way to becoming the category leader in Europe.

  • We are a great place to work, filled with people who enjoy working together.

We are a rapidly growing company and believe in investing in our people. If you're a highly motivated and results-oriented engineer with a passion for building secure, scalable technologies, we encourage you to apply!
