jobs.title: Research Assistant in Regenerative Medicine
jobs.description:
A position as a full-time research assistant is vacant in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. 

The position is limited to one year with the possibility of extension and/or continuing further as a PhD student, subject to funding and fulfilment of SDU's PhD admission requirements.

Job description

The position primarily consists of research within tissue regeneration, epithelial biology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with limited research-based teaching or supervision activities where relevant. The research assistant will join a translational research programme that aims to understand how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be therapeutically targeted to restore safe and durable mucosal healing.

The position will suit a highly motivated candidate with a strong interest in mucosal biology, epithelial regeneration, organoid models, immune-stromal-epithelial interactions, single-cell and spatial technologies, and clinically oriented biomedical research. The successful candidate will work at the interface of experimental biology, translational medicine and omics-based research.

Research environment

The research assistant will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Institute for Molecular Medicine and the Department of Clinical Research at SDU. The project benefits from close interactions among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop practical and analytical skills in experimental and translational biomedicine, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and prepare for a potential subsequent PhD project.

Research project

The project investigates how prior inflammation leaves a lasting memory in the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how this memory affects mucosal healing in IBD. The research assistant will help establish and apply experimental models based on patient-derived intestinal biopsies, organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures to study epithelial regeneration in health and disease.

The work will also support the generation and functional validation of findings from single-cell and spatial approaches, including single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell chromatin accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. Depending on experience and project needs, the research assistant may contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering of patient-derived organoids.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish, maintain and experimentally manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and relevant co-culture systems involving fibroblasts and immune cells.

  • Design and perform functional assays to assess epithelial regeneration, inflammatory responses, barrier function and cell-state plasticity.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods such as qPCR, immunostaining, microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA-based assays and related techniques.

  • Support sample preparation and experimental workflows for single-cell and spatial transcriptomic or epigenomic studies.

  • Contribute to CRISPR-based genetic engineering and functional validation of candidate pathways, depending on prior experience.

  • Work with patient-derived material in close collaboration with clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers.

  • Maintain accurate experimental records, analyse and document results, and contribute to protocol development and optimisation.

  • Present results at group meetings and contribute to scientific reports, manuscripts, conferences, teaching and collaborative activities where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications 

The applicant is expected to hold a relevant master's degree or equivalent qualification in molecular biology, biomedicine, immunology, cell biology, biotechnology, medicine, bioinformatics or a closely related discipline.

Essential qualifications

  • A strong interest in mucosal biology, tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, inflammatory disease and translational biomedical research.

  • Hands-on experience with mammalian cell culture, molecular biology, primary cells, organoids, immunology, epithelial biology, inflammation research or related experimental systems.

  • Strong written and spoken English communication skills.

  • A structured, curious and technically careful working style, with the ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team.

  • Good organisational skills and a commitment to reproducible research, careful documentation and responsible handling of research data and biological material.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, immune-cell culture, fibroblast culture or epithelial-stromal-immune co-culture models.

  • Familiarity with qPCR, immunostaining, confocal or advanced microscopy, flow cytometry, ELISA or MSD assays, and CRISPR-based genetic engineering.

  • Experience with, or a strong interest in learning, single-cell RNA sequencing, ATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomics, spatial epigenomics or computational analysis of omics datasets.

  • Interest in developing and optimising experimental models that connect mechanistic biology with clinically relevant questions in IBD and mucosal healing.

  • Previous experience with bioinformatics, statistics or image analysis will be considered an advantage but is not essential.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information please contact 

Srustidhar Das
Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine
University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
Tel.: +45 71504339
E-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

September 15, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET/CEST).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). 

The position as research assistant is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed research assistant allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated. 

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.   

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of master’s degree)

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment. 

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. 

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

jobs.title: Digital Product Designer - Design System
jobs.employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz GBC AB
jobs.description:
Job Description

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Digital Product Designer in the Design System team, you’ll play a key role in evolving and scaling H&M’s customer-facing design system across app and web. You will help create a cohesive visual language that strengthens H&M brand expression while enabling product teams to deliver high-quality experiences efficiently and consistently.

This is a role for someone with exceptional UI craft and strong systems thinking. You understand that great design systems are more than components and documentation — they are the foundation that brings coherence, quality and brand differentiation across every digital touchpoint.

You’ll work at the intersection of brand, design and technology, translating design principles and brand identity into scalable foundations, tokens, components and guidelines that work seamlessly across iOS, Android and web. You have a sharp eye for visual detail, understand what elevates a digital experience and can balance aesthetic excellence with platform-specific best practices.

You will:

    Drive the evolution of H&M’s design system foundations, visual language and component library across app and web.
    Translate brand identity into scalable design foundations, guidelines and reusable patterns.
    Create alignment and visual coherence across iOS, Android and web while respecting platform-specific conventions.
    Define and refine design tokens, typography systems, spacing systems, colour systems and interaction principles.
    Partner closely with designers, engineers and product teams to ensure consistent implementation and adoption.
    Provide guidance and direction on visual quality, UI patterns and brand alignment across product teams.
    Champion accessibility best practices and ensure inclusive design is embedded into system foundations.
    Facilitate design reviews, workshops and discussions that drive alignment across a large product organisation.
    Stay up to date with emerging design, fashion, digital and consumer experience trends and identify opportunities to evolve the design system.
    Contribute to design system governance, documentation and community engagement across the organisation.

The role is based in Stockholm, with an expectation of being onsite at least 4 days per week.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will join the Digital Product Design organisation at H&M and become part of the Fabric Design System Product team.  

You’ll work closely with experience designers, design leads, engineers and product teams across app and web. You will collaborate with colleagues in Design, Product, Engineering and Brand to ensure H&M delivers a consistent, high-quality customer experience across all digital touchpoints.

You will also act as a trusted expert and partner to the wider design community, helping teams make informed decisions about visual design, interaction patterns and brand expression.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with:

    Extensive experience designing and evolving design systems for large-scale digital products.
    Exceptional UI and visual design skills with a strong portfolio demonstrating attention to detail and design craft.
    Deep understanding of cross-platform design across iOS, Android and web and their native patterns.
    Strong experience translating brand principles and visual identities into scalable digital systems.
    Expertise in typography, colour, spacing, layout and visual hierarchy.
    Experience defining and implementing design tokens and system foundations.
    Strong understanding of accessibility and inclusive design practices, including WCAG guidelines.
    Experience collaborating closely with engineers and understanding the realities of implementation.
    Experience influencing and aligning multiple stakeholders across a matrix organisation.
    Proven experience working with Figma and modern design system tooling.

Extra consideration will be given to candidates who have:

    Experience working with premium consumer brands or fashion brands in e-commerce.
    Experience building and scaling design systems across both mobile and web platforms.
    Experience defining design principles, governance models or contribution frameworks.
    Experience working within large international product organisations.

And people who are:

    Passionate about visual quality and design excellence.
    Naturally curious about trends in fashion, digital design and consumer behaviour.
    Skilled at identifying the small details that elevate an experience from good to exceptional.
    Comfortable balancing creativity, brand expression and system scalability.
    Collaborative, generous and motivated by raising the quality of work around them.
    Confident providing design direction while building trust and alignment across teams.
    Energised by creating clarity and consistency in complex environments.
    Driven by customer value, craftsmanship and continuous improvement.

Additional Information

WHO WE ARE

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.

We are thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by a shared culture and strong values. Together, we aim to use our scale and knowledge to push the industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer:

    Global career and development opportunities
    A value‑driven culture where you are encouraged to be yourself
    Staff discount cards and benefits
    Wellness and wellbeing benefits
    Parental support
    Opportunities to experiment, grow, and create tangible impact in a large‑scale tech organization

Here, you are encouraged to be yourself, experiment, and grow — and as you flourish, so do we.

JOIN US

Our uniqueness comes from our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and the growth opportunities we create. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.

Take the next step in your career — the journey starts here.

jobs.title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

jobs.title: Head of Geospatial AI - Foundation Models and Geo-Intelligence Platform
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland,  in areas such as natural hazards, agriculture, and forestry.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss national centre for supercomputing (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, agricultural organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Head of Geospatial AI, you will spearhead the Geo-Intelligence Team and own the development and implementation of ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI, data and shared platform capabilities. With domain experts from academia and the tech industry, you will help define the technical strategy and architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic AI systems, geospatial tools, data pipelines and compute infrastructure.

You will work closely with Research Program Support teams (plus the external partners mentioned above). You will lead cross-functional and external experts and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define and implement ETH Swiss GeoLab’s geospatial AI and technical strategy
Based on broad inputs, establish the target architecture for multimodal foundation models, agentic systems, geospatial data pipelines, compute environments and the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform
Adopt or set technical standards, priorities, interfaces and development principles aligned with GeoLab strategy and mission requirements
Drive and lead the design, development, evaluation and operationalisation of multimodal geospatial foundation models and related agentic capabilities
Encourage, enable or direct prototyping, benchmarking, validation and integration activities
Ensure that technical work produces reliable, reusable and operationally relevant capabilities rather than isolated research demonstrators
Own and be empowered to adapt the technical roadmap and delivery of the shared Geo-Intelligence Platform, including data access, processing pipelines, model-training environments, deployment capabilities and integration with HPC and cloud infrastructure
Coordinate with CSCS, ETH units, innovation leaders and technology providers to ensure scalability, security, efficiency and maintainability
Work with the Natural Hazards, Agriculture, Forestry and future Mission Leads to translate mission requirements into technical capabilities and delivery plans
Assess feasibility, define technical milestones, allocate technical resources and resolve trade-offs between mission-specific development and reusable platform components
Redirect technical work when evidence, performance or mission priorities require it
Lead or support technical collaborations with ETH groups, research institutions, CSCS, hyperscalers, companies, start-ups and open-source communities
Structure joint development activities, evaluate external capabilities and mobilise partners where they can accelerate delivery or provide distinctive expertise
In summary, you have a track record of innovative thought-leadership and a track record in brining others along with you on a journey for which the goal may not be 100% clear at the beginning. You are a voracious learner and are able to translate ambitious scientific and operational needs into robust, scalable and reusable technical solutions.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, geo-informatics, engineering, remote sensing or a related field
Several years of experience leading technical AI/ML, geospatial data or large-scale software and platform development activities that includes interactions with user communities
Demonstrated experience defining technical architectures, guiding interdisciplinary teams and managing technical resources such as platform architectures and large-scale data processing and ML workflows
Strong expertise in machine learning and multimodal foundation models with a track record of learning and adaptability as the industry and technological tools change. This also involves experience with agentic AI, reasoning systems or related AI architectures.
Excellent understanding of geospatial AI, Earth observation and remote sensing
Experience with HPC, cloud infrastructure or distributed computing environments
Proven ability to build reliable, reusable and operational technical capabilities in a cost-effective and agile manner
Experience working with academic, infrastructure, technology or industry partners
Excellent written and spoken English; German or French is an asset
You bring strong technical judgement and the ability to set direction under uncertainty. You have an excitement for technology and a passion to use this technology to enable breakthrough research and to change lives through the results it produces. You are a fast learner and a strong listener who also has the courage to try things and pivot where expectations are not fulfilled. You are able to lead highly qualified specialists, resolve architectural trade-offs and translate mission needs into scalable technical solutions. You are structured, delivery-oriented and willing to challenge or redirect weak approaches where needed. You communicate effectively across scientific, engineering, management and industry environments and build trust while maintaining clear standards, accountability and focus on outcomes.

The great and rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national competence centre for Earth observation
A senior technical leadership role with high visibility and strategic relevance
The opportunity to develop geospatial AI capabilities with direct application to societal, environmental and economic challenges
The opportunity to build novel and useful AI, data and platform capabilities for multiple mission areas
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Agriculture Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position.
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, at felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

We would like to point out that the pre-selection is carried out by the responsible recruiters and not by artificial intelligence.

You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organization. About us  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. Since conducting its first experiment on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission, the division has participated in numerous missions led by major space agencies such as ESA, NASA, and JAXA.  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. This is an exciting opportunity to contribute directly to the engineering, testing, and scientific support of one of Europe's premier planetary science missions.

The successful candidate will play a central role in supporting the development, testing, and operation of NIM, including:  
Planning and conducting calibrations and tests of the instrument under various operational conditionsLeading the diagnosis, troubleshooting, and repair of hardware and system issuesCharacterizing and optimizing critical components and subsystemsParticipating in the development and validation of operation and software tools

Opportunities to grow technical and scientific expertise in a cutting\-edge laboratory  
Highly interdisciplinary work environment (including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, and software engineering)

The position is initially for one year with the possibility of extension.

jobs.title: Gasoline Blending Operator #R-018360#
jobs.employer: TRAFIGURA PTE LTD, Singapour,succursale de Genève
jobs.description:
Main purpose
Responsible for execution of Gasoline Blending operations and trader support. The role co-ordinates all aspects of post-deal trading activity to ensure contract execution runs efficiently, provides commercial and market information to the trader as necessary, and reviews and comments on contracts and tenders to ensure consistency with the trade ticket and recap.

Key responsibilities
For all Gasoline blended cargoes, be the key point of contact between the commercial desk and external stakeholders.
Liaise with terminals and vessels to ensure commercial blending plans are followed in line with the traders’ expectations.
Ensure with inspection companies that quality is as per blend plans and in line with contractual provisions.
Investigate Quantity losses and explore remedial action.
Trouble shoot when plans change and provide solutions.
Actively manage the terminals line up to mitigate demurrage.
Review stowage plans and monitor vessel progress during voyages.
Appoint third-party providers in line with group policy; oversee clean acceptance of vessels on subjects and chartering progress.
Liaise and co-ordinate with Finance, providing accurate and timely data needed for the issuance of L/Cs and P/Us.
Issue documentary instructions to suppliers and handle all aspects of customs exportation/importation where applicable.
Maintain good contract and shipping files electronically; keep Pluto updated regularly and minimise exceptions.
Complete voyage and storage reconciliations to identify and investigate loss/gain differences for each operation.
Monitor and advise the deals desk of all costs related to each transaction, maintaining P&L awareness.
Ensure operations are optimised to best commercial advantage, meeting all contractual obligations (e.g. minimising demurrage exposure).
Maximise recoveries; document, present and secure payment of all claims to third parties.
Maintain strong working relationships with trade support divisions — claims, deals desk, trade finance and chartering — and with counterparts and third-party service providers.
Train and develop less experienced members of the operations team to increase knowledge and commercial awareness.
Follow internal procedures and company policies; adhere to Trafigura's Code of Conduct, HSEC Policy and Business Principles.
Identify operational issues and escalate to the Regional Manager as appropriate.

Required qualifications
At least 5 years' experience in cargo operations in a global oil trading company.
Experience working on Gasoline cargo operations with a preference for experience with blending operations.
Ability to interpret the operational requirements of contracts and comment on operational aspects; understanding of the basic legal framework supporting oil contracts.
Ability to interpret charter party terms against the interacting oil contract; good understanding of common ship operations and terminology.
Good understanding of relevant petroleum product specifications, analytical methods, laboratory precision and inspection procedures.
Good understanding of different types of financial instruments, their uses, and the importance of LOIs and shipping documents within the trading process.

Preferred qualifications
Experience across multiple product desks (Gasoline, Distillates and Fuel Oil).
Familiarity with Pluto or similar trade operations management systems.
Exposure to storage logistics and reconciliation processes.

Attributes for success
Strong decision-making ability — comfortable navigating ambiguity and complexity in a fast-moving trading environment.
Effective networker who builds and maintains relationships with counterparts, service providers and internal stakeholders.
Organised and detail-oriented, with strong planning and prioritisation skills.
Resourceful and commercially aware, with a proactive approach to problem-solving.

Department overview
The Oil Cargo Operations department is responsible for the efficient and effective management of the physical movement of oil and petroleum products. The team ensures commodities are transported from origin to destination, meeting all contractual obligations and regulatory requirements. The department works closely with Traders, Finance, Deals Desk (Risk and P&L) and Chartering to support the full trade lifecycle.

Pflegewegweiser Shop is a startup within this scale\-up. We're building an e\-commerce business from the ground up. That means: no legacy accounts to inherit, no 40\-page media plans, and no waiting three quarters for your test to go live. You launch it, you own it, you read and interpret the numbers, and you act accordingly.  
What you'll own  
The paid engine. You own Google Search, Shopping, and PMax end\-to\-end — from campaigns to assets to budget. You run the Merchant Center and the shopping feed like they're yours — because they are: clean data, healthy diagnostics, well\-maintained feeds.  
Meta \& creatives. You plan, launch, and optimize our Meta campaigns. You drive the creatives that feed them — static and video — from in\-house production to briefing and directing agencies. You know a winning ad isn't luck, it's a testing pipeline.  
Funnels. You build marketing funnels across the entire customer journey and continuously optimize them — from first click to repeat purchase.  
Growth sprints. You design experiments that open up new growth opportunities beyond day\-to\-day optimization. You find the growth opportunities we haven't identified or tapped yet.  
New bets. You develop new business models together with the Head of E\-Commerce, stress\-test them, and make them better — expanding what the shop can be.  
The setup. You question existing setups and processes, iterate on them, and make them better. If something is slow, manual, or "just grew that way," you challenge it.  
The shop. You help improve the shop experience, drive e\-commerce sales, and elevate the customer experience — your insights and improvement suggestions can be implemented quickly and directly to give our customers a better experience.  
The numbers. You analyze marketing and sales KPIs to find growth opportunities and efficiencies. Your analysis doesn't just go into a report — it directly influences our spending and budget allocations.  
What you bring  
2–5 years of marketing experience, preferably at a startup, scale\-up, or agency  
Hands\-on experience with paid campaigns on Google Ads and Meta — you've set up and optimized campaigns yourself, not just watched a dashboard  
A data\-driven understanding of marketing and e\-commerce KPIs — comfortable with reporting and able to move quickly from raw data to an actionable recommendation  
Ownership from day one — you'd rather build the process than wait for one  
Comfort with ambiguity and a healthy balance between speed and quality  
German and English \- both C1\+  
Nice to have  
Experience with Google Merchant Center and shopping feeds  
Familiarity with Shopify or a comparable e\-commerce platform  
Basic creative skills (Canva, CapCut, Figma, video production) and experience briefing creative agencies  
Knowledge of A/B testing, CRO, and funnel analytics  
An affinity for healthcare/homecare — or the curiosity to dive deep  
Why this role  
0 to 1, for real. You build the growth engine instead of waiting for someone else to.  
Direct line to leadership. You report to the Senior Growth Manager and work closely with the Chief Business Development Officer. Short paths, fast decisions, no bureaucracy. You learn fast, get direct feedback, and quickly gain ownership of your own topics and areas of responsibility.  
Impact you can see. Small, independent team; your tests land in the business immediately.  
Scale at your back. The pace and autonomy of a startup, backed by the resources of an international group — in one of the biggest growth markets there is: homecare and digital health.  
How we operate — non\-negotiable:  
"Insanely great" for families — delivered now  
Forget mere "satisfaction." We deliver support that makes caregivers feel seen, understood, and valued. Anticipate their needs and solve problems quickly. The standard is "insanely great," period. Anything less slows us down and fails our families.  
Speed is king — ruthless focus is key  
Velocity comes from focus. Eliminate distractions. Concentrate all effort on the \#1 critical objective until it's done, then move to the next. Decide what not to do and cut it ruthlessly. Being a mile wide and an inch deep is failure — move the needle now.  
Raise the bar — crush mediocrity  
Mediocrity kills speed, morale, and companies. Hunt it down and eliminate it. Good enough is never good enough. Demand top performance from yourself and everyone around you. Own your work, deliver excellence fast, and accept no excuses.  
The speed algorithm — question, delete, simplify, accelerate  
Build momentum by questioning every requirement: who asked, and why? Delete ruthlessly — parts, processes, bureaucracy. Simplify what remains. Accelerate cycle times relentlessly. "It can't be done" means "you haven't figured it out yet — go do it." Break bottlenecks, find shortcuts, remove friction.  
Act like owners — bold bets, fast action  
This is your company. Own the mission and the results. Take initiative, make bold bets that leapfrog progress, and act decisively. If you stumble, learn faster and go again. Bias for action is everything.  
The bottom line:  
We are building something vital at lightning speed. This requires intensity, focus, and a relentless drive to execute. If reading this makes you want to jump in and build faster, welcome to Pflegewegweiser!

jobs.title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Langzeitpflege 80-100% für die Region Moutier gesucht
jobs.description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Moutier suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Langzeitpflege.

### Kurz zusammengefasst: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Moutier

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Langzeitpflege

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Moutier

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Moutier liegt im Berner Jura und besticht durch seine malerische Lage zwischen Natur und Infrastruktur. Die ausgezeichnete Verkehrsanbindung mit direkten Bahnverbindungen nach Biel und Basel macht pendeln problemlos möglich. Als Arbeitsort bietet die Region Sie mit einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt, günstigen Mieten und hoher Lebensqualität an, während Sie gleichzeitig die Nähe zu Grünflächen und kulturellen Angeboten geniessen.

### Ihr Aufgabengebiet als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Moutier

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das setzen wir für diese Stelle voraus

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Moutier verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). jobs.title: Market Manager - Go-to-Market
jobs.description:
Sector Manager - Go-to-Market

Purpose of the job

Define and execute the ADV go-to-market strategy by managing a high-performing global channel partner network to drive growth, increase market share, enhance sales efficiency, and expand market coverage.

Key Objectives / KPIs:

  *  Channel partner Sales growth and Contribution Margin
  *  New generated opportunities and face-2-face customer visits by ADV Account Managers
  *  Revenue by Field Sales headcount
  *  Growth rate by customer classification
  *  Reduction of transactional tasks


Responsibilities:

Channel Partner Network:

  *  Leads the negotiation, review, and amendment of distribution agreements, ensuring ongoing compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and internal legal policies.
  *  Defines the framework for negotiating trade agreements and discount rates led by the regional Sales Channel Manager.
  *  Monitors regular business reviews and opportunity meetings led by the Regional Sales Channel Manager.


Global Channel Partner:

  *  Build and maintain strategic relationships with global channel partners at the senior executive level and organize regular face-to-face strategic meetings and workshops.
  *  Define and drive the strategic partnership roadmap.
  *  Shape and optimize the product portfolio and product branding.


Local Channel Partner and Representatives:

  *  Establish and maintain management-level relationships with local channel partners and representatives.
  *  Define and optimize the product portfolio.
  *  Develops and continuously optimizes performance-based rating systems as the foundation for sales conditions and services provided by VAT.
  *  Monitor channel partner performance and, together with local Channel Partner and ADV Sales Leaders, decide on onboarding new channel partner or phasing out underperforming channel partner.
  *  Supports Regional Sales Channel Managers with standardized analysis tools and templates to monitor channel partner performance and conduct business reviews efficiently.
  *  Support the regional Sales Channel Manager in organizing channel partner meetings.


Digital Sales Channels

  *  Develop the ADV digital customer journey in close collaboration with the data architects to automatize transactional tasks and enhance productivity.
  *  Support channel partners with digital tools and services.
  *  Establish digital customer services in collaboration with other Business Units.


Go-to-Market Strategy:

  *  Develop and execute the annual update of the Go-to-Market Strategy.
  *  Align and reinforce market reach strategy with ADV Sales Leaders and BU Management Team.
  *  Conduct regular reviews with ADV Sales Leaders to monitor progress and implement corrective actions where necessary.


Pricing Strategy:

  *  Support the ADV PM Pricing Team in pricing initiatives and implementation.
  *  Lead sales communication for the annual price adjustment.


Qualifications:

  *  Bachelor's degree in sciences, engineering or economy.
  *  Master in Business Administration.
  *  Fluent business English skills written and spoken.
  *  4+ years working experience in B2B Sales, Account Management or Channel Management.
  *  Vacuum market experience preferred.
  *  Solid experience in managing international projects.
  *  Strong entrepreneurial mindset combined with strategic clarity to identify and capture growth opportunities.
  *  Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives at global scale, spanning processes and systems.
  *  Executive-level communication skills, with the ability to influence customers, partners, and senior stakeholders.
  *  High level of ownership: self-driven, decisive, and accountable for outcomes.
  *  International mindset with strong cultural agility and a track record of building trust across regions.

jobs.title: Directeur Adjoint de Village (H/F)
jobs.description:
Villages clubs du soleil acteur majeur du tourisme social et familial, certifié ISO 9001, expert dans l'accueil de familles en formule " tout compris " en France et entreprise à taille humaine avec des valeurs solides, recherchent pour la prochaine saison d'hiver 2027, un directeur Adjoint de village F/H pour son Village Club du Soleil Arc 1800 et sur d'autres magnifiques sites à la Montagne. Rattaché(e) au Directeur du village F/H, il/elle veille à la réalisation du produit, en optimisant les moyens humains et organisationnels, dans le respect des budgets et des exigences réglementaires.

Véritable relais du directeur F/H et en interaction permanente avec les chefs de service, il/elle doit :

Manager, animer et coordonner l'ensemble des services, et plus particulièrement la restauration
Participer au recrutement et gérer les ressources humaines du village dans le respect des engagements de l'entreprise
Assurer une relation client de qualité et anticiper leurs attentes
Veiller à la réalisation du produit et à la bonne application de la démarche qualité

En qualité de manager, vous êtes un véritable vecteur de la culture d'entreprise dans un esprit basé sur des valeurs de Respect,  Solidarité et Excellence qui favorisent l'engagement et le développement humain de tous nos collaborateurs.

Vous avez :

Issu(e) d'une formation supérieure en hôtellerie ou en management, vous parlez couramment le langage de la gestion et du service. Le terrain est votre seconde nature : Fort(e) d'une expérience de 3 ans minimum, vous excellez dans le management d'équipe et le pilotage d'un centre de profit. Le petit plus qui fera la différence ? Une expertise éprouvée dans l'univers du tourisme ou de la restauration.

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Ruovesi
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

Applied AI Engineer – Consulting Manager


At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.
We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.​
Join EY and help to build a better working world.



The opportunity

You will work across a diverse portfolio of clients spanning Financial Services, the Public Sector, and the Private Sector. Our Applied AI Engineering teams deliver production-grade AI systems in regulated financial institutions as well as government, health, infrastructure, consumer, industrial and energy organizations. This cross-sector model gives you broad exposure to different regulatory environments, data landscapes and operating models, while building deep engineering capability that transfers across industries.


Role purpose

Operate as a hands‑on engineer within a squad, taking ownership of defined components and delivering AI capabilities (e.g., agents, RAG pipelines) that meet enterprise standards for reliability, security and observability. Strengthen your foundations through the Applied AI Engineering Academy while taking on more responsibility for solution shaping and stakeholder engagement.


Your key responsibilities

Client‑facing engineering & delivery

Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders; translate requirements into engineering tasks; support workshops, demos and solution reviews; drive adoption through testing and iteration.
Solution design & implementation

Design and implement RAG pipelines, agents, microservices and integrations; apply monitoring, evaluation and Responsible AI guardrails.
Product mindset & continuous improvement

Shape MVP scope, backlog and release planning; capture reusable patterns and contribute to shared accelerators.


What we're looking for

jobs.description:
AIFM Risk Management, Manager

Department: Funds

Company Description

ABOUT IQ-EQ

We're a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 5,800+ people across 25 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$750 billion. We work with 13 of the world's top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.      
                                                                              
Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We're driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

As a Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and enhancing the risk management framework for alternative investment funds managed by the AIFM. You will support the Head of Risk Management in leading the risk management team, ensuring robust risk governance, and acting as a key point of contact for senior management, clients, and governing bodies on risk management matters. You will be responsible for the effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of all material risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the firm's risk appetite.

You will:

• Serve as the back-up for the Head of Risk Management, taking over key responsibilities when needed and ensuring continuity of leadership.
• Support the Head of Risk Management in daily team management, including coordination, task allocation, and staff development.
• Support the implementation, maintenance, and regular update of the Risk Management Procedure (RMP), policies, procedures, registers, and framework.
• Assist in identifying applicable risk types, proposing measurement methodologies and limits.
• Support the development, monitoring, and updating of risk profiles for all AIFs under management, ensuring alignment with investment strategies and regulatory standards.
• Assist the team in performing pre-trade investment compliance controls.
• Monitor and regularly review the adequacy of risk indicators.
• Prepare and review quarterly risk management reports for the AIFs. Report material risk issues, breaches, and emerging risks to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies, and ensure appropriate remediation actions are taken.
• Collaborate with the onboarding team to assess risks of new products and projects, ensuring business growth aligns with the firm's risk appetite.
• Contribute to the preparation of annual CSSF Risk Management reports and Annex IV (AIFMD) reporting.
• Advise internal and external stakeholders on complex risk management matters and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds.
• Lead the analysis of new regulations and assess their impact on risk management activities for both funds and the company.

What we offer

• Comprehensive remuneration and pension: motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
• Wellbeing: additional social benefits
• Flexible working: we recognise the value of working flexibly and want to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements.

Qualifications

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in risk management within the asset management or fund industry
• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg AIFM regulatory environment, including SFDR, and alternative investment strategies.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an asset.
• In-depth knowledge of Annex IV Reporting is highly desirable.
• Advanced IT skills (e.g., VBA, SQL, Python) are a plus.

Additional information

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.  

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to oury people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,800+ employees - from 94 nationalities, acrosfyts 25 countries - to each achieve their potential.  
Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We're committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

jobs.description:
Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: SigCom
Job Number: UOL08391

Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Job Level: level 1
Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Researcher
Expertise: Researcher / Postdoctorant
Job (internal): Research scientist


About the SnT
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.
The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Signal Processing and Communications Research Group (SIGCOM) under the supervision of Prof. Symeon Chatzinotas at the University of Luxembourg.
Ever-evolving intelligent connectivity systems require increasingly efficient systems to transmit, analyze, and reconstruct high-quality data. The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. Fields of applications range from 6G telecommunications to satellite-based internet connectivity and quantum internet. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. Prospective researchers will find a large and vibrant team of over 100 members fostering a collaborative atmosphere. The group consistently publishes in top 10% venues, approaching 200 papers per year, supported by 60 running research projects.

Your role
• Conduct research and technology transfer in the area of advanced and intelligent wireless communications networks, with emphasis in the next-generation 6G cellular networks and non-terrestrial components
• Have the potential to build/lead a research team within the SIGCOM Research Group at SnT
• SIGCOM conducts research in close collaboration with the industry/government partners and is engaged in a number of European/International projects. The candidate will contribute to the definition, acquisition, and management of research projects together with other faculty or as a principal investigator
• Supervise PhD students in relevant topics with other faculty or as principal supervisor
• Ensure continuity in the laboratory/experimental research activities, international visibility and recruitment efforts
• Design and deliver Bachelor and Master level classes in computer science, wireless communications and/or optical-quantum communications, in the Bachelor in Engineering, or at the Masters belonging to FSTM Faculté des Sciences, des Technologies et de Médecine

The candidate detailed mission is to:
• Acquire, manage and contribute to research, innovations, and technology transfer activities with private and public partners
• Disseminate scientific results in top 10% conferences/journals
• Independently supervise PhD candidates and junior research associates
• Prepare and contribute to European and National research proposals to sustain the group's strategic research

Your profile
• PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or other relevant field
• At least 4 years of PostDoc research experience in relevant research area(s). Documented research expertise in:
o next-generation wireless communications and networking paradigms, non-terrestrial communications, quantum and optical communications, edge computing, telecom artificial intelligence, multi-functional systems (communications, sensing, positioning, computing), antenna and beamforming design and practical validation of technologies in Lab environment
• Proven track record in carrying a leading role in research project acquisition and project management
• Experience in research collaboration with industrial and international partners
• Experience in supporting PhD candidates in their research

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must demonstrate an excellent command of English (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn French or German and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective

jobs.title: Business Manager - Finance (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee.

More than a traditional business support role, this position acts as a strategic advisor and internal consultant to the CFO. You will tackle complex business challenges, drive transformation initiatives, support executive decision-making, and work across the organization to deliver strategic outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for a former consultant or strategy professional seeking direct exposure to executive leadership and the ability to influence the direction of a leading financial institution.


Your next challenge:


1. Strategy Advisory & Information Management

Act as a trusted sparring partner to the CFO on strategic, organizational and business topics.
Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.


2. Operational Support & Execution

Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.


3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.


4. Project Leadership

Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.
Act as an internal consultant on key business priorities, including organisational transformation, operating model improvements and strategic initiatives.


Your skills:

Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
Minimum 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, with a strong preference for candidates having gained experience in a top-tier consulting firm or a comparable strategic advisory, transformation or Chief of Staff environment.
Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
Solid understanding of finance.
Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats. This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

About the SnT:

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.

We offer an attractive position for a full stack software engineer to work in close cooperation with our research teams, particularly within the Computer Vision, Machine Intelligence and Imaging (CVI2) research group headed by Prof. Djamila Aouada. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and real-world software engineering, turning complex research outcomes into impactful applications.

Your role:

This is a Full Stack Engineer role with a rich and varied technology stack. You will work across the full application layer, from building interactive browser-based 3D interfaces to designing robust backend services and APIs, while integrating AI capabilities through modern LLM frameworks and SDKs. The role sits at the intersection of applied AI engineering and real-time 3D visualization, leveraging technologies such as Three.js, WebGL, and LLM orchestration frameworks to build intelligent, geometry-aware applications. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to contribute meaningfully to applied AI research while working with a modern, diverse set of technologies at the forefront of the field.

• Build browser-based 3D visualization experiences using libraries such as Three.js and WebGL to render and interact with complex geometric data

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
• Experience with Three.js and WebGL, including scene management, geometry interaction, camera controls, and rendering optimization for complex 3D models
• Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, e.g. Lang Chain, LlamaIndex, and LLM APIs, e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, including context engineering and API integration for building production-grade AI-powered features
• Experience with Python and at least one server-side web framework such as Flask or FastAPI, including building and maintaining REST APIs

The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.
