jobs.title: Requirements Engineer
jobs.description:
_Basemark | Automotive Software Projects_

_About the Role: Basemark is looking for a_**_Requirements Engineer_** _to join our automotive software engineering team. In this role, you will work within a customer-facing automotive project delivering advanced software solutions for a leading automotive manufacturer. You will play a key part in ensuring that customer and system requirements are accurately captured, structured, and maintained throughout the development lifecycle, in full compliance with ASPICE processes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical detail and cross-functional communication, working closely with automotive OEM stakeholders and internal engineering teams. What You'll Do:_

- _Gather, analyze, structure, and maintain functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR (Augmented Reality) projects._

- _Establish and maintain bi-directional traceability between customer requirements (SYS.2) and software requirements (SWE.1)._

- _Manage change requests, including impact analysis, throughout the requirements lifecycle._

- _Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10), supporting process assessments and audit readiness._

- _Act as a key point of contact with automotive OEM representatives to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into actionable engineering requirements._

- _Facilitate requirement reviews between engineering teams, ensuring alignment and clarity across disciplines._

- _Support problem resolution processes related to requirements and specifications._


_What We're Looking For_

- **_At least 5 years of hands-on experience_** _with ASPICE Software Engineering processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10)._

- _Solid knowledge of process assessments, audit readiness, and traceability compliance, as well as problem resolution and change request management._

- _Proven track record in gathering, analyzing, structuring, and maintaining functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR projects._

- _Proven experience establishing bi-directional traceability (Customer Requirements SYS.2 Software Requirements SWE.1) and managing change requests with impact analysis._

- _Proficiency with industry-standard tools for requirements lifecycle management (IBM DOORS, CodeBeamer, PTC Integrity, Jira, Confluence)._

- _Direct experience interacting with automotive OEMs to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into engineering requirements._

- _Experience facilitating requirement reviews between engineering teams._

- _Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives._

- _Fluent English; additional languages are a plus._


_Location & Compensation_

- **_Location:_** _Helsinki, Finland. The role is primarily based at our office, with on-site presence expected for most of the work week._

- **_Salary:_** **_EUR 33,500 - 33,700 per year_**_._


_Why Basemark? Basemark offers you the chance to work on cutting-edge automotive technology in a collaborative, international environment. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement — with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on projects used by major automotive manufacturers._

jobs.title: Car Registration Specialist
jobs.description:
Car Registration Specialist

Location: Stockholm

About the us

Green SM is a leading electric vehicle (EV) and sustainable mobility solutions provider headquartered in Vietnam. With a commitment to transforming urban transportation, we have successfully expanded into the Global Market and are now preparing to launch operations in the EU Market. Join us in driving the future of sustainable mobility.



Website: Green SM - Electric Mobility Service, 5-Star Quality | Green SM



Position Overview

The Car Registration Specialist is responsible for supporting the end-to-end vehicle registration process to ensure GSM Europe’s EV fleet is legally ready for operation in the local market. This role will coordinate documentation, registration applications, insurance confirmation, license plates, and related administrative procedures to ensure vehicles are ready for deployment on time.

Key Responsibilities

    Support vehicle registration processes for GSM Denmark EV fleet across assigned markets
    Prepare and manage registration documents including CoC, vehicle titles, customs, insurance, and compliance paperwork
    Coordinate with transport authorities, registration offices, and external agencies to ensure legal compliance
    Monitor local EV regulations, registration requirements, tax incentives, and subsidy policies
    Execute and track bulk vehicle registrations to support operational launch timelines
    Follow vehicle status from delivery through license plate issuance and road readiness
    Coordinate with insurance providers and external partners to resolve registration issues and documentation gaps

    Collaborate closely with Logistics, Fleet Operations, Insurance, and local teams to ensure timely “Ready-to-Drive” vehicle deployment



Requirements

    Familiarity with electric vehicles, vehicle imports, or EV-related documentation is an advantage.
    Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple documents and cases at the same time.
    Good coordination skills with authorities, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Why Join GSM

    Backed by Vietnam's largest company, with the growth trajectory of a fast-scaling European startup
    Real decision-making authority with tangible, visible impact
    Learn alongside counterparts across other markets
    Help build the future of green transport in Europe

jobs.title: Site Engineer
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard elements will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark. To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations. At the same time, an outfitting team from another department is outfitting the element with more permanent additions. It is up to the Site engineer to assist the production team and to document and verify the activities that are executed. There will be interface with several Supervisors, work preparation of the outfitting and subcontractors.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

▪ Prepare work method statements (WMS) and work procedures (WPR).

▪ Adjust the WMS and WPR where needed to optimize the procedure of installation.

▪ Ensures that schedules and planning are optimized in coordination with all departments, both within and outside FLC.

▪ Takes an active part in the structural meetings.

▪ Ensures clear communication, including minutes of meeting, to all parties involved.

▪ Is supportive of Commissioning Engineers and TE Systems execution teams by providing planning, documentation and the necessary equipment.

▪ Ensures a safe working environment through toolbox meetings, pre-start meetings, safety walks and by addressing issues directly.

▪ Document executed activities in the tools provided by FLC.

▪ Verify and validate contract requirements.

Qualifications:

▪ Has experience working with drawing applications.

▪ Has experience working with Office 360.

▪ Has experience in work preparation.

▪ Has good organizational skills.

▪ Enjoys coordinating with multiple parties involved.

▪ English, minimal B1

▪ Is willing to work in shifts and at irregular hours.

▪ Has a background as mechanical or electrical engineer.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Although working for the Marine team, this role is land-based in Rødbyhavn.

Application:

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible and. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

Contact:

For questions related to the position, please contact tri@flc-jv.com, lge@flc-jv.com

jobs.title: Positioning Specialist - Immersion Pontoon
jobs.description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challengeand the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

Conditions: 

FLC considers transparent management structures, short decision-making channels, and a team-oriented environment to be extremely important. The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company. 

FLC offers attractive employment conditions on a Danish contract according to The Danish Salaried Employees Act (Funktionærloven). Pension health insurance and lunch arrangement will be available. 

Workplace:

Rødby

We look forward to receiving your application (in English) as soon as possible. Applications received will be processed on an ongoing basis, and we will complete the recruitment once we have found the right profile.

jobs.title: Senior Drilling Supervisor til krævende onshore drilling opgave
jobs.description:
(Region Nordjylland)

Er du en erfaren Drilling Supervisor med stærk operationel forståelse, og har du mange års erfaring med drilling og completion? Vi søger en erfaren Drilling Supervisor til vores kunde i Region Nordjylland, hvor du vil spille en central rolle i den daglige ledelse og koordinering af boreaktiviteter på site.

Om stillingen

Som Drilling Supervisor vil du fungere som kundens repræsentant på site og have ansvar for sikker, effektiv og struktureret gennemførelse af drilling og completion aktiviteter. Du vil blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Drilling og completion: Overvågning og godkendelse af aktiviteter i henhold til det gældende drilling og completion program

  • Well control og barrierer: Verifikation af barrierer, well control krav og kritiske beregninger inden udførelse

  • Koordinering: Daglig koordinering med rig contractor, service companies, site ressourcer og øvrige interessenter

  • Sikkerhed og kvalitet: Sikring af korrekt gennemførelse af toolbox talks, permit to work processer og øvrige sikkerhedsaktiviteter

  • Rapportering og handover: Udarbejdelse af daglige drilling reports samt grundige overleveringer mellem skift

Du får en central operationel rolle med stor kontaktflade og betydeligt ansvar for sikkerhed, kvalitet, fremdrift og koordinering på site.

Din profil

Vi ser gerne, at du har følgende kvalifikationer:

  • Minimum 15 års erfaring fra oilfield eller drilling aktiviteter

  • Minimum 10 års erfaring som Drilling Supervisor, Client Representative eller tilsvarende

  • Gyldigt IWCF Well Control certifikat på supervisor niveau

  • Solid erfaring med drilling og completion samt kritiske well calculations

  • Erfaring med casing, drilling mud, cementing, logging og well control

  • Stærke kompetencer inden for operationel ledelse, risikostyring og emergency response

  • Erfaring med koordinering af contractors og service companies

  • Gode IT kompetencer og erfaring med drilling reporting

  • Gyldigt kørekort kategori B

  • Engelsk på professionelt niveau

Erfaring fra europæiske onshore projekter samt deep well, HT/HP eller geothermal drilling vil være en fordel.

Hvad vi tilbyder

  • En spændende stilling med stort operationelt ansvar

  • Mulighed for at arbejde på en krævende teknisk opgave

  • Et professionelt og dynamisk arbejdsmiljø

  • Attraktive vilkår efter kvalifikationer

Opstart: ASAP eller efter aftale

Vi ønsker stillingen besat hurtigst muligt, men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat. Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning i dag. Stillingen kan blive besat inden fristens udløb.

Kort om os: Hvem er Nordjysk Projektledelse?

Nordjysk Projektledelse er et specialiseret projektlederhus, der hjælper virksomheder med at styrke deres projektorganisation gennem erfarne og kompetente projektledere. Vi leverer fleksible løsninger inden for projekt og programledelse, både ved spidsbelastninger, strategiske projekter og midlertidige ressourcemangler.

Vi samarbejder med en bred vifte af virksomheder på tværs af brancher og har et stærkt netværk af dygtige projektledere, der sikrer, at vores kunder får den rette ekspertise til deres behov. Hos Nordjysk Projektledelse værdsætter vi faglighed, engagement og stærke relationer. Vi tror på, at succesfulde projekter ikke kun handler om struktur og styring, men også om mennesker, kommunikation og samarbejde.

Er du den rette kandidat?

Upload dit CV direkte via vores ATS system.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Julia Fitzhugh på +45 27 83 92 56.

jobs.title: Durability and Sensor Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a technically broad engineering role in an advanced automotive development environment, working closely with chassis systems and wheel suspension. The focus is on turning measured forces and simulation data into better durability decisions, from sensor design and calibration to CAE-based stress and strain analysis.

A large part of the role is about connecting theory with real-world testing. You will help ensure that strain gauge solutions and other sensor setups generate reliable data for model correlation and laboratory testing, while also supporting the long-term durability of components and systems. You will work cross-functionally with CAE engineers, design teams and test stakeholders, which gives you real influence on both technical direction and engineering quality. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy combining simulation, hardware and testing in work that directly shapes vehicle durability.

Job Description

    You will lead sensor design activities with a focus on strain gauge applications for vehicles and test rigs.
    You will drive the workflow from design input and test needs to sensor concept, placement strategy and final calibration.
    You will define load ranges, identify testing needs and perform strength simulations to support sensor design.
    You will design physical components and sensor solutions, using detailed stress and strain analysis to optimize strain gauge placement.
    You will plan and oversee calibration activities to secure accurate and reliable measurement data.
    You will perform stress and strain CAE simulations for chassis systems and components during the design phase.
    You will provide recommendations to improve durability in ongoing programs and design concepts.
    You will contribute to developing durability requirements, targets and technical guidelines together with the wider engineering organization.
    You will collaborate across CAE, CAD and physical testing to connect analytical work with practical validation.

Requirements

    MSc in Mechanical Engineering.
    Knowledge of Wheel Suspension design.
    Documented knowledge and a few years of experience from the durability domain.
    Experience of the CAE tools Ansa, Abaqus and nCode, as well as the CAD tool CATIA.
    Broad knowledge of the vehicle design process.
    Experience in writing requirements and technical guidelines.
    Ability to work across disciplines and balance theoretical modeling with hands-on testing and analysis.
    Fluent in English, written and spoken.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

jobs.description:
Wioniq Nordic is a pioneer in smart IoT solutions for the water, energy, and construction sectors. With our new brand identity and ambitious growth targets leading up to 2028, we are heading into an exciting future. Our innovative platform monitors and protects critical infrastructure worldwide, and we are now looking for you who want to be part of our journey and contribute to developing the next generation of solutions. Together with us, you will have the opportunity to help shape the smart and sustainable societies of the future.

About the role

You’ll take on a central role as a hands-on Fullstack Developer while also leading and coordinating a technical team of approximately 5–7 people. A significant part of your day will be spent developing alongside the team, building robust and scalable solutions and contributing to the continued evolution of our IoT platform.

Alongside your own development work, you’ll provide direction for the team by setting priorities, coordinating the day-to-day work and helping remove blockers. You’ll also collaborate closely with other teams and stakeholders across the organization, making sure technical priorities are aligned with customer needs and business goals. When requirements shift or the scope changes, you know how to reassess, prioritize and keep the work moving forward.

You’ll be involved throughout the entire journey, from concept to production, working with a modern tech stack including Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Vue3, Kubernetes and PostgreSQL. Here, leadership means staying close to both the technology and the people, creating clarity, communicating across teams and making sure everyone is moving in the same direction.

We’re looking for someone who..  …is an experienced developer who enjoys staying close to the technology while taking an active role in leading and supporting others.

You’re curious, hands-on and comfortable taking ownership, but you also have the ability to step back, see the bigger picture and understand where your focus will make the most difference.

You’re a strong communicator who can connect with different personalities, roles and stakeholders. You listen, ask the right questions and know how to turn complex discussions into clear decisions and next steps. When priorities compete or circumstances change, you stay calm, reassess what matters the most and create a clear path forward.

As a leader, you build trust through both your technical knowledge and the way you work with others. You enjoy supporting and challenging your colleagues, sharing knowledge and creating an environment where people can take ownership, collaborate and deliver great work together.

    

6+ years of experience in fullstack development, working with Go and/or TypeScript/Node.js and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue, React or Angular

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different personalities, roles and stakeholders

We believe in technology’s ability to simplify, improve, and transform, and that’s exactly what we do. Our ambition is to make the complex simple and give our customers full control, where every decision is based on smart insights. Through a powerful platform and intelligent devices, we ensure that our automated solutions meet customer needs at every stage, detecting deviations, minimizing operational disruptions, and providing decision support that saves money, resources, and contributes to a better environment. jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences)at Tampere University invites applications for a fixed-term Senior Research Fellow position in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature for a two-year period starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The position is open within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering (MePhiS), funded by the Research Council of Finland, and its research team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature. Among the five research teams of MePhiS, four are hosted by the Faculty of Theology at the University of Helsinki, while the team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature is hosted by the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University. The Centre offers a supportive and inspiring research environment and excellent opportunities for researchers to develop their careers in an international and interdisciplinary setting. More information about MePhiS is available at: www.helsinki.fi/mephis .

MePhiS engages in philosophical and interdisciplinary scholarship that places the concept of suffering at the centre of philosophical reflection and offers conceptual and argumentative tools for a deeper understanding of human engagement with affliction, starting from the meliorist (Lat. melior, better) idea that the world can and should be made better through active human efforts. According to meliorism, a positive outcome is neither guaranteed (optimism) nor impossible (pessimism).

The research group on Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature within MePhiS focuses on literary studies and the philosophy of literature as pathways to a meliorist philosophy of suffering. We take seriously the idea that literature can articulate philosophical questions and shape peoples ways of experiencing, expressing, and coping with suffering. The group critically examines writers and literary traditions associated with optimism, pessimism, and/or meliorism, and analyses literary works that reflect societal anxieties as well as human or non-human suffering arising from war, violence, poverty, marginalisation, the climate crisis, and related challenges. We also investigate how philosophers draw on literature in developing ethical responses to suffering.

Position

Towards these ends, we invite applications for a Senior Research Fellow with a background in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature with demonstrated interest in advancing research in these fields.

The Senior Research Fellow will be responsible for

- investigating representations of suffering and meliorism in literary and philosophical contexts;
- developing literary and philosophical analyses of ethical responses to suffering;
- authoring scholarly publications on the research topic;
- collaborating with other members of the Centre of Excellence, including through joint publications and other research activities; and
- contributing to teaching and administrative duties, amounting to approximately 5-10% of the working time.

Qualifications

We seek candidates with expertise in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature who are interested in advancing the research aims described above. Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in a relevant field within the humanities or social sciences (e.g., literary studies, philosophy) and have a demonstrated track record of high-quality research and international publications. A Senior Research Fellow typically has at least ca. five years of postdoctoral experience. In addition, applicants should possess the ability to lead a research group, a track record of securing external research funding, and the teaching skills required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position.

Familiarity with the topics of suffering, optimism, pessimism, or meliorism in literature and philosophy, as well as experience in combining literary studies with philosophical inquiry, will be considered an advantage.

The selected candidate should be capable of conducting independent research at a high international level and able to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of the research team. The working language of MePhiS is English, and excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Applicants should be prepared to provide proof of their qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated proposals.

The position is fixed-term for two years starting in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). The salary of a Senior Research Fellow is at levels 6-7. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. jobs.title: 1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history / 1-2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa kirjallisuustieteessä tai historiassa (The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities, VERSITAS project)
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

MYYJÄ, SALE HUHTINEN, 12 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää Sale Huhtiseen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Myyjän työtehtävissä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtäviä, mm. asiakaspalvelutyötä kassalla ja hyllytystä. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös myymälän siisteydestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä tuotteiden esillepano ja saatavuuden varmistaminen.

Me Sale Huhtisessa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin!

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä - myös juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta(10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
-5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtuntitulospalkkioonyrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 30.8.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa apulaistoimipaikkapäällikkö Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***

FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE HUKTIS, 12 H/VECKA, TILLSVIDAREANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Huktis för en tillsvidareanställning. Som försäljare får du arbeta mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter, bland annat kundservice i kassan och varuplock. I ditt dagliga arbete ingår också att se till att butiken är ren och trivsam samt att säkerställa produkternas exponering och tillgänglighet.

På Sale Huktis brukar vi säga att vi har ett helt vanligt jobb. Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng – tvärtom!

Vi önskar att du
- möter du kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- har en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- har förmåga att ta i bruk nya system
- har möjlighet att jobba i varierande arbetsskift – också under högtider.
Goda kunskaper i finska och kunskaper i svenska ses som en merit.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.
Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89 - 14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt men senast söndag 30.8.2026. Närmare information om uppgiften ger biträdande enhetschef Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Castle Quarry Crushing & Plant Hire Ltd are currently recruiting a Business Analyst to join their team at Brooklodge Demesne, Ballyglunin, Co. Galway. The salary ranges from €36,605 to €40,000 per Annum based on a 39-hour per week. Salary may be more based on experience and will increase proportionately if additional hours are required. Salary offered shall be based on relevant experience and qualifications. The Business Analyst will support the organisation by analysing operational and business data, preparing structured reports, and assisting management in decision-making. The role is analytical and supports operational planning, performance monitoring, and process improvement activities. Duties and Responsibilities • Analyse operational, inventory, and business data to support effective planning and resource management. • Monitor stock movement, material usage, and operational performance indicators. • Prepare regular internal reports for management on operational performance, efficiency, and cost control. • Support forecasting and planning activities using historical and current data. • Liaise with internal departments, including operations, logistics, procurement, and finance, to gather and document business requirements. • Maintain accurate records and data within internal business systems, including ERP and inventory management systems. • Identify inefficiencies and process gaps and assist in the development of improvement measures. • Support audits, compliance reviews, and internal controls by ensuring data accuracy and proper documentation. • Assist with the implementation and ongoing improvement of business systems and reporting processes. • Provide analytical support to management to assist in operational and business decision-making. Requirements Previous experience in a relevant business support role. Demonstrated ability to analyse data and prepare structured business reports. Experience using Microsoft Excel and internal business systems. Understanding of operational workflows and business processes. Strong organisational and communication skills. Ability to work independently in an analytical, office-based role.

jobs.title: Chargé(e) de Marketing & Communication (H/F)
jobs.description:
Mission freelance / prestation - Remote possible, présence ponctuelle à Barcelone souhaitée
Rejoignez le futur pôle d'ingénierie et développement du groupe AXOR
Dans le cadre de son développement, AXOR Ingénierie souhaite faire de Barcelone son futur pôle d'ingénierie, de coordination et de développement pour l'ensemble du groupe.
Déjà implanté sur plusieurs marchés, le groupe accompagne ses clients dans la conception, l'ingénierie, la fabrication et le déploiement de structures métalliques destinées aux bâtiments industriels, tertiaires et résidentiels.
Nous recherchons aujourd'hui un(e) Chargé(e) de Marketing & Communication capable d'accompagner la structuration de l'image du groupe et la création de supports commerciaux clairs, professionnels et directement exploitables.
Votre mission
En lien direct avec la Direction, vous participez à la mise en place et à l'amélioration des outils de communication d'AXOR Ingénierie.
Votre rôle sera de rendre les activités du groupe plus lisibles, plus professionnelles et mieux présentées auprès des clients, partenaires et équipes commerciales.
La mission porte principalement sur la création, la mise à jour et l'harmonisation des supports de communication et de présentation du groupe.
Vos principales responsabilités
Supports marketing et communication
- Créer, mettre à jour et harmoniser les plaquettes commerciales du groupe ;
- Préparer des supports de présentation clairs pour les rendez-vous clients, partenaires et commerciaux ;
- Structurer les documents de présentation des activités : structures métalliques, ingénierie, enveloppe du bâtiment, solutions constructives ;
- Participer à l'amélioration de l'image de marque et de la cohérence visuelle des supports ;
- Mettre à jour les contenus de communication existants : site internet, présentations, documents internes et commerciaux ;
- Coordonner si besoin les échanges avec les prestataires externes : graphistes, web, imprimeurs, traducteurs.
Appui au développement commercial
- Travailler avec la Direction et les équipes commerciales pour clarifier les messages, offres et argumentaires ;
- Produire des supports simples, professionnels et utilisables rapidement sur le terrain ;
- Participer à la valorisation des projets, références, partenaires et savoir-faire du groupe ;
- Proposer des améliorations concrètes pour renforcer la visibilité et la crédibilité d'AXOR Ingénierie ;
- Accompagner progressivement la communication autour des nouvelles activités du groupe.
Profil recherché
- Expérience en marketing, communication, création de supports commerciaux ou communication d'entreprise ;
- Très bonne capacité rédactionnelle et de synthèse ;
- Bonne maîtrise des outils de présentation et de mise en page ;
- Capacité à transformer des informations techniques en supports clairs et professionnels ;
- Profil autonome, structuré, rigoureux et orienté concret ;
- Sens de l'organisation, réactivité et capacité à travailler avec plusieurs interlocuteurs ;
- Une expérience dans un environnement industriel, BTP, ingénierie ou international serait appréciée.
Langues
- Français courant indispensable ;
- Espagnol professionnel apprécié ;
- Anglais apprécié.
Ce poste s'adresse à vous si..
En plus d'une vraie compétence en marketing et communication, nous recherchons une personne capable de comprendre rapidement les enjeux du groupe, de structurer des supports utiles et de contribuer concrètement à son développement.
Cadre de la collaboration
- Mission freelance / prestation ;
- Présence régulière à Barcelone souhaitée, avec possibilité d'organisation hybride selon profil ;
- Démarrage possible rapidement ;
- Collaboration évolutive selon les livrables, les résultats et les besoins du groupe ;
- Possibilité d'évolution vers un temps plein ou une collaboration plus durable selon profil.

jobs.title: Senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering
jobs.description:
We are looking for up to two senior lecturers in Electrical Engineering for permanent employment at the School of Science and Technology.

Subject area

The subject area for this position is Electrical Engineering.

Background

We are looking for up to two new colleagues to strengthen our teaching and research related to electrical engineering, at the intersection of electrical engineering, robotics, and autonomous systems. Topics of interest include control theory, signal processing, sensors, electronics and mechatronics; potentially extending towards robot manipulation, robot perception and machine learning. If you are passionate about advancing knowledge in these fields and enjoy working in an internationally connected research and educational environment, we would love to hear from you.

The positions are based at the school’s unit for computer science, which conducts education in both computer science and electrical engineering, and is home to the research environment AASS (applied autonomous sensor systems) which is a dynamic and multi-disciplinary constellation at the intersection of computer science, robotics, artificial intelligence, computer vision, and cybersecurity. The successful candidate is also expected to interact with the university-wide centre for AI, Robotics and Cybersecurity (ARC). See also: https://www.oru.se/english/research/university-wide-centres/arc-ai-robotics-and-cybersecurity-center/

Duties and responsibilities

As a senior lecturer, you will divide your time between teaching at all levels, research, and any associated public engagement activities.

On the teaching side, you will contribute to courses spanning the breadth of electrical engineering, from foundational to advanced level. This includes courses in electrical circuits and electronics, digital electronics, control theory, digital signal conditioning and processing, and electrical machines. Over time you will be expected to develop your own courses. Teaching encompasses supervision, examination, course development and administration, planning and evaluation. Teaching can be done in Swedish and English. On the research side, you are expected to publish in relevant international venues and attract external research funding. You will be integrated into the research environment with possibilities to establish an independent research agenda connected to the unit's general topics.

There are also opportunities to take on leadership roles in research and education (for example, shaping degree programmes or leading a research team) and to contribute more broadly to the development of the unit's activities.

Qualifications

Those qualified for appointment as a senior lecturer are applicants who have demonstrated teaching expertise and been awarded a doctoral degree in a subject matter relevant for the position, or has the corresponding research competence or some other professional expertise that is of value in view of the subject matter of the position and the duties that it will involve.

A general eligibility criterion for teaching staff at Örebro University is to have completed courses on teaching and learning in higher education corresponding to 10 weeks. Knowledge and skills equivalent to such courses may also be assessed to establish whether these provide eligibility. A teacher who at the time of appointment lacks such training or the equivalent competence, must complete the required courses no later than within two years of taking up the position.

Assessment criteria

To see the job advertisement and the assessment criteria in its entirety, visit: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/job/?jid=20260201

Information

This is a permanent full-time position. At Örebro University, salary depends on the successful candidate’s qualifications and experience, and positions announced are, where appropriate, subject to a trial period.

For more information about the position, contact head of unit Martin Magnusson, +46 19 30 38 70, email: martin.magnusson@oru.se, or head of school Henrik Olsson, +46 19 30 12 36, email: henrik.olsson@oru.se.

At Örebro University, we expect each member of staff to be open to development and change; take responsibility for their work and performance; demonstrate a keen interest in collaboration and contribute to development; as well as to show respect for others by adopting a constructive and professional approach.

Örebro University actively pursues equal opportunities and gender equality as well as a work environment characterised by openness, trust and respect. We value the qualities that diversity adds to our operations.

Application

The application is made online. Click the button “Apply” to begin the application procedure.

For the application to be complete, the following electronic documents must be included:

    Covering letter, outlining how you believe you can contribute to the continued development of Örebro University
    CV with a relevant description of your overall qualifications and experience
    Teaching portfolio (as instructed in Örebro University's guidelines:  https://www.oru.se/globalassets/inforum-en/key_documents/human-resources/template-for-teaching-portfolio.pdf)
    Research portfolio
    Publication list
    Relevant scientific publications (maximum of five and in full-text format)
    Copies of relevant course/degree certificates and references verifying eligibility and criteria met

Only documents written in Swedish, English, Norwegian and Danish can be reviewed.

More information for applicants will be found on our career site: https://www.oru.se/english/career/available-positions/applicants-and-external-experts/

The application deadline is 2026-08-31. We look forward to receiving your application!

After the application deadline, no supplements can be made electronically. If you have scientific publications that cannot be attached electronically to the application, please cite them in your application and contact hr@oru.se.

As we have already made our choices in terms of external collaboration partners and marketing efforts for this recruitment process, we decline any contact with recruitment agencies and advertisers.

As directed by the National Archives of Sweden (Riksarkivet), we are required to deposit one file copy of the application documents, excluding publications, for a period of two years after the appointment decision has gained legal force.

jobs.title: Työnjohtaja teline- ja sääsuojapalveluihin Rauman telakalle
jobs.description:
**_Etsimme työnjohtajaa teline- ja sääsuojapalveluihin Rauman telakalle_**

_Olemme teline- ja sääsuoja-alalla Euroopan suurimpia toimijoita ja Suomessa yksi suurimmista rakennusalan aliurakoitsijoista. Asiakaskuntamme on laaja; toteutamme asiakkaillemme teline- ja sääsuojausprojekteja sekä rakennuksilla että teollisuudessa._

_Olemme osana tuotantoa mukana rakentamassa niin maailman suurimpia risteilijöitä kuin muitakin moderneja aluksia, tarjoten asiakkaillemme turvalliset työskentelyolosuhteet sekä huolletun ja toimivan vuokrakaluston. Näissä projekteissa poikkeuksetta yhdistyy sujuva palvelu ja vankka ammattitaitomme._

_Tässä tehtävässä toimit osana Väli-Suomen työnjohtotiimiä, jossa kollegoinasi toimivat pitkän linjan ammattilaiset. Työnjohtotiimi ei toimi yksin, vaan ammattimaista tukea työhön tarjoavat Ramirentin tuotehallinta, suunnittelu, projektitoimisto ja logistiikka._

_Työnjohtajana vastaat teline- ja sääsuojatyömaistasi. Valvot ja vaadit työturvallisuuden ehdotonta noudattamista, joka on yrityksessämme keskiössä. Toimit Ramirentin edustajana asiakkaan suuntaan esimerkiksi työmaakokouksissa ja muissa sidosryhmätilanteissa. Meillä sinulla on mahdollisuus kehittyä myös tarjouslaskennassa._

_Emme odota, että olet täysin valmis työnjohtaja. Hyvät ihmissuhdetaidot yhdistettynä oppimispotentiaalisi ovat avainasemassa tässä tehtävässä menestymisen kannalta. Tarjoamme sinulle erinomaiset puitteet ja kattavan perehdytyksen työssä menestymisen tueksi. Tehtävään valittavalle tullaan tekemään turvallisuusselvitys, mikä on edellytys työsuhteen aloittamiselle._

**_Hakijalta toivomme:_**

- _Tuloksentekokykyä_

- _Kykyä kokonaisuuksien hallintaan_

- _Rakennusalan teknistä koulutusta (esimerkiksi insinööri/rakennusmestari, myös vastavalmistuneet huomioidaan) tai rakennusalan kokemusta_

- Kokemusta telineasennuksista

- _Työnjohtokokemusta (ml. esihenkilökokemusta) ja hyviä ihmissuhdetaitoja_

- _Hyviä yleisiä IT-taitoja_

- _Kielitaitoa: Äidinkielentasoinen suomi ja sujuva englanti ovat välttämättömiä_


**_Ramirent tarjoaa sinulle:_**

- _Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen, hyvät työsuhde-edut sekä kattavan työterveyshuollon palvelut_

- _Ison palvelualan yrityksen tuen_

- _Vakavaraisen ja arvostetun brändin, jonka laatuun voit luottaa_

- _Sitoutuneet kollegat positiivisessa työyhteisössä_

- _Hyvän perehdytyksen ja koulutuksen tehtävään_

- _Vastuullisen tehtävän ja mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä kehittyä_


**_Kiinnostuitko?_**

_Lähetä CV sekä vapaamuotoinen hakemus palkkatoiveineen viimeistään 6.9.2026 hakuportaalin kautta. Hae pikaisesti, tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan kandidaatin löytyessä!_

_Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Aluejohtaja Panu Makkonen, p. +358 400 920 638 arkisin klo 8-16._

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Nolato MediTech develops and manufactures polymer products and systems for global Medtech and Pharma customers. We offer extensive turnkey solutions within plastic and silicone molding, as well as innovative assembly solutions.

Do you want to combine engineering expertise with customer collaboration in an industry where quality, structure and long-term partnerships matter?

As a Sales Engineer, you will be the technical-commercial link between our customers and Nolato MediTech. You will help turn customer needs into robust manufacturing solutions, working closely with engineering, quality, purchasing and controlling throughout the quotation and project process.

About the role

In this role, you will support sales within the contract manufacturing of medical devices. You will lead and structure the technical-commercial dialogue from request for quotation to signed agreement, ensuring that customer requirements are understood, evaluated and translated into feasible, high-quality solutions.

Rather than selling a standard product, you will work with complex, customer-specific projects and long product life cycles. Your engineering background will enable you to engage confidently in technical discussions, coordinate input from internal specialists and explain our proposed manufacturing set-ups clearly to customers.

You report directly to the Managing Director, who holds the overall sales responsibility. You will work closely with a senior Sales Account Manager, who will provide mentoring and commercial support. The position supports our facilities in Hörby and Lomma and is based at our Hörby site.

Main responsibilities

    Develop business opportunities with new and existing customers in line with Nolato MediTech’s strategy and established ways of working.
    Act as a technical-commercial contact for customers, clarifying requirements, coordinating technical input and supporting discussions on manufacturing solutions.
    Drive, coordinate and prepare quotations in accordance with the Quotation Review process, working with engineering, quality, purchasing and controlling.
    Support the evaluation of manufacturability, technical risks, quality requirements and proposed production set-ups during the quotation phase.
    Communicate and negotiate product pricing, services and commercial terms together with the relevant internal stakeholders.
    Lead and facilitate Business Review meetings with customers, ensuring follow-up on technical, commercial and operational topics.
    Work closely with the Medical Solutions business area to align customer strategies, pipeline activity and business opportunities.
    Ensure that technical and commercial commitments are clearly documented and handed over effectively to the project and operational teams.



Background and skills

We welcome candidates at an earlier stage of their commercial career who bring a strong technical foundation and the motivation to develop in a customer-facing role. Relevant experience from sales, application engineering, project engineering, product development, manufacturing engineering or technical project coordination is valuable, but extensive sales experience is not a requirement.

    Education — A university degree in engineering, for example mechanical engineering, materials/polymer engineering, industrial engineering, biomedical engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
    Technical understanding — Ability to understand and discuss technical solutions, manufacturing processes, drawings, specifications and production set-ups with customers and internal specialists.
    Relevant environment — Experience from medical devices, life science, contract manufacturing or another technically advanced and regulated industry is an advantage.
    Structured working style — Ability to document, coordinate and follow defined processes in a complex project environment.
    Communication — Strong communication skills and the ability to build confidence with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    Languages — Fluency in Swedish and English, spoken and written.

Profile

We believe you are someone who:

    Is curious about technology and enjoys understanding how products and manufacturing processes work.
    Can translate customer needs into clear questions and practical next steps for internal experts.
    Works in a structured and methodical way, with attention to quality and detail.
    Uses the organisation’s expertise naturally and knows when to involve the right people.
    Builds long-term, trust-based relationships with customers and colleagues.
    Is comfortable developing into a commercial role and taking responsibility for customer dialogue over time.
    Has a professional, collaborative and confident manner in discussions and negotiations.

We offer

    A key technical-commercial role in a growing medical technology company.
    A structured organisation with clear mandates, processes and decision paths.
    Close collaboration with experienced colleagues in sales, engineering, quality and regulatory affairs.
    Mentoring and support as you develop your technical-commercial career.
    Long-term development opportunities within Nolato MediTech and the Nolato Group.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application via hr.meditech@nolato.com and attaching your CV and cover letter.

The last day of application is 2026-09-13

If you want to know more about the position, please contact:

Managing Director; Hanna Ingesson, 072-237 46 42, hanna.ingesson@nolato.com

HR Director; Stefan Hasselblad, 0768–617183, stefan.hasselblad@nolato.com

jobs.title: AC- Tarjoilija tai -kokki, Tule töihin Kilpisjärvelle ruskan keskelle!
jobs.description:
Etsimme **AC-kokkia** ja -**tarjoilijaa** Kilpisjärvelle ruska-ajan sesonkiin.

_AC-kokki:_

Työskentely alkaa heti ja kestää **syyskuun loppuun** asti.

AC-kokin tehtäviin kuuluu monipuolisesti keittiön työtehtäviä, kuten:

- aamupalavuorojen tuurauksia

- buffetin valmistusta ja ylläpitoa

- à la carte -ruokien valmistusta

- keittiön muita päivittäisiä työtehtäviä.


Etsimme reipasta ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää kokkia, jolla on hyvä asenne ja halu tehdä laadukasta ruokaa sesongin kiireessä.

_Tarjoilija:_

Tarjoilijan työt alkaa heti ja kestävät **lokakuun loppuun** asti.

Työhön kuuluu asiakaspalvelua, anniskelua sekä ravintolan päivittäisiä tarjoilijan tehtäviä. Arvostamme positiivista asennetta, oma-aloitteisuutta ja hyvää asiakaspalvelutaitoa.

Työskentely Kilpisjärvellä

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden työskennellä upeissa Lapin maisemissa ruskan aikaan. **Majoitus järjestyy soluasunnossa hintaan 282 €/kk.**

Molemmissa tehtävissä on **mahdollisuus jatkaa työskentelyä talvikaudella**.

**Työkieli on suomi. Huomioithan, että emme käsittele englanniksi lähetettyjä hakemuksia.**

**Palkkaus matkailu- ja ravintola-alan TES sekä kokemuksen mukaan.**

Jos kiinnostuit, lähetä hakemuksesi osoitteeseen rekrytointi@teampa.fi ja kerro lyhyesti itsestäsi, aiemmasta kokemuksestasi sekä siitä, kumpaa tehtävää haet.

jobs.title: Lvi-asentaja huolto ja saneeraustöihin
jobs.description:
Haemme toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan työsuhteeseen Lvi-asentajaa. Päivittäiset työtehtävät muodostuvat vaihtelevissa kohteissa lvi-huoltotöistä, remonttikohteista, saneeraustyömailla työskentelystä kuin myös uudistyömailla työskentelystä. Kuitenkin pääsääntöisesti huolto- ja remonttikohteiden parissa. Niin taloyhtiökohteissa kuin yksityisasiakkaiden luona sekä remonttialan yritysten kanssa.

Tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan ja kattavan työterveyshuollon, oman työauton käyttöösi, nykyaikaiset työkalut, rennon ja rempseän työyhteisön pienessä porukassamme. Lisäksi voit käyttää vapaa-aikanasi yhtiömme tiloja omiin pieniin hommiisi. Tarjoamme myös vuosittain henkilökunnallemme, niin liikunta kuin hierontapalveluja lahjakorttien muodossa.

Toivomme sinulta: Tarkkaa ja tarmokasta otetta työhösi sekä luonnollisesti hyvää ammattiosaamista. Hitsaustaito luetaan eduksesi. Ymmärrys lämpöpumppu- ja kaukolämpölaitteista luetaan myös eduksesi. Olethan valmis oppimaan uutta sillä pyrimme aina mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös tarjoamaan kouluttautumista henkilökunnallemme. C-kortti luetaan myös eduksesi, tarvittaessa voimme kustantaa sinulle myös ajokortin suorittamisen.

Paikka täytetään heti kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
**Help Engineers Solve Real-World Technical Problems Across Europe from Porvoo, Finland**

At Thermetrics Europe, we support engineers, researchers, manufacturers, and technical organizations with precision thermal and moisture measurement technology, application expertise, service, calibration, and technical support.

We may be a young European company, but we are not starting from scratch. We have more than 40 years of Thermetrics technology, engineering experience, and industry knowledge behind us.

We're now building the next stage of Thermetrics Europe, and we're looking for a **Technical Support Engineer – Service & Support** to join our growing team in Porvoo, Finland (you must be already located in Southern Finland).

**The Role**

This is a hands-on, varied engineering role. You'll provide technical support to customers, assemble and test our products in Porvoo, travel throughout Europe for installations and service, troubleshoot equipment, perform calibrations, train customers, and help them get the most from their Thermetrics systems.

You'll also work closely with our engineering team in the US, bringing customer and field experience back into product development and continuous improvement. No two days will look exactly the same. You might be troubleshooting a system remotely in the morning, preparing equipment for shipping items in the afternoon, and traveling to a customer site the following week.

Travel is approximately **25% or less**, throughout Europe, occasionally including trips to outside Europe as well.

**Help Build the Support Team**

We're building our European support organization as we grow, which means this isn't a role where every process is already written and every responsibility has been neatly assigned. There will be trial and error, problem solving, and plenty of wearing different hats.

You'll have opportunities to help develop service procedures, documentation, customer support processes, training materials, and new ways of working. Sometimes you'll be doing the technical work. Sometimes you'll be helping figure out how the technical work should be done.

We're looking for someone who enjoys that kind of environment.

You don't need to know everything on day one. You do need to be curious, willing to learn, comfortable asking questions, and able to look at a problem and say: "We haven't done this before. Let's figure it out."

**Team Player. Independent Problem Solver.**

You'll be part of a small, collaborative team, but field service also requires you to be comfortable working independently.

When you're at a customer site, you may be the technical person in the room. You'll need to assess the situation, troubleshoot on the go, make good decisions, communicate clearly, and keep working toward a solution even when conditions aren't perfect.

We're looking for someone who:

- Works well as part of a small team.

- Can work independently in the field.

- Enjoys hands-on troubleshooting and problem solving.

- Stays calm when things don't go according to plan.

- Takes ownership of problems and follows them through to resolution.

- Knows when to solve a problem independently and when to reach out for help.

- Is willing to pitch in wherever needed as the company grows.

- Communicates well with both technical and non-technical customers.


**What You'll Bring**

**Required:**

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Physics, or a related technical field.

- At least 2 years of experience with scientific instrumentation, laboratory equipment, automated equipment, engineered products, field service, commissioning, or technical support.

- Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- A practical, hands-on approach to technical problem solving.

- Ability and willingness to travel up to 25% internationally, mostly alone

- Ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative international team.

- Native or professional working proficiency in English.

- Valid Driver's License


**Nice to have:**

- Experience with scientific instrumentation or laboratory equipment.

- Experience with thermal, environmental, textile, or PPE testing.

- Experience with calibration, validation, commissioning, or field service.

- Familiarity with SolidWorks, Python, Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.

- Finnish or Swedish language skills.


**Why Thermetrics Europe?**

You'll be joining a company with the technology and experience of an established global organization, while having the opportunity to help shape a young and growing European operation.

You'll work with advanced thermal testing technology, support customers across Europe, collaborate with experienced engineers internationally, and have a direct influence on how our European service and support organization develops.

This is a role for someone who wants to build, not just maintain.

If you enjoy solving real-world engineering problems, working with customers, troubleshooting in the field, and helping build something that is still taking shape, we'd like to hear from you.

**Location:** Porvoo, Finland (Itä-Uusimaa)

**Employment:** Full-time, with trial period

**Travel:** Up to 25%, mostly Europe

**Education**: Bachelors (Required)

**Language**: English, Professional or Native (Required), and Finnish/Swedish, Working (Preferred)

jobs.title: Elämyskaupan liiketoimintapäällikkö
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LIEKSA

Etsimme elämyskaupan liiketoimintapäällikköä johtamaan, rakentamaan ja kehittämään tulevaisuuden matkailu- ja elämysliiketoimintaa Pohjois-Karjalassa.

Tässä tehtävässä pääset yhdistämään liiketoiminnan johtamisen, matkailun, elämykset ja kaupallisen kehittämisen ainutlaatuisessa toimintaympäristössä. Vastaat Bomba Safaris ja Koli Safaris - Karelian Adventures & Experiences liiketoiminnasta, Koli Ski rinnetoiminnoista sekä PKO matkailu- ja ravitsemiskaupan tapahtumatuotannosta ja tuotteistuksesta. Tavoitteena on kasvattaa ja kehittää kokonaisuutta entistä vahvemmaksi, ympärivuotiseksi ja kansainvälisesti kiinnostavaksi elämyspalveluiden kokonaisuudeksi.

Tehtävässäsi pääset
johtamaan ja kehittämään liiketoimintaa sekä vastaamaan sen budjetista ja tuloksesta
rakentamaan ympärivuotista elämystarjontaa kotimaisille ja kansainvälisille matkailijoille
tunnistamaan uusia mahdollisuuksia ja kehittämään uusia tuotteita, palveluita ja elämyksellisiä konsepteja
johtamaan henkilöstöä ja vahvistamaan osaamista, työyhteisöä ja asiantuntijuutta
suunnittelemaan ja edistämään investointeja, jotka tukevat liiketoiminnan kasvua ja tulevaisuuden asiakastarpeita
kehittämään määrätietoisesti turvallisuutta, laatua ja asiakaskokemusta
rakentamaan vahvoja kumppanuuksia alueen toimijoiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
vastaamaan kokonaisuuden kaupallisesta kehittämisestä ja löytämään uusia tapoja kasvattaa myyntiä ja kannattavuutta.

Odotamme sinulta
Sinulla on vahva kaupallinen ote ja kyky nähdä metsä puilta – ja mahdollisuudet siellä, missä muut näkevät vain nykytilan. Osaat yhdistää strategisen ajattelun käytännön tekemiseen ja viet ideat suunnitelmallisesti toteutukseen.
Olet kokenut esihenkilö, joka innostaa ihmisiä, rakentaa toimivia tiimejä ja saa aikaan tuloksia yhdessä muiden kanssa. Ymmärrät asiakaskokemuksen, palveluliiketoiminnan ja kannattavuuden välisen yhteyden ja haluat kehittää niitä kokonaisuutena.

Matkailu- ja elämysliiketoiminnan tuntemus on tehtävässä eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea etsimme kehittämishaluista ja kaupallisesti ajattelevaa esihenkilöä, jolla on kyky tarttua mahdollisuuksiin ja rakentaa uutta.

Mikä tekee tehtävästä erityisen?
Pääset työskentelemään Kolin ja Bomban ainutlaatuisessa matkailuympäristössä, jossa luonto, kulttuuri, tapahtumat ja elämykset kohtaavat. Tehtävässäsi sinulla on mahdollisuus vaikuttaa siihen, millaisia kokemuksia alueen matkailijoille ja asiakkaille tulevaisuudessa tarjotaan.
Tämä ei ole tehtävä, jossa vain ylläpidetään olemassa olevaa. Tässä tehtävässä rakennetaan seuraavaa lukua.

Jos innostut liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, ihmisistä, elämyksistä ja siitä, että hyvästä ideasta tehdään kannattavaa ja mieleenpainuvaa asiakasliiketoimintaa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Me tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työnkuvan, loistavan työporukan sekä mahdollisuuden edetä urallasi isossa toimipaikkaverkostossamme. PKOlaisena saat käyttöösi S-ryhmän ja PKOn kattavat henkilöstöedut. (https://pko.fi/toissa-meilla/palkka-ja-edut) Meillä työnantaja on vakuuttanut jokaisen työntekijän myös vapaa-ajan tapaturmavakuutuksella, ja liikkumistasi kannustamme Epassilla. Perehdytämme sinut kaikkiin tehtäviin ja erilaisiin työvuoroihin sekä opastamme onnistumisiin pitkin matkaa. Palkkaa maksamme alan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti.

Tule rakentamaan Pohjois-Karjalan seuraavia elämyksiä kanssamme.

Hakuaika päättyy 31.8.2026.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa matkailukaupan toimialajohtaja Satu Näsärö p. 040 5379 201, voit soittaa hänelle 20.8. klo 14.30-17.00 tai 24.8. klo 10.00-14.00.
