jobs.title: Software Engineer - Product Engineering
jobs.description:
About Varnish Software

Varnish Software is a Scandinavian-based tech company developing caching technology for some of the world's biggest players in the content delivery market. Our technology helps businesses worldwide improve website performance, deliver video streams, and scale their infrastructure.

About the role 💼

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our new Product Engineering team. While Varnish is known for its general purpose caching engine (OSS and Enterprise), our team is focused on building new products to solve real-world needs, where caching is just one of the components. It’s a bit like developing LEGO sets.

We are currently building a Data Fabric suite of products designed to address infrastructure challenges, including (but not limited to):

  • Virtual Registry: Caching packages, Docker images, and other software artifacts.

  • Artifact Firewall: Preventing and mitigating software supply chain attacks.

  • S3 Cache: On-prem caching of S3-compatible object stores.

  • AI Storage Accelerator: Speed up AI training and inference workloads.

You will have a high degree of technical freedom and ownership, as we prioritize quality over quantity and work on long-term ongoing projects. The solutions you help create will be deployed both on-prem by customers and used to build managed platforms and services.

What You Will Do

We primarily develop our tools in Go, but Rust is becoming increasingly relevant for our critical high-performance components.

You will be building self-hosted, distributed systems that need to deploy across a wide range of customer environments. Your core responsibilities will include:

  • System Architecture & Implementation: You will not just be implementing features, you will participate in architecting the "Data Fabric" suite. This involves solving complex concurrency, networking, and data consistency challenges. It’s a lot of fun!

  • Technical Ownership: We are looking for an engineer who thinks beyond the ticket. You will take ownership of entire components, from the initial RFC/design phase through to implementation and testing.

  • Drive Innovation: You are expected to be a vocal part of the engineering process. We need you to challenge our architectural assumptions, propose alternative technical approaches, and help us avoid local optima in our design decisions.

  • Good Code: You will contribute to a culture of high code quality, writing maintainable, testable code and participating in rigorous code reviews.

Who You Are

We are looking for a developer who is driven by solving problems, not just closing tickets.

  • Solid Engineering Foundation: You have strong experience in backend software development. While our stack is primarily Go, we value deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, concurrency, and distributed systems over specific syntax.

  • Product-Minded: You understand that code is a means to an end. You have enough industry knowledge to understand why we are building these products and can make technical decisions that align with market needs.

  • Innovator & Challenger: You are not afraid to voice a different opinion or challenge architectural decisions. Varnish Software has a flat company structure and thrives on individuals taking ownership.

  • Versatile: You understand the complexities of self-hosted software. You are comfortable navigating the blurry line between application code and the infrastructure it runs on (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux).

  • Self-Driven: You manage your own time effectively, take initiative without waiting for permission, and contribute to a friendly, humble, and collaborative team culture.

About the team 💙

Our Research & Development team develops and maintains the Varnish Software products, which includes Varnish Enterprise, Varnish Controller and Varnish Traffic Router. We're a group of open-minded, friendly, and curious software engineers, eager to exploring and pushing the boundaries of what's possible in content delivery.

We embrace a company culture inspired by innovation and teamwork. For us, a sense of belonging, equality and trust is key for building high performing teams who thrive as professionals and individuals. 

We're based in Oslo, Karlstad and Paris. 

Benefits, Perks & Salary Range 🙌

At our Varnish Software, we believe that a happy and healthy team is the foundation of our success. That's why we offer a range of benefits and perks:

  • Flexible working arrangements 🏡

We know that life doesn't always fit into a 9-to-5 schedule. That's why we offer flexible working arrangements to help you balance your professional and personal life. This role requires You to be able to work from the Oslo office (Nydalen) at least once a week.

  • Generous parental pay 🧑‍🍼

We believe in supporting our employees through all life stages, ensuring you can enjoy quality time with your little one without financial worries. Join us and experience a workplace that truly values work-life balance and family wellbeing.

  • Vacation 🏖️

We believe in the importance of rest and relaxation. That's why we offer 26 vacation days, enjoy more time to travel, unwind, and spend quality time with your loved ones.

How to Apply

Eligibility: You must have the legal right to work in Norway or hold unrestricted work authorization within the EU/EEA that allows you to work in Norway at the time of employment. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa or work permit sponsorship for this role.

Ready to join our team?
Simply click the "Apply" button to start your application process. We look forward to learning more about you and how you can contribute to our success. Don’t hesitate - take the first step towards your new career with us today!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Varnish Software creates edge caching and content delivery software that unlocks fast, reliable digital experiences for users and systems.

We’re an inclusive employer; seeing diversity as a strong asset. When we’ve different perspectives and approaches, we grow together to create innovative solutions and contributions to software development and to our customers. With this diversity, we have one thing in common; we’re fun and friendly. And we’re in this together!

jobs.title: Secondary Engineer
jobs.description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as hydrogen, data centers and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

**The Opportunity**

We are offering a position as a Secondary Engineer at Hitachi Energy, Grid Integration business. This role will be in Vaasa, where we have the team and an office.

The business unit designs and delivers complete substations for distribution and transmission grids. We are offering an interesting position in an international project environment and various development possibilities in the areas of design and engineering, research, and development. Because each project is different, your responsibilities will range widely and may include managing all aspects of secondary design from initial planning to final delivery.

Daily responsibilities include preparing design drawings, drafting essential construction documents, conducting engineering calculations, and overseeing commissioning processes. At Hitachi Energy, you will have the opportunity to apply your design expertise across diverse projects, both domestically in Finland and internationally.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

- Prepare and review substation documentations, for example, single line diagram, protection diagrams, interlocking diagrams, AC and DC drawings, calculations, control and protection panel drawings, IED configurations, cabling and bills of materials.

- Provide technical evaluation of supplier proposals and accepts as fit for purpose supplied equipment or services.

- Provide technical support during pre-FAT and FAT stage, handling installation and commissioning activities. Prepare project documentation within one's scope of deliverables.

- Participate in testing and commissioning.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including project manager, design (Lead, Primary, Civil and commissioning), planner, quality assurance, and supply chain, to ensure seamless project integration and successful outcomes in international project environment.

- Drive a culture of continuous improvement, fostering innovation, and encouraging employee involvement in problem-solving and process enhancement.

- Living core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues, and the business.


**Your background**

- B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Electrical Engineering.

- Proficiency in both spoken and written English and Finnish or Swedish.

- Demonstrated proactivity, results orientation, strong interpersonal and teamwork abilities.

- Willingness to participate in international projects.

- Willingness to travel up to 20%, both domestically and internationally.

- Previous experience in engineering work related to high and medium voltage substations is considered an asset.

- Experience in design software such as E3, AutoCAD, PCM600 is considered as an advantage.

- Understanding of substation control and protection systems is also considered beneficial.

Zabezpečovať realizáciu poradenských aktivít v školách prezenčným, alebo dištančným spôsobom: - realizovať individuálne poradenstvo pre pedagogických zamestnancov (PZ), vedúcich pedagogických zamestnancov (VPZ), - realizovať návštevy hodín PZ a VPZ s cieľom zvýšenia kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - poskytovať im spätnú väzbu na pozorované edukačné aktivity, - navrhovať odporúčania na zvýšenie kvality výchovno-vzdelávacieho procesu, - identifikovať a diagnostikovať problémy PZ a VPZ, - podporovať PZ a VPZ pri tvorbe návrhov možných riešení ich problémov, - pomáhať im pri aplikácii týchto riešení vo výchovno-vzdelávacom procese v triede a práci so žiakmi, - vedieť poskytovať poradenstvo v niektorých z uvedených oblastí: vzdelávacie programy (ŠVP, ŠkVP), hodnotenie vzdelávacích výsledkov žiakov, vzdelávací proces a vyučovací štýl učiteľa, personalizácia vyučovania a inkluzívne vzdelávanie, digitalizácia. Realizovať skupinové formy rozvoja spôsobilosti PZ a VPZ vo vyššie uvedených oblastiach - formou poldňových/celodňových workshopov, - formou organizovania učiacich sa skupín/organizácie prednášok a diskusií, Monitorovať potreby PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl v regióne - formou dotazníkov pre PZ, VPZ a riaditeľov škôl a školských zariadení, - formou individuálnych rozhovorov s PZ, VPZ a riaditeľmi škôl a školských zariadení. Vykonávať administratívne úlohy spojené s pracovným miestom: - vyplnenie pracovného výkazu, - vedenie dokumentácie o činnostiach, - iné podľa potreby EduHubu. Vykonávať pracovné činnosti podľa potreby a pokynov zamestnávateľa.
Výhody:- flexibilný úväzok 40 – 100 percent , - organizácia času podľa dohody min. 2 dni v týždni, súvisle 7,5 h , - zaujímavá pracovná príležitosť v oblasti školstva na nepedagogickej pozícii, - flexibilita. Ak ešte nemáte absolvované vzdelávanie v mentoringu alebo koučingu 50 h , zabezpečíme a uhradíme ho za vás. Hľadáme predovšetkým ľudí, ktorí sú ochotní vydať sa na cestu rozvoja škôl vo svojom regióne.

jobs.title: Riadiaci pracovníci (manažéri) v priemysle
jobs.description:
The Engineering Supervisor is responsible for leading and developing a specialized engineering team within EEDC, supporting delivery of industrial automation and functional safety projects. The role combines people leadership, resource and capacity management, technical leadership, and direct project contribution when required, including acting as Lead Engineer on selected safety-related projects.

Main Responsibilities
Team Leadership & People Development
•    Lead, coach, and develop a team of engineers and technical specialists.
•    Conduct performance, development, and career discussions in line with company processes.
•    Support employee engagement, team collaboration, retention, and succession planning.
•    Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and high-quality engineering delivery.
Resource, Capacity & Delivery Management
•    Manage team utilization, workload visibility, resource allocation, and project staffing priorities.
•    Support recruitment, onboarding, competency planning, and capability development for the team.
•    Coordinate with project managers, delivery leaders, and other engineering teams to secure adequate resource coverage.
•    Monitor team objectives and contribute to operational performance, productivity, and delivery reliability.
Technical Leadership – Functional Safety & SIS
•    Provide technical guidance and mentoring on Functional Safety Management (FSM), Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS), and related industrial automation topics.
•    Support functional safety lifecycle activities, including review of safety requirements, engineering deliverables, verification approach, and project execution practices.
•    Act as Lead Engineer, Technical Lead, or Senior Engineer on selected customer projects when business needs require direct technical contribution.
•    Support technical estimation, proposal reviews, project risk identification, and solution alignment for SIS, safety PLC, DCS, SCADA, and critical control applications.
•    Ensure that engineering outputs are aligned with applicable standards, customer requirements, internal quality requirements, cybersecurity expectations, and safety practices.
Operational Excellence & Compliance
•    Support implementation of EEDC strategic initiatives, standard operating practices, and competency roadmaps.
•    Contribute to continuous improvement activities, quality management system adherence, and audit readiness where applicable.
•    Promote safe, compliant, and customer-focused execution across assigned engineering activities.
•    Collaborate with cross-border stakeholders and support regional or global delivery needs as required.

jobs.title: Špecialisti v oblasti databáz a počítačových sietí inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Your responsibilities
Respond to customer support requests and technical incidents through the ticketing system.
Troubleshoot issues involving Linux servers, dedicated infrastructure, cloud environments, storage platforms, and network connectivity.
Analyze system logs, performance metrics, and monitoring events to identify the root cause of incidents.
Resolve problems related to server functionality, operating system configuration, performance, and service availability.
Coordinate with data centre technicians to perform hardware diagnostics and component replacements when required.
Escalate complex technical issues to engineering teams, providing complete troubleshooting details.
Keep customers informed about incident progress and communicate technical information in a clear and professional manner.
Maintain accurate case documentation, contribute to the knowledge base, and collaborate with internal infrastructure teams.

Required skills and experience
At least two years of experience in technical support, Linux administration, hosting operations, NOC, or a similar infrastructure-focused role.
Practical experience administering Linux distributions such as Ubuntu, Debian, CentOS, or equivalent.
Strong command-line skills, including process management, system services, user administration, permissions, package management, log analysis, and file systems.
Good understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, IP addressing, routing, SSH, HTTP/HTTPS, ports, and firewall concepts.
Basic knowledge of server hardware, storage technologies, RAID configurations, and infrastructure monitoring.
Experience working with ticketing systems, monitoring platforms, log management, or remote administration tools.
Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to prioritize and manage multiple issues simultaneously.
English proficiency at Upper-Intermediate (B2) level or above.

jobs.title: Dizajnéri a správcovia databáz
jobs.description:
Design, develop, and maintain Power BI reports and dashboards translating complex operational data into actionable insights for business operations stakeholders; ensure models are performant, scalable, and governed.

Build and maintain automated workflows and business applications using Power Automate and Power Apps, reducing manual effort across core operations processes (approvals, data collection, escalation routing).

Own the data layer: write and optimize DAX measures and Power Query transformations; connect to sources including SharePoint, Dataverse, SQL, and Snowflake where applicable.

Collaborate with business operations teams to gather, challenge, and translate requirements into technical solutions — including scope control and managing change requests.

Administer production and distribution of internal financial reports, compile various cross functional reports. Drive the reporting simplification and efficiency.

Prepare, clean, and analyze large datasets from various sources (ERP, operational, and financial systems).

Maintain solution documentation, workspace governance, and RLS (row-level security) configurations in line with organizational data access policies.

jobs.description:
Pravidelná údržba elektrotechnických zariadení a zabezpečenie ich plnej funkčnosti. Vykonávanie pravidelnej kontroly jednotlivých zariadení. Operatívne riešenie vzniknutých problémov na rozvádzačoch a iných elektr. zariadeniach. Zodpovednosť za pravidelnú údržbu prevádzky a opravy (voda, elektrika, výmena žiaroviek, opravy svietidiel, klimatizácia, vzduchotechnika). Hlavná činnosť je zameraná na fyzický výkon práce. Všetky údržbárske práce v areáli prevádzky. Bezodkladné riešenie vzniknutých problémov a nedostatkov a ich následné hlásenie kompetentným osobám. Znalosť technických parametrov a špecifikácie používaných prístrojov a zariadení. Zapisovanie hodnôt z plynomerov, vodomerov. Výpomoc pri kosení areálu, vysádzaní kvetináčov a udržiavaní poriadku v areáli prevádzky, odpratávanie snehu, výkopové práce. V rámci dosiahnutého vzdelania a kvalifikácie (získané osvedčenia) prevádza všetky pridelené údržbárske práce.
Výhody:Stravovanie zabezpečené zamestnávateľom za symbolickú úhradu. Po uplynutí skúšobnej doby nárok na: - možnosť výmenných rekreácii v našich zariadeniach, - príspevok na III.pilier DDS, - multisport karta, - nepravidelné odmeny. Jedná sa o prácu na 12-hodinové zmeny podľa harmonogramu od pondelka do nedele.

Evidencia, klasifikácia a riešenie používateľských požiadaviek a incidentov prostredníctvom tiketovacieho systému HALO. Inštalácia, konfigurácia a príprava pracovných staníc, notebookov, tlačiarní, mobilných telefónov a ďalších koncových zariadení. Podpora používateľov pri práci s Microsoft 365 a štandardnými kancelárskymi aplikáciami. Správa používateľských účtov, hesiel a prístupových oprávnení podľa interných postupov. Evidencia a aktualizácia inventára IT hardvéru a softvéru. Spolupráca pri nákupe, príprave a vydávaní IT techniky novým zamestnancom. Základná správa tlačového prostredia vrátane riešenia bežných problémov s tlačiarňami a skenermi. Podpora výrobných pracovísk pri riešení základných IT problémov ovplyvňujúcich výrobnú prevádzku. Spolupráca pri aktualizáciách operačných systémov, aplikácií a bezpečnostných nástrojov. Vykonávanie pravidelných kontrol pridelených IT systémov podľa definovaných postupov. Spolupráca pri vedení a aktualizácii IT dokumentácie, interných postupov a prevádzkových záznamov. Eskalácia zložitejších technických problémov na IT špecialistu alebo IT administrátora senior. Dodržiavanie pravidiel informačnej bezpečnosti a podieľanie sa na ochrane firemných dát a IT prostriedkov. Plnenie ďalších úloh v oblasti IT podpory podľa pokynov nadriadeného alebo potrieb spoločnosti.

jobs.title: Čalúnnici a podobní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Náplň práce Pracovná náplň nie je obmedzená len na nižšie uvedené činnosti a zamestnanec môže byť podľa prevádzkových potrieb zamestnávateľa poverený aj ďalšími súvisiacimi pracovnými úlohami. Výroba, čalúnenie, oprava a renovácia čalúneného nábytku (stoličky, kreslá, pohovky, postele a iný nábytok). Výroba a montáž čalúnenia pre motorové vozidlá vrátane kompletného čalúnenia interiéru, obkladov, dekoratívnych prvkov a zákazkových úprav. Meranie, strihanie, príprava a spracovanie poťahových materiálov (textil, koža, ekokoža a iné materiály). Montáž výplňových materiálov (pena, vatelín, pružiny, popruhy a ďalšie čalúnnické komponenty). Šitie poťahov na priemyselných šijacích strojoch podľa potreby výroby. Poťahovanie výrobkov a upevňovanie poťahových materiálov pomocou ručného a elektrického náradia. Oprava alebo výmena poškodených častí čalúneného nábytku a interiérov vozidiel. Kontrola kvality hotových výrobkov a dodržiavanie technologických postupov. Udržiavanie čistoty pracoviska, pracovných nástrojov a výrobných priestorov. Pomoc pri nakládke, vykládke a doručovaní hotových výrobkov zákazníkom. Riadenie služobného motorového vozidla pri zabezpečovaní rozvozu alebo prepravy materiálu, ak je držiteľom platného vodičského oprávnenia. Vykonávanie pomocných a upratovacích prác podľa potrieb prevádzky. Plnenie ďalších pracovných úloh súvisiacich s výrobou, montážou, servisom a prevádzkou spoločnosti podľa pokynov zamestnávateľa. Dodržiavanie predpisov bezpečnosti a ochrany zdravia pri práci (BOZP), protipožiarnych predpisov a interných smerníc zamestnávateľa. Požiadavky na uchádzača Minimálne 3 roky preukázateľnej odbornej praxe na pozícii čalúnnik alebo v obdobnej profesii. Skúsenosti s čalúnením nábytku a výhodou sú skúsenosti s čalúnením interiérov motorových vozidiel. Manuálna zručnosť, presnosť a zodpovedný prístup k práci. Schopnosť pracovať samostatne aj v tíme. Dobrý zdravotný stav a fyzická zdatnosť. Vodičské oprávnenie skupiny B je výhodou.
Výhody:Hradené, vlastná doprava zamestnávateľa

Lujzy de Marillac a pridaj sa k nám do tímu opatrovateľov! Ako opatrovateľ, opatrovateľka budeš mať možnosť: ​ • prispievať k zlepšeniu zdravotného stavu klienta formou starostlivosti o osobnú hygienu klienta, či pomoci pri presune na lôžko či invalidný vozík • zabezpečovať výdaj stravy, ako aj nevyhnutného ošatenia a obuvi • asistovať pri sprevádzaní klienta k lekárovi a bežných denných aktivitách • podporovať klienta pri každodenných činnostiach • vykonávať administratívne činnosti spojené s poskytovaním služieb klientom • podieľať sa na tímových poradách a skupinových supervíziach Láka Ťa práca opatrovateľa, ale máš obavu, či to zvládneš? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude sprevádzať šikovný kolega a neskôr budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať certifikovaný opatrovateľský kurz hradený organizáciou. Okrem toho Ťa počas roka čakajú vzdelávacie programy, ktoré Ti pomôžu pri práci s klientom Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce, ktorí by radi počas štúdia pretavili svoje doterajšie vedomosti pri priamej práci s klientom v praxi Týždenný pracovný čas je 37,5h (za mesiac to je 13-14 pracovných zmien). Práca je rozložená na denné a nočné zmeny (v priemere 5-6 nočných zmien mesačne). Denná služba v čase 7:45 - 20:15h a nočná služba v čase 19:45 - 8:15h. ☝️Čo je Útulok a ZOS sv. Lujzy de Marillac a aký Ťa čaká pracovný tím? V zariadení sociálnych služieb sa už 15 rokov venujeme pomoci ľuďom ohrozeným stratou bývania alebo skúsenosťou so životom na ulici, ktorí majú zdravotné ťažkosti a častokrát nemajú dostupné možnosti k doliečeniu svojho stavu. Práve u nás im poskytujeme celodennú starostlivosť s víziou zlepšenia či stabilizovania ich zdravia. V zariadení máme kapacitu 35 klientov, väčšinou v staršom veku. Aj napriek ťažkým životným skúsenostiam našich klientov neopúšťa radosť a snaha o riešenie svojho stavu. Počas týždňa sa klienti zapájajú do rôznych aktivít, ako ranné rozcvičky, prechádzky, návšteva galérie, trhov, spoločné varenie, výroba bezodpadových podpaľovačov a iné. Náš tím opatrovateľov aktuálne tvorí osem kolegov a kolegýň spolu s vedúcou opatrovateľkou, počas dňa sa stretneš aj s vedúcim a zástupkyňou zariadenia, ako aj so sociálnymi pracovníkmi, zdravotnou sestrou a koordinátorkou aktivít. jobs.title: Terénni sociálni a zdravotní pracovníci
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá má zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Depaul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! ​Len v Bratislave žije odhadom viac ako 5 000 ľudí bez domova. Mnohí z nich navštevujú naše zariadenia, no ešte väčšia skupina sa ukrýva priamo v uliciach, vlastnoručne postavených príbytkoch či opustených chatrčiach. Ako najväčší terénny tím v Bratislave navštevujeme Karlovu Ves, Dúbravku, Lamač a Devínsku Novú Ves, aby sme pomáhali i tým, ktorí za nami prísť nedokážu. Našim cieľom je vyhľadávať a oslovovať ľudí bez domova v ich prirodzenom prostredí, poskytovať im sociálne a psychologické poradenstvo, základné zdravotné ošetrenie, materiálnu pomoc, sprevádzanie v kríze a prepájať ich na dostupné služby a bývanie. Veríme, že solidarita a spoločná práca môže ľuďom v núdzi darovať nádej a silu na nový začiatok. Ako terénny sociálny pracovník/sociálna pracovníčka budeš: - aktívne vyhľadávať a kontaktovať osoby a rodiny so sociálnymi problémami v rámci lokality a cieľovej skupiny (osoby z marginalizovaných rómskych komunít, ľudia bez domova), - posudzovať životné situácie človeka v spoločenskom, ekonomickom, politickom kontexte lokality/regiónu/spoločnosti, - identifikovať zdroje možností a schopností klienta a jeho sociálneho prostredia potrebných pre dosiahnutie stanovených cieľov klientom, - posky­tovať podporu v krízových situáciách osobám z cieľovej skupiny a sprístupnenie ostatných foriem pomoci, - poskytovať sociálne poradenstvo na úrovni základného a špecializovaného sociálneho poradenstva v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, - poskytovať pomoc pri uplatňovaní práv a právom chránených záujmov jednotlivca v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách, príp. znevýhodnených skupín obyvateľov na lokálnej/regionálnej úrovni, - vykonávať preventívne aktivity v súlade so Zákonom č. 448/2008 Z.z. o sociálnych službách s cieľom predchádzať sociálnemu vylúčeniu alebo jeho prehlbovaniu, zmierňovanie negatívnych dopadov a zvyšovanie kvality života ľudí žijúci v podmienkach sociálneho vylúčenia a generačnej chudoby, - vykonávať aktivity, ktoré prispievajú k zmierňovaniu napätia a latentných konfliktov v lokalite, - spolupracovať s inštitúciami a organizáciami pôsobiacimi v lokalite/regióne a koordinovať ich v záujme klienta/skupiny/komunity, - jobs.title: Pomocní pracovníci inde neuvedení
jobs.description:
Túžiš po práci, ktorá by ti dávala zmysel? Staň sa súčasťou nášho Deapul tímu a maj prácu, ktorá inšpiruje a pomáha! Ako pomáhajúci pracovník/pomáhajúca pracovníčka budeš s tímom skúsených kolegov a kolegýň pracovať v nízkoprahovej Nocľahárni sv. Vincenta de Paul. Na starosti budeš mať najmä: - pomocné činnosti pri poskytovaní sociálnych služieb a zabezpečovania chodu prevádzky nocľahárne - administratívne činnosti spojené s registráciou klienta, vedenie požadovanej evidencie - pripravovanie hygienických potrieb, pranie uterákov, výdaj čistých plachiet pre klientov, pranie oblečenia - upratovacie práce priestorov počas dennej služby a príprava služby na nočnú zmenu - vo výnimočných prípadoch asistencia pri sprevádzaní imobilného klienta v zariadení, pomoc pri presúvaní, atď - výdaj a/alebo príprava stravy (raňajky), výdaj potravín a ošatenia Pozri si, ako vyzerá práca za dverami nocľahárne: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AfN4dSNk5/ :) Rozvrh pracovného času Ide o prácu na nočné (18:45h – 7:45h) a denné zmeny (7:30h – 20:00h) v nepretržitej prevádzke s týždennou pracovnou dobou 37,5h. Mesačný priemer je spravidla 9 nočných služieb a 4 denné služby. Rozvrhnutie zmien môže byť aj individuálne podľa dohody so zamestnancom​ Kto sme? Nocľaháreň sv. Vincenta de Paul je najväčšou nízkoprahovou nocľahárňou v strednej Európe. Funguje nepretržite už 20 rokov, bez prestávky každý deň v roku. Denne poskytne nocľah, teplé jedlo, sociálne poradenstvo a ďalšie služby pre 200 ľudí v núdzi. Nocľaháreň je jedným z 10 zariadení a projektov neziskovej organizácie Depaul Slovensko, ktorá poskytuje komplexné služby ľuďom bez domova. Pre činnosť našej organizácie sú najdôležitejší naši zamestnanci – Depaul ľudia – profesionáli s veľkým srdcom, trpezlivosťou a empatiou. Pracujeme v priateľskom kolektíve, podporujme vzdelávanie, supervízie a teambulidingové aktivity. Láka ťa práca v nocľahárni, ale premýšľaš, či máš dostatok skúseností? Počas zaúčacieho procesu ťa bude v práci sprevádzať skúsený tím kolegov. Postupne budeš mať príležitosť absolvovať školenia a supervízie, ktoré ti pomôžu pri práci s klientmi. Pozícia je vhodná aj pre študentov sociálnej práce alebo príbuzných humanitárnych odborov, ktorí by radi svoje doterajšie vedomosti preniesli do praxe. Náš tím tvorí viacero pomáhajúcich pracovníkov a počas dňa stretneš aj skvelých sociálnych pracovníkov, koordinátorky dobrovoľníkov a komunitné organizátorky či vedúcu nocľahárne s jej zástupkyňami. Viac informácií o nocľahárni a útulku nájdeš na našej webovej stránke https://depaul.sk/, v časti Naše služby, alebo vo video vizitke: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9IufpprxiqU Tešíme sa na teba :) !

Strong knowledge of VLANs, xSTP, LACP, VRRP, and other Layer 2 and high-availability technologies.
Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise or service-provider network equipment.
Experience managing network changes in business-critical production environments.
Ability to diagnose complex connectivity, routing, performance, and packet-loss issues.
Experience with network monitoring, configuration management, IPAM, and incident-management tools.
Understanding of capacity planning, network resilience, and failure-domain design.
Ability to review technical solutions and make sound architectural decisions.
Strong leadership, prioritization, and incident-coordination skills.
English and Russian at Upper-Intermediate level or higher.

Co od Vás očekáváme?
" praxi s řízením nákladní soupravy,
" samostatnost, spolehlivost a zodpovědný přístup,
" fyzická zdatnost je výhodou.
NABÍZÍME:
Co Vám nabízíme?
" stabilní zaměstnání u zavedené společnosti,
" mzdu vždy včas na účtu,
" pracovní poměr na HPP s možností prodloužení na dobu neurčitou (případně spolupráci formou dohody),
" 5 týdnů dovolené,
" hodinovou mzdu od 220 Kč/hod.,
" příplatky 30 % za práci o sobotách a nedělích,
" 100 % příplatek za práci ve svátek,
" tuzemské i zahraniční diety,
" čtvrtletní a roční odměny za splnění pracovního fondu,
" věrnostní odměny a odměny při pracovních jubileích,
" zvýhodněné ceny firemních výrobků,
" náborový příspěvek 30 000 Kč,
" odměnu 20 000 Kč za doporučení nového kolegy.
Nástup je možný ihned. Místo výkonu práce: okolí Litomyšle
Proč pracovat právě u nás?
Naše práce má smysl. Jsme součástí zemědělské výroby a každý den zajišťujeme důležitou přepravu. Nabízíme dlouhodobou spolupráci, férové jednání a odpovídající odměnu za dobře odvedenou práci.

jobs.title: S-Päällikkö-valmennus, Varsinais-Suomi, Turun Osuuskauppa
jobs.description:
Primary location:
TURKU

Kasva päälliköksi ihan tavallisissa töissä – epätavallisen hyvässä porukassa!
Haluaisitko rakentaa uran kaupan tai ravintola-alan esihenkilönä – sellaisessa työssä, jossa arki on sopivasti vauhdikasta, ihmiset ovat keskiössä ja pääset oppimaan tekemällä?

Haemme nyt viittä S-Päällikkö-valmennettavaa kasvamaan tulosvastuullisiksi päälliköiksi Turun Osuuskauppaan. Valmennettavat työllistyvät kokoaikaiseen ja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen, ja noin puolentoista vuoden mittainen valmennus alkaa 24.11.2026. Valmennuksen aikana saat vahvat valmiudet esihenkilötehtäviin sekä liiketoiminnan ja ihan tavallisen arjen johtamiseen.

Tässä haussa kaupan alan tehtävät sijoittuvat market-toimialalle eli Saleihin, S-marketeihin ja Prismoihin. Ravintola-alalla haemme valmennettavia ensisijaisesti nopean syömisen yksiköihin, kuten lounaskahviloihin ja Hesburgereihin.

Mitä S-Päällikkö-valmennus sisältää?

S-Päällikkö-valmennus yhdistää käytännön työssäoppimisen ja liiketoimintaosaamisen kehittämisen. Valmennuksen aikana työskentelet Turun Osuuskaupan eri yksiköissä Varsinais-Suomen alueella ja pääset tutustumaan toimialasi arkeen ihan käytännössä. Valmennus edellyttää mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa sekä arkisin että viikonloppuisin toimipaikkojen työvuorojen mukaisesti. Meillä päälliköt eivät johda vain toimistosta käsin, vaan ovat mukana siellä missä tapahtuu: asiakkaiden, tuotteiden, annosten, tiimin ja päivän pienten säätöjen keskellä.

Työssäoppimisen aikana pääset palvelemaan asiakkaita, kehittämään yksikön toimintaa, huolehtimaan myyntikuntoisuudesta sekä osallistumaan liiketoiminnan päivittäiseen johtamiseen. Välillä on rauhallisempaa, välillä päivät ovat vauhdikkaita, mutta juuri siinä tavallisessa arjessa opitaan, miten hyvä työpäivä, toimiva tiimi ja tuloksellinen liiketoiminta rakennetaan.

Valmennus suunnitellaan yksilöllisesti aiemman kokemuksesi ja osaamisesi perusteella. Jokaiselle valmennettavalle nimetään henkilökohtainen tuutori, joka toimii esihenkilönäsi, tukee oppimistasi ja auttaa rakentamaan juuri sinulle sopivan kehittymispolun.

Valmennus toteutetaan yhteistyössä Jollas Instituutin kanssa. Käytännön työn lisäksi osallistut lähijaksoille yhdessä muiden alueosuuskauppojen valmennettavien kanssa, suoritat verkko-opintoja ja oppimistehtäviä sekä toteutat projektityön. Näin saat monipuolisen näkemyksen niin omasta toimialastasi kuin koko S-ryhmän liiketoiminnasta.

Valmennuksen hyödyt valmennettaville
Saat kokonaisvaltaisen käsityksen toimialasi liiketoiminnasta ja opit katsomaan arkea myös lukujen, tavoitteiden ja toimintaympäristön kautta.

Pääset työssäoppimisjaksojen kautta kehittämään yksiköiden ja henkilöstön toimintaa ihan oikeassa arjessa.

Ymmärrät esihenkilötyön kokonaiskuvan ja saat valmiudet toimia esihenkilöroolissa Turun Osuuskaupassa.

Verkostoidut S-ryhmän ammattilaisten kanssa ja saat hyvän käsityksen S-ryhmän liiketoimintakokonaisuudesta.


Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työsuhteen, Suomen monipuolisimmat henkilöstöedut, ePassi-edun sekä mahdollisuuden henkilöstörahastoon. Tehtävän palkkaus on 2552 € kuukaudessa. Lisäksi kuulut tulospalkitsemisen piiriin, joka antaa mahdollisuuden ansaita lisäpalkkiota tavoitteiden saavuttamisesta. Ihan tavallisia töitä siis – mutta epätavallisen hyvillä eduilla ja mahdollisuuksilla kasvaa.

Millaisia valmennettavia etsimme?

Olet etsimämme henkilö, jos sinua innostavat asiakaspalvelu, myynti, liiketoiminta ja tavoitteellinen työskentely. Työskentelyotteesi on aktiivinen ja rohkea, ja tartut ennakkoluulottomasti uusiin haasteisiin. Viihdyt ihmisten parissa, rakennat luottamusta ja yhteistyötä ympärilläsi sekä toimit sujuvasti monimuotoisessa työyhteisössä.

Et säikähdä sitä, että päällikön työssä arki on välillä hyllytystä, tarjoilua, asiakaspalvelua, organisointia, palautteenantoa, kiirepiikkejä ja pieniä yllätyksiä. Meillä arvostetaan sitä, että asioihin tartutaan, työkaveria autetaan ja hommat hoidetaan yhdessä maaliin.
Lisäksi sinulla on soveltuva AMK-tutkinto tai olet valmistumassa lähiaikoina, ja pystyt työskentelemään sekä suomeksi että englanniksi. Odotamme, että sinulla onjo jonkin verran kokemusta työelämästä ja ymmärrystä työyhteisössä toimimisesta. Aiempi kokemus kaupan tai ravintola-alalta on eduksi, mutta meille tärkeintä ovat oikea asenne, oppimishalukkuus ja potentiaali kehittyä tulevaisuuden päälliköksi.

Kiinnostuitko? Sitten hakemaan!

Jos ihan tavalliset työt ja epätavallisen hyvä kasvupolku päällikkötehtäviin houkuttavat, lähetä hakemuksesi S-Päällikkö-valmennukseen 30.8. mennessä. Kerro hakemuksessasi, mikä motivoi sinua hakemaan valmennukseen, ja liitä mukaan CV:si.

Rekrytointiprosessi sisältää ryhmä- ja yksilöhaastattelun. Haastatteluista jatkoon etenevät ehdokkaat suorittavat henkilöarvioinnin.

Jäikö jokin mietityttämään? Tuutorit ja nykyinen S-Päällikkö-valmennettava vastaavat mielellään kysymyksiisi arkisin klo 9–15 välillä.

Kaupan alan tuutori:
Prismajohtaja Piia Laine puh. 010 764 4033

Matkailu- ja ravitsemuskaupan tuutori:
Ryhmäpäällikkö Katja Honkanen puh. 010 764 4219

Nykyinen S-Päällikkö-valmennettava:
Emil Gustafsson puh. 050400 0506

Turun Osuuskauppa on osa S-ryhmää ja yksi alueensa suurimmista työllistäjistä. Meillä työskentelet vakaassa organisaatiossa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja rakentamaan entistä parempia asiakaskokemuksia yhdessä ammattilaisten kanssa. Me Turun Osuuskaupassa työskentelemme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei tarkoita, että meillä olisi tylsää tai osaamatonta porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin! Meillä on harvinaisen hyvä työilmapiiri, epätavallisen hyvät henkilöstöedut ja poikkeuksellisen paljon monipuolisia työmahdollisuuksia. 82 % työntekijöistämme suositteleekin meitä työpaikkana. Meitä tokkilaisia on reilu 2600, ja työskentelemme neljällä eri toimialalla. Työskentelemme pilke silmäkulmassa ja tavoitteenamme on olla asiakkaiden ykkösvalinta! Lue lisää Turun Osuuskaupasta: Tietoa meistä – TOK.

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Train smart: follow your capacity, not just the physical activity guidelines Train slim
13 July
Ana Rodrigues
We all know that exercise is healthy. But how much exercise is actually enough? And do you always have to give it your all during every workout? The Dutch Physical Activity Guidelines provide a good starting point for this. For adults, the advice is to to exercise moderately intensely for at least 150 minutes per week, and to perform muscle- and bone-strengthening exercises at least twice a week. to do and limit prolonged sitting as much as possible. It is important to know that this no targets , but the minimum amount of exercise which is necessary to stay healthy.
However, in practice, we see that many people unconsciously deal with this in two ways. They either do too little because work, family, or other obligations always take precedence, or they deliberately try to perform at their maximum during every training session, even on days when their body is actually not ready for it. Listen to your body
No two days are the same. One day you feel energetic and strong, while on another you may have slept less well, be under a lot of stress, or simply feel more tired. That is precisely why it is important not only to follow a training schedule, but also to listen to your load capacity to check. A simple way to do this is to ask yourself one question before every training:
"How strong do I feel today? "
Give yourself a score of 0 to 10. - 8 to 10: Do you feel fit and energetic? Then feel free to challenge yourself a little extra. - 5 to 7: Great energy? Follow your normal training schedule. - 0 to 4: Low energy? Scale back the training slightl...

This fully funded 36-month postdoc project aims to test whether targeting the aminopeptidase ERAP2 can tackle EBV infection in Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and is a joint effort of our group at the Department of Ophthalmology of the UMC Utrecht and the ErasMS team at Erasmus MC Rotterdam. You will use state-of-the-art molecular and cellular techniques available at the Kuiper group and its collaborating labs to elucidate how ERAP2 shapes pathogenic immune responses and if this can be corrected with small molecular inhibitors.
This project aims to test whether targeting ERAP2 can selectively remove pathogenic EBV-infected B cells in MS. Almost everyone with MS carries EBV, and EBV-infected B cells help drive disease. ERAP2 shapes how these B cells present viral peptides to NK cells and CD8+ T cells.
- You will build disease-relevant cellular models of EBV-infected B cells, modulate ERAP2 activity, and read out the downstream consequences for antigen presentation, NK and CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity, and B cell survival. You will be embedded in the research group of Dr. Jonas Kuiper within the Center for Translational Immunology (CTI) at UMC Utrecht and collaborate closely with the groups of Dr. Marvin van Luijn and Dr. Joost Smolders at MS Center ErasMS in Rotterd...

jobs.title: Author
jobs.description:
EMA Centralised Procedure - Analysis of Marketing Authorisation Applications
Author
Cornelis Jansma
Published on
April 29, 2026
The European Medicines Agency (EMA) focus group on submission predictability monitoring report (H2-25 MAAs pipeline monitoring exercise) makes one thing clear: predictability in Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAA) is improving, but industry still has significant room to mature.
Key findings include: - 57% of MAAs were submitted on time, up from 48% in 2023. - Short-notice delays remain a major issue: over 60% of applicants provided less than 60 days' advance warning before shifting their submission date. - Justifications for delays are often missing or uninformative; only 73% of applicants who changed their plans provided a justification, and many cited internal resource constraints or planning issues. - Generics and biosimilars frequently bypass timely Letters of Intent, creating additional unpredictability. - While communication between applicants and regulators has improved, the overall planning reliability remains insufficient to support efficient workload allocation across the EU regulatory network.
The report concludes that although progress is visible, predictability challenges continue to strain regulatory resources, and further improvements in applicant planning and transparency are essential. EMA will continue monitoring but will shift focus toward new approaches aligned with the upcoming New Pharmaceutical Legislation.
With the regulatory network under increasing workload pressure, companies that invest in predictable, well-governed submission processes will be better positioned for smooth assessments and timely approvals.

Eawag, the Swiss Federal Institute of Aquatic Science and Technology, is an internationally networked aquatic research institute within the ETH Domain (Swiss Federal Institutes of Technology). Research Fundraiser (m/f/d) 80% \- 100%  
Would you like to help shape the fundraising activities of an internationally renowned environmental research institute? As part of the ETH Domain, Eawag offers a unique opportunity to build and further develop institutional fundraising in a collaborative and purpose\-driven environment. You will identify suitable funding opportunities and develop sustainable funding partnerships with foundations, institutional funding organisations, philanthropic partners and selected major donors. Working closely with researchers, the Directorate and the Communications team, you will develop compelling funding concepts that communicate Eawag's scientific strengths and strategic objectives in a clear and attractive way to funding partners  
This position offers you a high degree of responsibility and autonomy, as well as the opportunity to actively shape Eawag's fundraising activities and strategic partnerships.  
Your responsibilities  
Conduct research, analysis and identification of potential funding partners, in particular foundations and private major donors.  
Assess and evaluate research projects regarding their fundraising potential.  
Work closely with researchers to develop audience\-specific fundraising materials, such as funding cases, project proposals and progress reports.  
Build and maintain long\-term relationships with funding partners and donors, support the acquisition of new partners and manage funding partnerships throughout the entire funding cycle.  
Manage administrative fundraising processes, including contract management, payment processing and maintenance of data in the CRM system.  
In close collaboration with the Communications team, plan and coordinate visits and events for existing and potential funding partners and develop fundraising\-specific content for Eawag's communication channels.  
Your qualifications  
At least five years of professional experience in fundraising, ideally in foundation fundraising, institutional fundraising or major donor fundraising.  
Proven track record in developing successful funding proposals as well as establishing and maintaining long\-term funding partnerships.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, combined with a strong service\-oriented mindset. You build trusted relationships with internal and external stakeholders and collaborate effectively with different research groups.  
A structured and independent working style, with strong organisational skills.  
A strong interest in scientific topics, particularly environmental research; experience in research, higher education, environmental sustainability or healthcare is an advantage.  
Confident use of common digital tools, including CRM systems.  
You have excellent command of German or French and good knowledge of the other language. You are fluent in English at a professional level and able to communicate and negotiate confidently.  
At Eawag, we have a working environment in which people with different experiences, strengths, and perspectives can fully contribute and further develop. Here, you can help us advance! We promote genuine participation, exchange, and mutual understanding. We create structures that enable the compatibility of work and other areas of life, such as care work, and continuously make efforts to reduce barriers.  
Do you have specific requirements regarding the application process or the position, or do you need additional information? Talk to us about it \- we will be happy to support you with possible flexible workplace, working hours, and job design solutions. For further information please visit our website about Eawag as well as our conditions of employment.  
Applications must be submitted by September 15th, 2026, or until the position is filled. However, screening of applicants will begin immediately. Your application should include a cover letter giving a description of the motivation to apply and highlighting the relevant experience, curriculum vitae, and the names (with email addresses and phone numbers) of at least two potential references  
For further information, please contact , Deputy Director, via email.  
We look forward to receiving your application. Please send it through this webpage, as any other way of applying will not be considered. A click on the button below will take you directly to the application form.  
Applications from employment agencies/personnel consultants are not welcome and will not be considered.  
Apply now

jobs.title: Poêlier - Fumiste
jobs.description:
Poêlier-fumiste qualifié et autonome

Pour l’un de nos clients, nous recherchons un poêlier-fumiste qualifié, expérimenté et autonome pour intervenir sur des chantiers de construction, de rénovation ou chez des particuliers.

Vos missions :
Installer et monter des poêles, cheminées, foyers, conduits de fumée et systèmes d’évacuation selon les plans et les normes en vigueur.
Préparer le chantier, effectuer les prises de mesures et adapter les installations aux contraintes techniques du bâtiment.
Réaliser les raccordements, les habillages et les finitions avec soin.
Assurer les travaux de montage et les adaptations de maçonnerie, peinture, ferblanterie/couverture liées à l’installation.
Contrôler la conformité, l’étanchéité et le bon fonctionnement des installations.
Intervenir sur des travaux neufs, de rénovation, de transformation ou de remise en état.
Veiller au respect des normes techniques, des règles de sécurité et des prescriptions de protection incendie.

Votre profil :
Vous êtes qualifié ou expérimenté, capable de travailler de manière autonome.
Vous maîtrisez l’installation de poêles, cheminées et conduits de fumée.
Vous êtes précis, soigneux et attaché à la qualité du travail réalisé.
Vous savez lire les plans, prendre des mesures et vous adapter aux contraintes du chantier.
Vous êtes fiable, polyvalent et appréciez le travail bien fait.

jobs.title: Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%
jobs.description:
We are a world leading Engine MRO service provider, headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, with over 90 years of operational experience. Our unwavering dedication to innovation, excellence and environmental responsibility propels us forward on our journey to becoming the leading, most customer-centric, and sustainable Engine focused MRO worldwide.

Working with an extensive network of partners and business development offices in Europe, the USA, Asia and the Middle East, we offer comprehensive, fully customized solutions for the Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul of aircraft engines, airframes and components sales business including impeccable technical support to over 500 customers worldwide. Our mission: We safely power your flight.

We are looking for dedicated and skilled individuals to join our shop floor across several areas and departments at Zurich-Airport. If this sounds appealing to you, we encourage you to apply for our Supervisor position.

As a Supervisor Engine Shop Floor you will be responsible for the development and management of a highly effective Team of approximately 20 to 25 employees, striving for safety and quality, while delivering in time and on cost expectations. You will coordinate the team’s work with its direct stakeholders at SR Technics to the goals and missions of the organization.

Supervisor Engine Shop Floor 100%

Your tasks

- Promote a positive Safety Culture and ensure that Safety and Quality Policy are communicated/promoted and implemented within the Organization.
- Lead and manage a multi-cultural team, fostering performance, engagement, and a positive work environment.
- Drive performance culture through periodic target setting and regular structured follow up with all employees. Apply performance management process (PMP) and leadership with a focus on employee motivation.
- Plan and allocate resources to ensure high productivity and monitor labor efficiency
- Drive personnel development and skill management to meet capacity requirements (OJT, qualifications, certifications, performance evaluations).
- Execute and promote Continuous Improvements in applying Lean principles and 5S to achieve the organization targets and key performance indicators (KPI).
- Participate in, prepare for and be responsible for internal and external audits

Your Profile

- Technical background or technical education (aviation experience is a plus)
- Leadership experience with strong interpersonal skills and leadership skills with the ability to lead, motivate, and develop teams. Minimum 3 years team leadership or strong project leadership preferred.
- Excellent communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills in a fast-paced environment and strong focus on safety, quality, and cost efficiency
- Proactive, independent, and self-initiated working style with high performance drive
- Knowledge and experience in applying Lean/Six Sigma methodology
- Proficient in English (B2+), German is an advantage
- Proficiency with maintenance documentation systems. Microsoft Office required, SAP is an advantage

jobs.description:

We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Manager to manage our existing Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) business and lead the launch of an exciting new product across the Swiss German part of Switzerland. This role requires strong expertise in pharmaceutical sales, strategic planning and relationship-building with key healthcare professionals. The Account Manager will also work closely with marketing to create and implement impactful materials, projects and campaigns. While experience in Pulmonary Hypertension and rare diseases is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in pharmaceutical sales who are excited about launching a new product in a very specialized market.
Responsibilities:
•    Manage performance of Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) portfolio, lead the successful launch of a new Pulmonary arterial Hypertension (PAH) product, including market analysis, stakeholder engagement, implementation of launch strategy and monitor territory performance versus targets.
•    Build and maintain long-term partnerships with customers (Scientific Leaders, Specialists and specialized Nurses), through individual sales visits, promotional lectures and participation in congresses and educational events.
•    Ensure tailored account management for your assigned territory by understanding and mapping your customers, identifying Drivers and Barriers, understanding the patient journey and influencers on treatment decisions per account.
•    Engage in balanced product sales discussions including scientific data with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) to align the customer and business needs.
•    Stay up-to date on the latest product and therapeutic area information by attending internal trainings, conferences and symposia, as well as by self-study.
•    Drive tailored customer engagements, by using data and analytics to better understand the customer’s preference and by properly balancing physical and digital engagements.
•    Organize and co-create educational events for HCP’s including sponsorships in line with strategic priorities and budget constraints.
•    Demonstrating highest ethical principles conducting Local law, our company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulations.


Your Profile:

•    3-5 years of pharmaceutical or biotech sales experience, ideally in specialty care. Experience in Pulmonary Hypertension, Intestinal Lung Disease or Rare Diseases is a strong plus.
•    Degree in Life Sciences, medical/paramedical field or another relevant discipline with healthcare curriculum from an accredited institution. shqa Certification «Certified Pharma Sales Representative» is a strong plus.
•    Proven experience in managing an existing product portfolio and successfully launching a new product.
•    Strong track record of achieving sales targets and supporting marketing efforts in a complex medical environment.
•    Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.
•    Ability to manage multiple priorities, with strong organizational and strategic planning skills.
•    Experience collaborating with marketing teams to create and implement marketing materials, campaigns and projects.
•    Open to innovation and experimentation.
•    Fluent in German and additionally English.
•    Valid driver’s license.

Interpersonal capabilities:

•    Growth-mindset, strong team-player, results-oriented and proven ability to achieve ambitious goals.
•    Adaptable to change, ambiguity and a high level of resilience in the face of challenges.
•    Independent, motivated and highly organized.
•    Excellent interpersonal skills in communication, persuasion and customer relations.
•    Possessing a strong learning mindset.
•    Identification of challenges or obstacles and proactively ideate on solutions.
•    Data-driven decision-making and mindset.
•    Comfortable with commercial experimentation and implementing customer projects.

Additional information needed for the advert:
Relocation: None
Visa Sponsorship: None
Travel Requirements: 75%
Flexible Working Arrangements: No onsite
Shift: No
Valid Driver License: Yes
Hazardous Materials: No

THE COMPANY

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub. In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases. We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine. Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».  

We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.

One Roof is our new Swiss headquarters in Lucerne designed to bring teams together and make collaboration easier. Across 15,000 m² of modern office space, we unite colleagues from national, regional and global functions within different functions under one roof to strengthen cross functional cooperation and a ONE Team culture. The site is centrally located, a short walk from Lucerne train station, supporting sustainable commuting.

jobs.title: Expert Clinical Trial Documentation - Clinical Trial Associate
jobs.description:
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Become part of a vital chain and contribute to our common goal of making people’s lives better. Headquartered in Lachen, Switzerland, Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing medicines sourced from human plasma and human cell lines. We are a privately\-owned company, where the warmth of family meets the scale of a global organisation.  
Join us in shaping our vision to provide new health solutions advancing human life.  
Expert Clinical Trial Documentation \- Clinical Trial Associate (CTA)  
Your main tasks and responsibilities  
Set up and maintain Trial Master Files (TMFs) and lnvestigator Site Files (ISFs) according to Octapharma SOPs  
Support the Clinical Team in preparing clinical trial documents and documentation for regulatory submissions  
Track clinical trial documents such as insurance certificates, confidentiality agreements and study contracts throughout the trial lifecycle  
Maintain audit and inspection readiness through periodic review of TMF accuracy and completeness, quality control checks, and a unified TMF management approach. Support audits and inspection preparation and execution with regards to the TMF  
Act as a central contact for trial documentation, designated project communications, support ad hoc tasks  
Manage returning/archiving of TMF documents  
Assist in the organization of lnvestigator Meetings  
Perform various administrative tasks to support team members with clinical trial execution, as required (e.g. literature search or document formatting review for regulatory submissions)  
In addition, for the senior position:  
Assume Data Protection / Information Security Champion responsibilities  
Assists in development of SOPs  
Perform vendor evaluation and oversight for selected vendors  
Your expertise and ideal skill set  
A minimum of 1 year of experience as a CTA/documentation expert in international clinical trials or similar (3 years for the senior position)  
Fluent in both written and spoken English; preferably also in German  
Experience with various CTMS and TMF systems  
Excellent command of Microsoft Office applications and Adobe Acrobat DC  
Able to prioritize workload with attention to details and within timelines  
Able to learn on the job and apply new knowledge to future challenges  
Able to manage multiple and various tasks with a positive and flexible attitude  
Strong operational, organizational, documentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, able to work in a team and independently  
Your department \- where you make an impact  
The Clinical Research and Development (CR\&D) team in Lachen develops medicines that target complex and life\-threatening conditions in Haematology and Critical Care  
We specialize in clinical development of new as well as already marketed products  
The successful candidate will work closely with CPMs, CTMs, and colleagues across CR\&D in Lachen to support a wide variety of clinical trials  
This position reports to the Global Senior Director CR\&D in Lachen and is a permanent role within the team.  
“Join an international environment with exciting projects and responsibilities — be proactive, contribute, and grow together with a great team”  
\- Dr. Cristina Solomon, Global Vice President CRD Lachen  
Thrive with us  
You help save lives \- Every day is meaningful as we produce life\-saving medicines  
Family values \- Long\-term perspective for employees and relationships  
Be rewarded with market\-related salary and benefits package  
You will have a high level of influence where you can make a difference and leave your footprint  
Work with skilled and fun colleagues in a relatively informal organization  
Skills development \- We offer various internal and external employee and leadership trainings, trainee programs and digital solutions  
It´s in our blood  
We live diversity and stand for equal opportunities as an employer! We therefore look forward to receiving your application \- regardless of age, gender, origin, sexual orientation, and religion.  
Please apply in English.  
Do you have any questions? Then get in touch with your contact person.  
Vignau  
Senior Expert Talent \& Acquisition  
Octapharma AG  
Seidenstrasse 2, 8853 Lachen  
T:  
Want to find out more about us?  
Visit our website Octapharma Career and follow us daily on LinkedIn.  
About Octapharma  
Octapharma is one of the largest human protein manufacturers in the world, developing and producing human proteins from human plasma and human cell lines. We employ more than 11,000 people worldwide to support the treatment of patients in 120 countries with products across three therapeutic areas: Immunotherapy, Haematology and Critical Care. With seven R\&D sites and five state\-of\-the\-art manufacturing facilities in Austria, France, Germany, and Sweden, Octapharma also operates over 195 plasma donation centres across Europe and the US. With four decades of experience, we are committed to advancing patient care worldwide. jpid5481217jm jit0833jm jiy26jm

jobs.description:
AI Solution Engineer  
Job Description  
Our Data \& Analytics Team is growing, and we are looking for an AI/ML Solution Engineer to support and take responsibility for the following tasks:  
Deliver AI/ML solutions across LGT CP;  
Develop and test AI/ML solutions according to business needs;  
Further develop our proprietary, cloud\-based (Gen)AI infrastructure as the backbone of technical capabilities and deliveries;  
Re\-design business processes and simplify using data \& technologies;  
Extract business requirements and create technical specifications required to deliver AI/ML solutions as a bridge between business and technology teams;  
Design scalable and enterprise\-grade data and AI products, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical standards;  
Being a technological leader and go\-to person for the AI solution engineering team;  
Manage business stakeholders' expectations, ensure delivery and business adoption;  
Understand, explain, and interact on complex topics with both business and technical teams;  
Actively support and share knowledge across the extended Data \& Analytics team;  
Stay aligned with and be the spokesperson of the AI solution engineering team for the broader IT department, such as solution architecture, software engineering or cloud infrastructure teams.  
Requirements  
Must\-haves:  
University degree in computer science, data science, information technology, artificial intelligence, engineering, mathematics, statistics or any other STEM degree;  
At least 2 years of professional experiences in a related field, such as data science, software engineer, solution/AI engineer or similar;  
Strong knowledge and experience with , SQL and React (Typescript); additional knowledge in infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform) as well as Microsoft Azure is strongly preferred;  
In\-depth knowledge of generative AI technologies (LLMs) as well as traditional ML methods;  
Proven experience in implementing enterprise\-grade (Gen)AI/ML solutions  
Interest in and strong affinity with technology and a particular focus on AI/ML;  
Knowledge and understanding of software design and development principles in an enterprise\-context;  
Proven experience in working in large\-scale or complex technology landscapes is a plus;  
Excellent analytical and technical skills and attention to detail;  
Motivation to work at the intersection of technology, research and business;  
Great team player and ability to work collaboratively at various levels of the organization;  
Proactive personality who takes ownership and uses initiative;  
Fluency in English.  
Nice\-to\-haves:  
Experience in leading technical deliveries and delivery teams in the AI/ML space;  
Experience with modern cloud data toolsets, preferably Microsoft Azure;  
General knowledge about financial markets, preferably private markets;  
German skills.  
What you can expect  
We provide modern working conditions, including work\-from\-home options, flexible hours and a home office allowance to ensure staff members have a work environment equipped with the latest technology;  
A diverse culture founded on mutual respect, teamwork and appreciation awaits you at LGT Capital Partners. We go the extra mile to generate impact;  
We empower and invest in you: your professional development and personal growth are our priority. We offer various internal and external training opportunities that are aligned with your ambitions and our business needs. If you are interested, you can also enhance your German or English language skills;  
We are proud to be owned by the Princely Family of Liechtenstein and our company is inspired by its entrepreneurial spirit;  
Commitment to ESG: our approach to business is influenced by the Princely Family's long\-term perspective. Sustainability is key for us and has shaped our actions since 2002;  
You benefit from favorable terms and conditions if you wish to participate in LGT Capital Partners' investment programs or to use LGT banking products and services.  
Contact Information  
If you are interested in becoming an integral part of a successful alternative investment management team in an international, multicultural working environment we will be pleased to get to know you soon.  
For further information please contact us.  
Hohermuth  
Human Resources  
LGT Capital Partners AG, Pfaeffikon

jobs.title: Conducteur de Travaux - Rénovation & Transformation
jobs.description:
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Conducteur de Travaux \- Rénovation \& Transformation  
Description de l'entreprise  
Notre client est un acteur établi du secteur de la construction en Suisse romande. Grâce à son expertise technique, à ses équipes expérimentées et à sa capacité à mener des projets complexes, l'entreprise intervient sur des chantiers variés de rénovation, de transformation et de réhabilitation de bâtiments. Elle propose un environnement dynamique, axé sur la qualité, la sécurité et l'efficacité opérationnelle, au sein duquel chaque collaborateur bénéficie d'un réel niveau d'autonomie et de responsabilités.  
Description du poste  
Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous serez responsable de la préparation, de l'organisation et du suivi complet de vos chantiers de rénovation et de transformation, de la phase de préparation jusqu'à leur réalisation finale.  
Préparer les chantiers sur les plans technique, organisationnel et financier.  
Analyser les plans, les dossiers d'exécution et les spécificités liées aux bâtiments existants.  
Planifier les différentes étapes des travaux, notamment les besoins en personnel, en matériel et en équipements.  
Organiser le déroulement quotidien des chantiers et assurer leur exécution opérationnelle.  
Coordonner les équipes, les sous\-traitants et les différents corps de métier.  
Assurer la commande, l'approvisionnement et la disponibilité des matériaux nécessaires.  
Anticiper les éventuelles contraintes liées à l'occupation, à l'exploitation ou à la structure des bâtiments existants.

Spa \& Wellness Attendant 100% (w/m/i)  
ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung  
Eine Ikone der Hotellerie und eine Legende seit der sensationellen Eröffnung im Jahr 1873\. Gelegen auf dem Bürgenberg, einem 500 Meter hohen Felsvorsprung in der Zentralschweiz, zeichnet sich das Bürgenstock Resort Lake Lucerne durch gewagtes Design, bahnbrechende Nachhaltigkeit, atemberaubende Landschaften und modernste Freizeitangebote aus. Rund 700 Mitarbeitende aus 54 Nationen sorgen für exzellente Gastfreundschaft und bieten den perfekten Rahmen für Momente jenseits der Vorstellungskraft.  
Drei exklusive Hotels, das Bürgenstock Hotel \& Alpine Spa (5\* Superior) mit den beiden Übernachtungsmöglichkeiten The Contemporary und The Heritage, das Waldhotel by Bürgenstock (5\* Superior) und die Taverne 1879 (3\*) stehen den Gästen zur Verfügung. Jedes dieser Häuser versteht es, eine einzigartige Atmosphäre zu kreieren. Zwölf Restaurants, Lounges und Bars sind das Schaufenster für kulinarische Exzellenz; im preisgekrönten Bürgenstock Alpine Spa und Waldhotel Spa finden Gäste die ultimative Entspannung. Das Resort ist nicht nur eine Traumdestination für Reisende aus aller Welt, sondern auch ein Arbeitsplatz mit hervorragender Unternehmenskultur.  
Das Bürgenstock Resort erhielt das dritte Jahr in Folge die offizielle Zertifizierung als "Great Place to Work" der Schweiz \- eine Auszeichnung, die das gesamte Team mit erfüllt.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab August 2026 oder nach Vereinbarung eine Persönlichkeit als

Die Reinigung und der Unterhalt der Spa Anlagen (Innen und Aussenbereich)  
Aufräumen, Aufwischen, Desinfizieren und Abstauben der Saunaräumlichkeiten, Umkleidekabinen, Toiletten, Poolanlagen sowie der Behandlungs\- und Fitnessräume  
Betreuen der SPA\-Gäste sowie die Aufsicht im ganzen Spa Bereich  
Auffüllen von Verbrauchmaterialien sowie allgemeine Aufräumarbeiten im Spa
