Erfahrungen im Housekeeping oder in der Spa Reinigung setzten wir voraus  
körperlich Belastbar, um auch in sehr warmen Räumen arbeiten zu können (Innenpool, Sauna, Garderobe usw.)  
gepflegtes, freundliches und zuvorkommendes Auftreten  
Sie sprechen Deutsch oder Englisch  
Freude im Umgaben mit den Spa Gästen und im Team zu arbeiten

Neben einem modernen Arbeitsplatz profitieren Sie von zahlreichen attraktiven Mitarbeiterangeboten und Vergünstigungen. Das Personalhaus verfügt über ein eigenes Fitnessstudio, eine TV\-Lounge, einen Billardraum sowie eine Bibliothek. Weitere Vorteile umfassen Vergünstigungen für Tennis, Golf, Sportartikel, Versicherungen, Gruppenkurse und REKA\-Checks.

November, und verantworten die selbständige Durchführung der Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende. Selbständige Durchführung der monatlichen Lohnverarbeitung für über 1'000 Mitarbeitende in der Schweiz.  
Sicherstellung einer korrekten und termingerechten Lohnverarbeitung inklusive Payroll Accounting, Lohnausweisen und Jahresendverarbeitung.  
Pflege und Validierung lohnrelevanter Personal\-, Organisations\- und Vergütungsdaten zur Gewährleistung einer korrekten und gesetzeskonformen Lohnverarbeitung über den gesamten Employee Lifecycle.  
Betreuung und Durchführung payrollrelevanter Prozesse in Workday, SAP und weiteren angebundenen HR\-Systemen.  
Übernahme der Rolle als Subject Expert für Swiss Payroll, Time \& Absence, Sozialversicherungen und Steuern sowie Sicherstellung der Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben und Best Practices.

Verarbeitung und Abstimmung von Payroll\-Daten, Erstellung von Payroll\-Auswertungen und Analysen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Finance bei Kontenabstimmungen sowie HR\-relevanten Rückstellungen.  
Verantwortung für interne und externe Payroll\-Audits als zentrale Ansprechperson seitens HR sowie Sicherstellung der termingerechten und korrekten Bereitstellung von Dokumentationen, Daten und Abstimmungen.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant & Private PA to the Chairman & CEO
jobs.description:
Executive Assistant \& Private PA to the Chairman \& CEO  
About the Company  
A privately owned investment holding based in Zurich. Through its operating companies, it develops strategic resources at origin, alongside proprietary investments in emerging technologies.  
The Zurich team is small and senior, with short decision paths — this role has direct visibility and impact.  
We are looking for an organized, responsible, and proactive assistant who combines classic executive assistance to our Chairman \& CEO with corporate and office support for the Zurich team — and, distinctively, with private and family support for the principal. This is a true right\-hand role spanning both the professional and private spheres, suited to someone who enjoys variety, takes genuine ownership, and treats discretion as second nature.  
Key Responsibilities  
Executive Assistance to the CEO  
Book and manage international travel (flights, hotels, visas), both European and global  
Proactively manage the CEO's calendar across time zones, anticipating conflicts and protecting focus time  
Prepare meeting briefings, agendas, and follow\-ups; track action items to completion  
Track and process expenses per the group's expense policy  
Act as first point of contact for the CEO's calendar and correspondence, exercising sound judgment on prioritization and access  
Corporate \& Governance Support  
Support board meeting logistics (scheduling, board packs, resolutions)  
Maintain document retention and archiving across group entities  
Track statutory and filing deadlines  
Liaise with external providers (fiduciary, insurance broker, external counsel, banks) on administrative matters  
Private \& Family Support  
Schedule and track personal appointments for the principal and family (medical, dental, and similar), including reminders and follow\-ups  
Coordinate children's school administration and communications, extracurricular activities, and related logistics — largely in German  
Plan and book private and family travel and holidays  
Handle household administration: insurance policies, vehicle matters (registration, servicing, appointments), property\-related paperwork, and coordination of contractors and service providers  
Manage personal errands, purchases, gifting, and restaurant and event reservations  
Serve as a reliable point of coordination between the office, the household, and the family  
Office Management \& Cross\-Jurisdictional Coordination  
Support day\-to\-day operations of the Zurich office (supplies, facilities, visitors, mail)  
Assist with administrative coordination across the group's international entities  
Candidate Profile  
Required  
Experience as a Personal/Executive Assistant, Private PA, or in a comparable role supporting senior leadership, a principal, or a family  
Fluent English and German (written and spoken) — German is essential for schools, medical providers, and Swiss administration  
Experience organizing complex international travel  
High discretion; able to handle confidential legal, HR, financial, family, and household information responsibly  
Comfortable working closely with a family as well as an executive team, and able to move naturally between the two  
Proactive, hands\-on, solutions\-oriented; comfortable in a small, lean team without heavy bureaucracy  
Strong MS Office skills; comfortable learning new tools  
Valid Swiss work permit or EU/EFTA citizenship  
Advantageous  
Prior experience in a family office, private household, or entrepreneur\-led environment  
Familiarity with the Swiss school system and local administrative processes  
Additional languages (e.g., French)

This is an on\-site role based in central Zurich during normal office hours. Given the private\-support dimension, occasional flexibility outside standard hours is expected for time\-sensitive personal or travel matters; this is managed reasonably and reciprocated with flexibility in return.

Direct, daily exposure to the Chairman/CEO, the COO, and board\-level operations in an entrepreneurial, international holding group  
A genuinely varied role combining classic PA/EA work, corporate operations exposure, and private/family support  
A position of real trust with meaningful autonomy and short decision paths  
A small, senior, non\-bureaucratic team  
Central Zurich office location  
Competitive compensation, commensurate with the breadth and seniority of the role

Please submit your CV and a short cover note via this platform. The employer is not named at this stage for reasons of strategic confidentiality. Full company details will be disclosed to shortlisted candidates before the interview process.

jobs.description:
Contrôleur de gestion  
WHYNESS DVLP\-RH\-Services Sàrl, est un cabinet de recrutement actif en Suisse romande. Nous accompagnons les entreprises dans le recrutement et la sélection de cadres et spécialistes, tout en offrant aux candidats un accompagnement personnalisé dans leurs évolutions et transitions de carrière. Notre approche se distingue par un haut niveau d’exigence, une relation humaine de confiance et une confidentialité absolue, tant pour les entreprises que pour les talents que nous accompagnons. Nos interventions s’inscrivent principalement dans les secteurs de l’horlogerie, de l’industrie et des services, pour des fonctions clés et ou à responsabilité.  
Dans ce cadre, nous recherchons actuellement un / une :  
Contrôleur de gestion (H/F/X)  
Création de fonction \- poste fixe \| Horlogerie \| La Chaux\-de\-Fonds  
Dans le cadre d'une création de poste, nous accompagnons aujourd'hui une PME industrielle d'environ 70 collaborateurs basée à La Chaux\-de\-Fonds et reconnue pour son savoir\-faire dans la sous\-traitance horlogère.  
Afin d'accompagner sa croissance et de renforcer le pilotage de sa performance, nous recherchons un(e) :  
Contrôleur de Gestion Industriel (H/F)  
Votre mission  
Rattaché(e) à la Direction, vous prenez la responsabilité de créer, structurer et développer la fonction contrôle de gestion au sein de l'entreprise.  
Véritable partenaire des équipes opérationnelles et de la Direction, vous apportez une vision claire et factuelle de la performance économique de l'entreprise. Votre rôle consiste à transformer les données financières et industrielles en indicateurs pertinents permettant d'orienter les décisions stratégiques et opérationnelles.  
Dans cette fonction à forte autonomie, vous serez notamment amené(e) à :  
•Mettre en place les outils, méthodes et indicateurs de contrôle de gestion adaptés à l'activité industrielle  
•Construire et assurer le suivi des tableaux de bord de pilotage destinés à la Direction et aux responsables de département  
•Analyser les coûts de production, les marges, les écarts et la rentabilité des différentes activités  
•Participer à l'élaboration des prix de revient et des analyses de rentabilité par produit, client ou activité  
•Accompagner les responsables de production dans le suivi de leurs indicateurs et la compréhension des résultats  
•Identifier les leviers d'amélioration de la performance industrielle et financière  
•Participer à l'établissement des budgets, forecasts et plans d'action  
•Réaliser des analyses ponctuelles destinées à soutenir les décisions stratégiques de l'entreprise  
•Structurer et fiabiliser les données issues des différents systèmes de gestion  
•Participer à l'évolution des outils de reporting et à l'amélioration des processus de pilotage  
Votre profil  
•Formation supérieure en Finance, Contrôle de Gestion ou Économie d'entreprise (HEG, Université ou équivalent)  
•Première expérience réussie dans une fonction de contrôle de gestion en environnement industriel suisse  
•Bonne compréhension des mécanismes de production et des enjeux liés aux coûts industriels  
•Solides capacités d'analyse, de synthèse et d'interprétation des données  
•Excellente maîtrise d'Excel ainsi qu'une forte aisance avec les outils informatiques  
•Expérience avec un ERP industriel et idéalement avec des outils de Business Intelligence (Power BI ou équivalent)  
•Sensibilité aux systèmes d'information et à la qualité des données  
•Capacité à travailler de manière autonome et à construire une fonction nouvellement créée  
•Excellentes compétences relationnelles et de communication, vous permettant d'interagir efficacement avec des interlocuteurs variés, de l'atelier à la Direction  
•Personnalité pragmatique, rigoureuse, proactive et orientée résultats  
Notre client vous offre :  
•Une opportunité rare de créer et développer une fonction stratégique au sein d'une entreprise reconnue dans son domaine  
•Une grande autonomie et une forte proximité avec la Direction  
•Un environnement industriel stimulant, mêlant expertise technique et exigence de qualité  
•Un rôle transverse au coeur des décisions de l'entreprise  
•La possibilité d'avoir un impact concret et durable sur la performance de l'organisation  
•Des conditions d'engagement en adéquation avec les responsabilités du poste  
Vous souhaitez relever un défi entrepreneurial au sein d'une PME agile et reconnue, où votre expertise contribuera directement à structurer le pilotage et la performance de l'entreprise ?  
Notre approche du recrutement  
Chez WHYNESS, chaque candidature est avant tout une rencontre.  
Nous prenons le temps de comprendre votre parcours, votre savoir\-faire et vos aspirations.  
Notre engagement :  
Vous rencontrer pour comprendre qui vous êtes  
Mettre en valeur votre expertise  
Vous accompagner avec transparence et exigence  
Transformer une opportunité en collaboration durable

jobs.description:
At Ypsomed, we are shaping the future of medical technology together \- with the aim of sustainably improving the quality of life for people with chronic conditions. We promote an open corporate culture in which diversity is valued, and new perspectives are welcome. Our employees take responsibility, work in an interdisciplinary manner and develop innovative solutions with real added value for society.  
As our Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead, you will build and grow Ypsomed's Human Factors service offering for pharmaceutical partners worldwide. With your expertise, you will help deliver user\-centered solutions that support successful regulatory approvals.  
Human Factors Engineer \& Service Lead \| 80 \- 100%  
Ref. No. 7961  
Location: Burgdorf \| Hybrid

Take end\-to\-end responsibility for establishing Human Factors (HF) as a service offering and drive the acquisition of HF service projects in close collaboration with Business Development  
Act as a trusted advisor to pharmaceutical customers on HF strategies for combination products, with a strong focus on efficient regulatory pathways and ensuring that service offerings are aligned with customer needs  
Conduct and coordinate international HF studies, including setting timelines and budgets and planning, monitoring, and documenting formative, summative, and comparative use HF studies, including studies involving large participant cohorts

Executive Assistant \- LE4 \- DFAT \- Geneva  
About The Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade  
The role of the Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT) is to advance the interests of Australia and Australians internationally. This involves strengthening Australia’s security, enhancing Australia’s prosperity, delivering an effective and high\-quality overseas aid program and helping Australian travellers and Australians overseas. The department provides foreign, trade and development policy advice to the Australian Government. DFAT also works with other Australian Government agencies to drive coordination of Australia’s pursuit of global, regional and bilateral interests.  
About the Position  
Under direction, the Executive Assistant to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador provides high\-level executive, administrative and organisational support at the Australian Permanent Mission to the United Nations in Geneva. The position also organises official events and functions.  
Due to the sensitive nature of the work involved, this position will need to be able to hold and maintain a national security clearance recognised by DFAT.  
Key responsibilities of the position include but are not limited to:  
Provide high\-level executive support to the Ambassador and Deputy Ambassador, ensuring the effective operation of executive offices in a fast\-paced and sensitive environment.  
Manage and prioritise correspondence, invitations, briefing materials and requests, exercising sound judgement to determine priority, action and compliance requirements.  
Coordinate official visits and delegation programs for Ministers, senior officials and high\-level visitors, balancing competing priorities and operational requirements.  
Plan and deliver representational events, meetings and official engagements, liaising with internal and external stakeholders to achieve Mission objectives.  
Manage representational expenditure and financial administration, including forecasting, acquittals, reconciliations and reporting in accordance with DFAT policies and procedures.  
Coordinate travel, logistics and related administrative arrangements for executive leadership and official activities, ensuring compliance with relevant policies and procedures.  
Monitor security, operational and workflow risks, implementing required controls and escalating issues as appropriate.  
Provide administrative guidance, maintain effective business systems and support team coordination, contributing to continuous improvement and organisational effectiveness.  
Required Qualifications/Experience/Knowledge/Skills  
Proven experience in similar Executive Assistant role/s  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Ability to work with and support a team. Ability to develop and maintain respectful and effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders  
Ability to manage time, prioritise, plan, handle multiple tasks and work well under pressure  
Financial management and organisational skills  
Discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential information  
Extensive experience using Microsoft Office and electronic applications  
Exceptional customer service and interpersonal skills  
Fluency in English is required, with fluency in French highly regarded  
Knowledge of, or an ability to quickly acquire a knowledge of Australian Government legislation or departmental policy and guidelines in relation to the position duties  
Desirable  
Previous experience working in an embassy, international organisation, or comparable environment.  
Security Requirements  
Australian NV2 security clearance or the ability to obtain and maintain this. Therefore applicants must hold Australian citizenship to be considered.  
Please note that candidates who hold citizenship or dual citizenship of Switzerland are not eligible for an Australian Security Clearance.  
How to Apply  
Where the application form asks for a cover letter, please provide a written pitch of no more than 500 words demonstrating your suitability to perform the key responsibilities of the position. Your pitch is your opportunity to tell us why you are the right candidate for the role. It will be assessed on your ability to demonstrate, or have the potential to develop, the required skills, knowledge, experience and qualifications to proficiently perform the role. Relevant examples and accomplishments will strengthen your application. Please attach a copy of your pitch with your CV.

jobs.title: Femme / Valet de Chambre
jobs.description:
Intitulé du poste:  Femme / Valet de Chambre
Département : Housekeeping
Supérieur hiérarchique: Gouvernante et Property Manager.
Lieu de travail: Établissement hôtelier de luxe – Hôtel 5 étoiles, résidences privées et chalets de prestige.
Type de contrat
•    CDD saisonnier
•    Temps plein
•    Horaires variables incluant les week-ends, jours fériés et périodes de forte activité
Mission du poste
La Femme / le Valet de Chambre est responsable de l'entretien, du nettoyage et de la remise en état des chambres, suites, appartements, chalets et espaces privatifs confiés, dans le respect des standards de qualité de l'établissement. Il/elle veille à offrir aux clients un environnement irréprochable, confortable et accueillant, tout en garantissant la discrétion, la confidentialité et un service d'excellence.
Responsabilités principales
Entretien des chambres et espaces privatifs
•    Assurer le nettoyage complet des chambres, suites, appartements et chalets selon les standards de l'établissement.
•    Effectuer les remises à blanc et les recouches.
•    Nettoyer et désinfecter les salles de bains.
•    Changer le linge de lit, le linge de bain et les peignoirs.
•    Réapprovisionner les produits d'accueil, minibars, consommables et fournitures.
•    Contrôler le bon fonctionnement des équipements et signaler toute anomalie technique.
Qualité et standards de luxe
•    Garantir une qualité de nettoyage irréprochable jusque dans les moindres détails.
•    Respecter les standards de présentation définis par l'établissement.
•    Préparer les chambres selon les demandes spécifiques des clients (VIP, anniversaires, demandes particulières, etc.).
•    Vérifier que chaque chambre est prête à accueillir les clients dans les meilleures conditions.
Gestion du linge et du matériel
•    Utiliser correctement les produits de nettoyage et les équipements mis à disposition.
•    Veiller au bon entretien du matériel de travail.
•    Réapprovisionner quotidiennement son chariot de service.
•    Gérer le linge sale et le linge propre selon les procédures internes.
•    Respecter les procédures de gestion des objets trouvés.
Hygiène, sécurité et environnement
•    Respecter les normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et les procédures internes.
•    Utiliser les produits d'entretien conformément aux recommandations.
•    Respecter les consignes relatives au tri des déchets et aux démarches environnementales de l'établissement.
•    Maintenir les offices, réserves et locaux Housekeeping propres et organisés.
Relation client
•    Saluer les clients avec courtoisie et professionnalisme.
•    Répondre aux demandes simples des clients ou les orienter vers le service compétent.
•    Faire preuve de discrétion et respecter strictement la confidentialité des informations concernant les clients.
•    Représenter en permanence les valeurs et l'image de l'établissement.
Travail en équipe
•    Collaborer avec les Gouvernantes, la Réception, la Maintenance, le Spa, le Room Service et les autres départements.
•    Participer aux briefings quotidiens.
•    Informer immédiatement sa hiérarchie de toute anomalie ou situation particulière.
Profil recherché
Formation
•    Formation en hôtellerie ou Housekeeping appréciée.
•    Une formation interne peut être assurée.
Expérience
•    Expérience d'au moins 1 an dans un poste similaire souhaitée.
•    Une expérience en hôtellerie de luxe (4 ou 5 étoiles), palaces ou résidences de prestige constitue un atout majeur.
Compétences techniques
•    Maîtrise des techniques de nettoyage hôtelier.
•    Bonne connaissance des produits d'entretien.
•    Connaissance des standards de qualité de l'hôtellerie de luxe.
•    Capacité à organiser efficacement son travail.
•    Respect strict des procédures internes.
Compétences personnelles
•    Sens aigu du détail.
•    Excellente organisation.
•    Discrétion et confidentialité.
•    Rigueur.
•    Rapidité d'exécution.
•    Sens du service.
•    Polyvalence.
•    Esprit d'équipe.
•    Bonne condition physique.
•    Gestion du temps et des priorités.
Langues
•    Une connaissance du français ou de l'anglais est souhaitée.
•    Toute autre langue constitue un avantage.
Conditions particulières
•    Travail debout prolongé.
•    Port de charges légères à modérées.
•    Horaires variables incluant les week-ends et jours fériés.
•    Respect des standards de présentation et de l'uniforme de l'établissement.
•    Respect absolu de la confidentialité et de la vie privée des clients.
Objectifs de performance
•    Garantir un niveau de propreté irréprochable conforme aux standards de l'établissement.
•    Respecter les temps de nettoyage définis tout en maintenant un haut niveau de qualité.
•    Assurer la satisfaction des clients grâce à un environnement impeccable.
•    Respecter les procédures d'hygiène, de sécurité et de qualité.
•    Contribuer à l'image d'excellence et de prestige de l'établissement.
Qualités recherchées
•    Sens de l'excellence.
•    Passion du travail bien fait.
•    Discrétion.
•    Sens des responsabilités.
•    Esprit d'équipe.
•    Fiabilité.
•    Ponctualité.
•    Adaptabilité.
•    Motivation.
•    Respect des standards de qualité.

jobs.description:
Zur Unterstützung unseres IT Business Applikationen Teams suchen wir per sofort eine/n  
Werkstudentin / Werkstudent Administration Klinikinformations\-System  
50\-50%  
Der Querschnittsbereich Innovations\- und Digitalisierungsmanagement (IDM) umfasst die Abteilungen Unternehmensentwicklung und Informatik und bündelt damit bisher eigenständig operierende Bereiche sowie dezentrale Projekte der PDAG. Als Teil der Unternehmensstrategie plant und entwickelt er Innovationen für das Unternehmen und setzt diese eigenständig sowie in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Providern um. Zusätzlich ist er für das Funktionieren und die Weiterentwicklung der IT\-Infrastruktur sowie bestehender und neuer Applikationen, wie zum Beispiel ORBIS, zuständig. Als neugeschaffener Geschäftsbereich trägt der IDM wesentlich zur Zukunftsfähigkeit der PDAG im sich wandelnden Gesundheitswesen bei.  
Profil  
Sie studieren und sind ein immatrikulierter Student/Studentin  
Sie besitzen analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse in den gängigen MS Office\-Produkten (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), Visio ist wünschenswert  
Sie sind verantwortungsbewusst, haben sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Sprache und Schrift  
Sie schätzen die Möglichkeit zu selbstorganisiertem Arbeiten und besitzen die Bereitschaft, sich in eine oder mehrere Fachapplikationen und Thematiken einzuarbeiten  
Sie besitzen Erfahrung in Protokollierung von Meetings / Aufgaben generell  
Aufgaben  
Erfassen, Mutieren und Beenden von Berechtigungen gem. Berechtigungskonzept und Sonderrechten gemäss Auftrag im Klinikinformations\-System (Orbis)  
Erstellen von definierten Auswertungen  
Administrative Tätigkeiten Terminabklärungen, Ablage von Dokumenten, Erstellen von Prozessdiagrammen, Vorgabedokumenten für die Parametrierung, (Projekt)\-Besprechungen  
Protokolle verfassen, Dokumente redigieren  
Erfassen von Stammdaten nach Vorgabe  
Mitarbeit bei der Erstellung von Schulungsunterlage  
Unterstützung der Mitarbeiter im Bereich der Terminverwaltung und dem Erstellen von Textbausteinen  
Benefits  
Unsere Mitarbeitenden sind das Herz unseres Unternehmens. Genau deshalb bieten wir Ihnen auch sehr viel: Weiterbildungen werden bei uns stark gefördert. Daneben bieten wir attraktive Vergünstigungen bei bekannten Marken wie Ikea, Zalando, Coop, Lidl und vielen mehr. Mitarbeitende, die mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln zu uns pendeln, erhalten am Ende des Jahres einen stattlichen Öko\-Bonus ausbezahlt. Zusätzlich bieten wir eine attraktive Pensionskassenlösung an. Fragen zur Stelle?  
APV Business Applikationen

jobs.title: Social Media & Community Engagement Officer
jobs.description:
Join MSF OCG as a Social Media & Community Engagement Officer in Geneva!
We are looking for passionate candidates ready to contribute to our humanitarian mission.
Below, you will find the job details and the qualifications we are looking for.
Inclusivity and Diversity at MSF
Do your qualifications and experience not exactly match all requirements of the job?
At MSF OCG, we are committed to an inclusive culture that supports and amplifies the diverse voices of our staff members. We strive to create workplaces where teams of people with diverse backgrounds, characteristics, perspectives, ideas and experiences work together to advance MSF's social mission and create better outcomes for our patients and the communities we work with.
We understand that some people may hesitate to apply for employment if they don't meet all listed job requirements. Research shows that this is especially true for women. If you believe your profile is a good match for this position, we invite you to apply even if you don’t fulfil every listed qualification.
We encourage applications from individuals of all genders, ages, sexual orientations, ethnicities, background, religions, beliefs, ability status, and all other diversity characteristics.
MSF does not tolerate sexual exploitation and abuse, any kind of discrimination or harassment, including sexual harassment. All selected candidates will undergo reference checks.

Context & mission
Médecins Sans Frontières is an independent, international medical and humanitarian organization that provides care to people in need, people affected by natural or man-made disasters, and victims of armed conflict, without discrimination and without regard to race, religion, creed or political affiliation (MSF Charter).
The MSF movement is built around 5 operational centers supported by 24 sections and offices worldwide. MSF Operational Center Geneva (MSF OCG) is one of these centers.
The mission is to develop and implement MSF Switzerland's organic social media approach for French-speaking audiences, strengthening audience engagement and supporting broader digital supporter journeys. Ensure social media channels contribute to awareness, engagement, advocacy and supporter acquisition through relevant content, community engagement and platform-specific practices.

Tasks & Responsibilities
Define and implement the organic social media approach : define and implement the organic social media strategy for French-speaking audiences, ensuring channel priorities, editorial choices and audience engagement support MSF Switzerland's digital engagement objectives.
Develop and maintain social media standards and playbooks: develop and continuously improve platform-specific playbooks, editorial standards and community engagement practices to ensure consistency, quality and effective use of social media channels.
Lead social media editorial planning and content adaptation: lead the planning, adaptation and editorial framing of social media content, ensuring messages are relevant, accessible and aligned with audience needs, organisational priorities and platform requirements.
Monitor and optimise social media performance: in collaboration with the digital analyst, analyse performance data, audience insights and engagement trends to identify opportunities, improve content effectiveness and refine social media approaches.
Manage and strengthen online communities: manage community engagement across priority social media channels, fostering meaningful interactions and encouraging audiences to take appropriate actions within the broader digital engagement journey.
Coordinate digital initiatives: coordinate and contribute to digital projects, campaigns and activations, ensuring alignment between social media activities and wider digital communication objectives.
Contribute to digital innovation and knowledge sharing: identify emerging trends, platform developments and best practices, translating insights into recommendations that enhance digital engagement activities and organisational learning.
Supervise and support the Digital Engagement Unit intern: supervise, guide and develop the French-speaking Digital Engagement Unit intern, ensuring quality delivery, skill development and alignment with team priorities.

Your profile
Education
Bachelor's degree in digital communication, digital marketing or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.

Experience
Experience in digital communication with a focus on social media management.
Experience developing and implementing organic social media strategies, editorial planning and platform-specific content approaches.
Experience engaging online audiences and supporting digital engagement objectives.
Experience contributing to cross-functional projects and campaigns.
Experience supporting or supervising junior contributors is an asset

Languages
French : fluency.
English : C1.
German is an asset (B1).

Skills/ Technical competencies
Knowledge of organic social media management, particularly Facebook, Instagram and YouTube.
Understanding of audience engagement, content performance and social media analytics.
Understanding of platform trends, content formats and community management practices.
Awareness of humanitarian communication principles and sensitive operational contexts.
Editorial judgement and content adaptation.
Audience engagement and relationship building.
Analytical and problem-solving skills.
Planning and project coordination.
Collaboration and stakeholder management.
Adaptability in changing environments.
Creativity and trends adaptation.

Terms of employment
Full-time position 100% (40h/week)
Open-ended contract
Working place: Geneva
Ideal start date: October 2026
Gross annual salary (for 100%): from CHF 87’372.- to CHF 100’608.- (salary commensurate with equivalent experience and internal salary grid)
Paid vacation: 25 days per year, prorate temporis, plus any Swiss public holidays falling within the contract period.
Pension plan: pension contribution covered 3/4 by MSF, 1/4 by staff member.
Relocation support available for eligible candidates.

How to apply
Candidates are invited to submit their application exclusively through our recruitment platform, following these guidelines:
CV (maximum 2 pages)
Cover letter (maximum 1 page)
Documents must be submitted in either English or French.
The application deadline is September  6th, 2026.

We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if we receive a sufficient number of quality applications.
All applications will be treated confidentially.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Please note that we do not wish to use the services of recruitment or placement agencies.

Making Future

Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du skal have en mindre opsparing med, da du ofte først får fuld løn efter en måned. Der kan være udgifter til depositum og husleje, som skal betales ved ankomst. Vi hjælper dig med at afklare kontraktforhold, boligmuligheder, sundhedsforsikring og opsigelsesvilkår.   • Kvalitetssikring af samværsbeskrivelser.

  • Udarbejdelse af statusrapporter på baggrund af den samlede dokumentation.

  • Udarbejdelse af underretninger på baggrund af observationer og dokumentation.

  • Kvalitetssikring af socialfaglige formuleringer, objektivitet, grammatik og sprog.

er det dig?

Vil du være med til at skabe de bedste rammer for idræt, fællesskab og lokale aktiviteter i Ilskov? Som centerleder får du ansvaret for, at Ilskov Hallen fortsat er et velfungerende samlingspunkt for byens borgere, foreninger og gæster.

 

Dine arbejdsopgaver

-Drift og vedligehold: Dagligt tilsyn med hallen, rengøring, klargøring, mindre reparationer og opfølgning på fejl og mangler.

-Administration: Håndtering af bookinger, udlejning, fakturering og kontakt til brugere og foreninger.

-Udendørs og praktiske opgaver: Ansvar for udearealer og løbende vedligehold.

-Arrangementer: Planlægning, koordinering og afvikling af arrangementer i Ilskov Hallen.

-Samarbejde: Tæt samarbejde med halbestyrelsen, foreningerne, skolen, daginstitutionen og øvrige brugere af hallen.

 

Vi forventer

-Du er imødekommende, serviceminded og god til mennesker.

-Du arbejder struktureret og selvstændigt.

-Du kan planlægge og strukturere din egen arbejdsuge. Som udgangspunkt fordeles arbejdstiden på hverdage fra mandag til fredag, men der kan forekomme aften- og weekendarbejde i forbindelse med arrangementer og aktiviteter.

jobs.description:
We are looking for a **reliable and active part-time cleaner** to join our team for the winter season in Rovaniemi. The job starts at the **beginning of November 2026 and continues until the end of March 2027**.

The work is varied and you will work in different locations around Rovaniemi. Our customers include **local businesses, Airbnb apartments and other holiday accommodation**. Sometimes you may also help at our laundry.

Working days can be **any day from Monday to Sunday, including weekends**. Working hours can change depending on the day, but most shifts are between **8:00 and 18:00**.

We are looking for someone who enjoys active and varied work. You should be able to work independently, take responsibility for your work and notice what needs to be done.

Your tasks include

- cleaning Airbnb apartments and other accommodation

- cleaning local businesses and other work spaces

- helping at our laundry when needed


The locations and tasks can be different every day. The most important thing is to make sure that every place is **clean, tidy and ready for the next guest or customer**.

What we expect from you

- a positive and active attitude

- careful and good-quality work

- ability to work independently

- ability to work on weekdays and weekends


A driving licence and the ability to drive a manual car are **required for this job**, because you will drive between different locations during the working day.

**Previous cleaning experience is a plus**, especially if you have worked with Airbnb apartments, hotels or business cleaning before. However, experience is not everything. A good attitude, willingness to learn and taking responsibility for your work are very important to us.

**English skills are a plus.**

Most of the time you will work independently, but sometimes you will also work together with other team members.

What we offer

- a job for the full winter season, from **November 2026 until the end of March 2027**

- different tasks and working days

- training before you start working independently

- a friendly and supportive team


Interested?

We are looking for someone who is **reliable, active and ready to work**. If you like varied work and enjoy seeing the results of your work, this could be a good job for you.

Please tell us briefly about yourself and your previous work experience in your application. We will review applications during the application period, so please send your application as soon as possible.

**The application deadline is 13 September 2026.**

jobs.title: Senior Independent Software Developer
jobs.description:
You must be located in the Americas, Europe, or Israel to apply.


A·Team is a VC-backed, stealth, application-only home on the internet for senior independent software builders to team up with hand-picked, high-growth companies on their next big thing. 

After talking with hundreds of independent engineers, designers, and product folks, we heard over and over that finding vetted, high-quality, consistent clients is hard, and projects are often too small to be rewarding. A·Team matches small teams of the most talented builders in the world with companies backed by a16z, YC, Softbank, General Catalyst, etc. on a contract basis for many of their most important initiatives. We quietly launched in May 2020, and have helped A·Teamers earn $85+ million since.

As part of A·Team, you can expect:

  • High-paying, meaningful missions with the most audacious companies sent your way; generally $90-$150+/hr, with vetted, fascinating clients doing work that matters. We're picky about who we partner with; new clients only come in via trusted referral. We've worked with Lyft, McGraw Hill, ClearCo, Pepsi, Walmart, the former CEO of Waze, the leading vaccine production software, several new unicorns we can't say here, and dozens of startups backed by a16z/YC/Softbank/Insight/Tiger/etc.
  • Work alongside friends old & new: our niche is small/diverse product teams, since clients with larger budgets and higher-impact work tell us they want teams, not individuals. Of course, we keep friends together whenever we can.
  • Full autonomy: say "no" to things that don't excite you. The most talented builders often juggle a few things at once, so there's never pressure to join an A·Team mission if you don't have the bandwidth. If we're no longer a fit, it's easy to leave or pause too. 
  • Small, curated, off-the-record gatherings: for conversations hard to have elsewhere. Long-term, we're creating micro-communities for the world's top builders to become friends around the things they care about.
  • Keep 100% of what you earn: if you charge $120/hr, you get $120/hr. A·Team makes money by charging a small, flat, transparent platform fee on top of your rate.

 

 

How to apply:

Go here: https://build.a.team/remotivereferral + mention Remotive. We respect your time so the application is short. We're also much more interested in seeing what you've made, and excited to chat more if there’s a fit.

What you’ll do:

  • Once part of A.Team, you’ll regularly be invited to impactful missions that match your interests. Find the right pick from early-stage incubations with world-class founders, to fast-growing super-funded companies, to old school non-tech incumbents looking to build as a tech giant would

  • Missions usually involve building an ambitious piece of software from 0 to 1 as part of a small 3-4 person team. 

  • You’ll be paid to scope it out, give the client options, guide strategy, and execute on the selected solution. Sometimes the client has a clear vision, sometimes not; which is why A.Team builders tend to be senior folks who can work together to find the right direction. 

Who A·Team is for:

  • Senior software developers who left large companies and high-growth startups to pursue their craft with autonomy.

  • Those who prefer consistent contract work over a full-time role, who want to create a variety of new products alongside other top-tier builders.

  • The majority of A.Teamers spend most of their time doing independent work, but a sizeable percentage are either employed full-time (but testing out client work), bootstrapping a side project, or looking for their next big thing

Who A·Team is not for:

  • People looking for small gigs

  • Folks looking to build simple wordpress/wix/squarespace-style websites

  • Those still early in their careers (<4 years) and recent university/bootcamp grads (at least not yet)

Our long-term vision:

A·Team is a new type of company for a new kind of independent software builder. We call them "unhirables": people who traditional companies couldn’t hire full-time even if they wanted to, but who want to do their most meaningful work with their favorite people in small, autonomous, distributed expert teams. 

To help us secure amazing missions, we raised $60 million+  from Insight Partenrs, Tiger Global, NFX, RocNation, along with the former CEO of Upwork, the founders of Fiverr and Lemonade, Apple's Global Head of Recruiting, YC Partner Aaron Harris, Wharton's Adam Grant, and Duke's Dan Ariely.

jobs.description:
Numeris is Canadaâs most trusted and authoritative source for broadcast measurement and consumer behaviour data. As well, the industry leading intelligence provider to broadcasters, advertisers, and agencies. We have been recognized for over 75 years as providing the gold standard in audience intelligence. 

 

We have great people who do exceptional work. We take pride in building an environment of continuous learning and career advancement opportunities. Our teams are collaborative, curious, and dedicated to creating quality experiences. We love what we do, enjoy each otherâs company, and support initiatives to give back to our communities. We are looking for people to help us shape the future of Numeris, and have a lot of fun along the way.


The Executive Assistant is a high-trust, senior-level administrative partner responsible for providing comprehensive executive, operational, and governance support to the Chief Growth Officer (CGO), Chief Research & Operations Officer (CROO), and broader People & Culture and GRC (Governance, Risk & Compliance) functions. 

This role goes beyond traditional administrative support, acting as a central hub across leadership, ensuring seamless execution of executive priorities, governance processes, internal workflows, and organizational operations. The incumbent is expected to anticipate needs, proactively improve systems, and drive efficiency across tools, processes, and leadership workflows. 

Key areas of responsibility include executive calendar and priority management, cross-functional coordination, governance and compliance support (including DocuSign and approval workflows), onboarding/offboarding governance alignment, financial tracking support, and leadership communications preparation. 

This role requires a high degree of discretion, judgment, organizational maturity, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, executive-facing environment. In-office attendance is required minimum twice per week, with additional presence as needed based on executive priorities and business needs. 

\n


What you will do

Executive & Leadership Support 

  • Provide high-level administrative and operational support to the CGO, CROO, and Leadership Team, including complex calendar management, prioritization of competing demands, and proactive scheduling optimization  

  • Coordinate executive meetings, leadership forums, and cross-functional working sessions, including agendas, briefing materials, and follow-ups  

  • Prepare and synthesize meeting notes, action items, and executive summaries as required  

  • Manage domestic and international travel arrangements, itineraries, and logistics with a focus on efficiency and executive readiness  

 

Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) & Workflow Support 

  • Support governance workflows including DocuSign routing, approval tracking, documentation integrity, and compliance-related administrative processes  

  • Maintain structured documentation across Confluence, SharePoint, Monday.com, and other workflow systems to ensure audit readiness and process consistency  

  • Support adherence to internal approval frameworks, ensuring proper routing, documentation, and tracking of executive-level decisions and sign-offs  

  • Identify and implement improvements to governance workflows, documentation standards, and operational procedures  

 

People & Culture (P&C) Support 

  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding processes in partnership with P&C and IT, ensuring consistent, compliant, and well-documented execution  

  • Takes a lead with internal initiatives aligned to corporate leadership priorities  i.e. plans corporate events 

  • Supports the P&C team with organizing both virtual and in person activities throughout the year 


Financial & Operational Support 

  • Manage executive-level expense tracking, credit card reconciliation, invoice submissions, and purchase order processing  

  • Support budget tracking and reporting accuracy for leadership-related expenditures  

  • Liaise with Finance as required to ensure timely and accurate processing of financial documentation  

 

Office & Operational Management 

  • Oversee office operations coordination, including supplies, vendor coordination, facilities requests, and workplace logistics  

  • Act as primary liaison with building management and internal operations teams for office needs (repairs, access, seating, meeting setup, etc.)  

  • Support in-person meeting and event logistics, including setup, coordination, and post-event wrap-up  

  • Manages the office space, orders supplies, kitchen stock up of drinks and snacks  

 

Executive Communications & Presentation Support 

  • Develop, format, and refine presentation materials for town halls, board updates, leadership meetings, and strategic reviews  

  • Ensure consistency, clarity, and executive-level polish in all presentation and communication materials  

  • Support storytelling and structuring of leadership content for internal and external-facing presentations  


What you have

Education 

  • College diploma required; Bachelorâs degree preferred  

Experience 

  • 3â6 years of experience in executive support, operations coordination, or senior administrative roles  

  • Experience supporting senior leadership (VP level) 

  • Exposure to governance, compliance workflows, or document approval systems (DocuSign or similar) is an asset  

  • Experience working across cross-functional teams such as HR/P&C, Finance, or Legal is preferred  

Skills & Competencies 

  • Advanced proficiency in MS Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)  

  • Strong operational judgment and ability to manage competing priorities in real time  

  • High attention to detail with a systems-thinking mindset  

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills  

  • Proven ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion  

  • Experience with workflow tools such as SharePoint, Confluence, Monday.com, or similar platforms  

  • Ability to proactively improve processes rather than simply execute tasks 

  • Pleasant âcan doâ attitude, takes steps to work proactively to support 


What's in it for you?
  • Be part of an evolutionary journey in the audience measurement and data space; work on exciting projects, add value & make a positive impact to our Company.

  • Competitive salary and benefits package (Health, Dental, Vision and Personal Spending Account - employer paid premiums).

  • Flexible Work location (on-site offices in Toronto and Montreal, remote â work from home, hybrid as required per role).

  • Continuous learning and development via Percipio, our Learning Management System.

  • Be part of additional programs such as MentorMe, which helps our employeeâs network, and grow within the organization. 

  • Leadership Training offerings for new and emerging leaders.

  • Culture of great teams, coworkers and supportive leadership.

  • Perkopolis: Participation in a program that provides exclusive discounts on products and services to employees. Perks include shopping discounts, movie tickets, services, event/show tickets and much more!


\n
$65,000 - $80,000 a year
\n

Values

 

Stronger Together:

We succeed through collaboration with each other and with the industry. Unity drives our impact.

We embrace change and challenge convention. Our innovation is purposeful, driven by insights, guided by strategy, and focused on delivering meaningful future-proofed solutions.

People First:

jobs.title: Autolakerer til opstart af ny afdeling i Silkeborg
jobs.description:
Vil du være med helt fra starten og sætte dit præg på en ny afdeling?

Byens Bilpleje.com søger en dygtig og engageret autolakerer, som har lyst til at være med til at åbne og opbygge vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg.
Her får du ikke bare et almindeligt job som autolakerer. Du bliver en vigtig del af opstarten og får mulighed for at være med til at skabe gode arbejdsgange, høj kvalitet og den rette kultur i afdelingen fra første dag.

Om Byens Bilpleje.com

Byens Bilpleje.com er en af Danmarks største aktører inden for kosmetisk klargøring, autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse og udskiftning af autoglas.
Vi behandler mere end 200.000 biler om året og beskæftiger mere end 450 medarbejdere i Danmark.
Den første afdeling blev grundlagt i Vejle i 1997, og i dag har vi mere end 50 afdelinger i Danmark.
Vores ambition er at være bilejerens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Det gør vi ved at skabe værdi for vores kunder gennem effektivitet, kvalitet og fleksibilitet.

Om jobbet

Som autolakerer i vores nye afdeling i Silkeborg bliver du en central del af opstarten.
Du kommer til at arbejde med autolakering i den daglige produktion og får samtidig mulighed for at bidrage til, hvordan afdelingen skal fungere i praksis. Vi leder derfor efter dig, der både har faglig stolthed og lyst til at tage ansvar.
Du klargør bilerne til lakering ved at spartle, slibe og afdække, inden du sprøjtelakerer dem med fokus på et flot og ensartet resultat. Du er med hele vejen i processen og sikrer den sidste finish, så bilen står skarpt og ser ud som ny.

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet være:

  • Sikre topkvalitet på det udførte arbejde 
  • Selvom du styrer dine egen opgaver, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det 
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens 
  • Sikring af høj og ensartet kvalitet
  • Bidrage til effektive arbejdsgange og processer
  • Overholde aftalte deadlines
  • Samarbejde tæt med kolleger og ledelse
  • Være med til at skabe struktur og gode rutiner i den nye afdeling
  • Bidrage aktivt til opbygningen og udviklingen af afdelingen

Om dig

Vi forestiller os, at du er uddannet autolakerer og har erfaring fra faget.

jobs.description:
Job Description â Billing Officer

Job Title: Billing Officer

Department: Finance & Accounts

Reporting To: Finance Manager / Accounts Manager

Experience: 2â4 years in billing, invoicing, or accounts-related roles

Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Purpose

The Billing Officer will be responsible for managing the company's billing and invoicing processes, ensuring accurate and timely preparation of invoices, proper documentation, reconciliation of billing records, and coordination with internal departments and customers. The role requires strong attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and good knowledge of accounting and billing procedures.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and issue accurate sales invoices, bills, credit notes, debit notes, and related billing documents.
  • Verify sales orders, delivery notes, purchase orders, contracts, and supporting documents before billing.
  • Ensure billing is completed accurately and within defined timelines.
  • Maintain proper records of invoices, billing documents, and customer accounts.
  • Coordinate with Sales, Operations, Stores/Warehouse, and Accounts teams to resolve billing discrepancies.
  • Verify pricing, discounts, taxes, quantities, and other billing details before invoice generation.
  • Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate with the Accounts/Collection team for timely payment follow-up.
  • Perform regular reconciliation of billing records with sales, delivery, and accounting records.
  • Assist in preparing billing-related MIS and periodic reports for management.
  • Handle customer queries related to invoices, billing adjustments, credit notes, and payment documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable tax regulations, company policies, and internal control procedures.
  • Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of financial and customer information.
  • Support month-end and year-end closing activities related to billing and receivables.
  • Identify billing errors or process gaps and recommend improvements where required.
  • Perform other finance and accounting duties as assigned by the reporting manager.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Management, or a related field.
  • 2â4 years of relevant experience in billing, invoicing, accounts receivable.
  • Good knowledge of accounting principles and billing procedures.
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP software.
  • Strong numerical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple invoices and deadlines efficiently.
  • Strong organizational and record-keeping skills.
  • Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with ERP/accounting software such as Tally, SAP, Odoo, or similar systems.
  • Knowledge of VAT, TDS, and other applicable tax-related billing requirements.
  • Experience in handling high-volume billing operations.
  • Good understanding of sales, inventory, and accounts receivable processes.

Key Competencies

  • Accuracy & Attention to Detail
  • Numerical & Analytical Ability
  • Time Management
  • Problem-Solving
  • Communication & Coordination
  • Accountability
  • Integrity & Confidentiality
  • Process Orientation
  • Teamwork

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Accuracy and timeliness of invoice generation
  • Billing error and discrepancy rate
  • Timely reconciliation of billing records
  • Resolution time for billing-related issues
  • Accuracy of billing MIS and documentation
  • Compliance with internal billing and financial procedures

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff Engineering
jobs.description:
Overview

Physical Superintelligence is a startup with roots at Google, NVIDIA, Harvard, Meta, MIT, Oxford, Johns Hopkins, Cambridge, and the Perimeter Institute building AI systems to discover new physics at scale. We are seeking engineers to build platform infrastructure at the intersection of computational science, AI systems, and software engineering.

Our mission is to discover and commercialize transformative physics breakthroughs at scale with artificial superintelligence, safely, verifiably, and for broad public benefit.

The last century's golden age of physics gave us transistors, lasers, and nuclear energy. We believe artificial superintelligence will unlock the next one. We're creating the infrastructure to industrialize scientific discovery and usher in this new era.

We have one product: new physics, at scale.

Use this application if you are an engineer, no open engineering role fits your profile, and you want to be considered anyway. We hire excellent engineers when we find them, whether or not a matching role is open. Tell us how your background and ambitions intersect with our mission, and where you would have the most impact.

Â 

Role and Responsibilities

  • Our platform spans distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evaluation, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, cloud infrastructure, and security. This application is for engineers who are strong across most of that list, or unusually deep in something important we did not list. The bar here is higher than any single posting.

  • The standard is the same as every engineering role here: full ownership from spec to ship to on-call, and systems other people build on.

  • Be specific about where you would have the most impact and what you would work on first.

  • We review these applications on a rolling basis and respond only when we see a strong fit.

What We're Looking For

  • A track record of shipping substantive engineering work: systems that shipped and mattered, open source people depend on, infrastructure that outlived your tenure. We weight evidence over credentials.

  • Depth in several of the areas above and the range to move between them, or singular depth in something important we did not list.

  • You can walk us through a hard technical decision you made, what you traded away, and what you would do differently.

  • A concrete reason to be here. If AI systems and physical science together is why you are applying, say so specifically.

Nice to Have

  • Background in any of our named areas: distributed systems, data infrastructure, agent systems and evals, HPC and scientific computing, developer platforms, product engineering, infrastructure, or security.

  • Experience in research or scientific computing environments.

  • Something we can read or run: a design doc, a paper, a repo, a postmortem.

Â 

How We Work

We hold a high technical bar and give people full ownership of their work, from spec to ship to on-call. We write contracts before logic, test against real systems instead of mocks, and favor simple designs that ship over clever ones that do not. Our development process is AI-native: we work with agentic coding tools daily, write specs that are legible to humans and agents alike, and lead with leverage.

Â 

Location and Compensation

This role is based in Boston. We will consider remote candidates on a case-by-case basis. We offer competitive compensation including salary, benefits, and meaningful early-stage equity. We evaluate on technical breadth, systems thinking, scientific curiosity, and shipping velocity. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diverse perspectives in building platforms for AI-driven discovery.

This role sits above day-to-day execution and partners closely with Customer Success Managers to ensure FreedomPay delivers against customer goals. The focus is on strategic engagement within the Lodging vertical, supporting brands such as Marriott, Hyatt IHG, and similar multi-location operators.

jobs.description:
About Pivotal Health

Pivotal Health is the leading technology platform that helps healthcare providers get paid fairly in an increasingly complex reimbursement landscape.

Today, many providers face persistent underpayment from health insurance companies, despite delivering high-quality care. While processes like IDR (Independent Dispute Resolution) were designed to promote fairness, theyâre often administrative-heavy, time-consuming, and difficult to navigate without the right tools.

Pivotal Health combines software, data, and service into a seamlessly integrated, AI-driven platform that simplifies these complex reimbursement workflows. We help providers efficiently dispute underpaid claims, reduce administrative burden, and recover the reimbursement theyâre entitled to; without adding more work to already stretched teams.

Our full-service IDR solution is just the starting point. Weâre building solutions that enable providers to operate with clarity, control, and confidence across the reimbursement journey.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer to join Pivotal's Case Execution team. This team owns critical parts of the case execution workflow, including eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These systems sit at the operational core of how Pivotal delivers outcomes for providers.

This is a strong fit for an engineer who enjoys solving complex, workflow-driven backend problems and working through data-heavy decision logic. The most technically demanding areas for this team are eligibility and batching, and the right person is energized by that kind of work rather than looking to avoid it.

What You'll Do

  • Build and improve core case execution systems: Own backend development across eligibility, batching, submissions, ops workflows, and claim orchestration. These are the systems that determine how cases move through Pivotal's platform and reach resolution.

  • Tackle complex, data-driven backend problems: Work through the decision logic and data-heavy workflows that make eligibility and batching hard, understanding not just how individual systems work, but how they interact across the broader platform.

  • Contribute to workflow orchestration: Build and improve the systems that coordinate how cases are staged, routed, and executed end to end, with a clear eye toward correctness and reliability.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with the Integrations team, Case Strategy team, and other engineering and product partners to ensure systems are well-connected and aligned with how the broader platform operates.

  • Contribute to front-end and admin workflows where needed: The role is primarily backend-focused, but you'll contribute to internal-facing UI and ops tooling where the product requires it.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience with a strong backend focus

  • Strong engineering fundamentals with hands-on experience building data-heavy, workflow-oriented systems

  • Experience working on complex, data-driven decision logic or orchestration problems: you're comfortable with systems where correctness and sequencing both matter

  • Comfortable operating in a collaborative, fast-moving startup environment where ownership and requirements evolve

  • Python experience; able to work effectively in a Python-based backend environment

  • Self-directed and proactive: you identify problems and drive them to resolution without heavy oversight

  • Strong communicator who collaborates well across engineering, product, and adjacent teams

Extra Credit If You Have

  • Experience with healthcare-specific data or HealthTech systems

  • Exposure to data-heavy architectures or problems adjacent to data engineering without being a pure data engineer

  • Familiarity with tools like Snowflake, dbt, or Databricks

  • Some front-end experience to support admin workflow contributions

Why Youâll Love Working Here

Weâre a collaborative, low-ego team on a mission to make healthcare reimbursement fairer for providers. While we primarily hire around our core hubsâLos Angeles and New Yorkâwe remain open to exceptional talent outside those regions. Remote and hybrid flexibility varies by role and team, and is outlined in each job description.

If youâre excited by solving complex problems and making a real-world impact, weâd love to hear from you.

Benefits Include:

  • Competitive compensation, including equity

  • Full health, dental, and vision coverage

  • Retirement savings plan through 401(k)

  • Flexible time off

  • Opportunities for company-wide connection and events

Ready to Make an Impact?
Weâre building something meaningful; and we want you on the team.

Bring your ideas, curiosity, and drive, and letâs transform healthcare reimbursement together.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future employer sponsorship.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

Pivotal Health provides reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you need assistance during the application or interview process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Directeur / Directrice d'hôtel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Hôtel des Années Folles construit en 1928, rendez-vous des artistes et écrivains, des gentlemen et des aventuriers, Le Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris incarne depuis toujours ce je-ne-sais-quoi parisien. Spontané, cultivé, audacieux : l'effervescence permanente de création et d'émotion qui y règne, attire les voyageurs en quête de vie à la française.

Ayant rouvert en 2010 comme l'hôtel de luxe le plus artistique de Paris, après une transformation complète de 2 ans par le designer Philippe Starck, c'est en 2013 que l'hôtel reçoit la distinction "Palace". Composé de 149 chambres et suites prestigieuses, dont 3 Suites Présidentielles, l'hôtel se situe à quelques minutes de l'Arc de Triomphe et des Champs-Élysées. Au Royal Monceau - Raffles Paris, l'Art est omniprésent, avec un service exclusif d'Art Concierge, une Librairie des Arts, une galerie d'art, un cinéma privé de 99 places et également une collection privée d'oeuvres d'art.

L'offre culinaire est elle aussi portée par l'esprit de créativité qui anime tout l'hôtel, de la partition sucrée du Chef et entrepreneur Yazid Ichemrahen, à l'effervescence du "Bar Long" jusqu'aux trois restaurants : "Matsuhisa Paris" dédié à la gastronomie péruvo-japonaise par l'illustre Chef Nobu et "Il Carpaccio", restaurant étoilé aux notes italiennes en collaboration avec la famille Da Vittorio. A ne pas manquer : les petits déjeuners et les brunchs d'exception du restaurant "La Cuisine". Le Raffles Spa & Wellness et sa piscine spectaculaire baignée de lumière naturelle est quant à lui un véritable havre de paix où l'on aime se perdre, pour mieux se retrouver.


Missions Améliorer la sécurité et la sûreté de l'hôtel via des moyens humains et matériels, et assurer une veille constante sur les évolutions juridiques, réglementaires et technologiques du secteur.
* Conseiller la Direction Générale sur les aspects sécuritaires et juridiques des opérations, et traiter avec discrétion les problèmes confiés par la Direction.
* Superviser et rendre compte mensuellement de la gestion administrative de son service, ainsi que du suivi et des missions de l'équipe de sécurité/sûreté.
* Participer aux appels d'offres liés à la sécurité, ainsi qu'à la rédaction et mise à jour du DUER et des plans de prévention.
* Rédiger et tenir à jour les consignes, procédures et le manuel d'urgence en matière de sécurité et sûreté.
* Contrôler les rapports de sécurité et assurer le suivi des anomalies relevées.
* Assurer la communication et coordination entre services (briefings, remontées d'information au comité de Direction) et participer aux réunions d'exploitation.
* Participer au recrutement, à la formation et à l'accompagnement des équipes, et animer les formations de sécurité (incendie, terrorisme, comportements inacceptables, etc Gérer tout événement lié à la sûreté/sécurité, faire l'interface avec les services de l'État, remonter les informations à la Direction Générale, et être présent lors des événements importants de l'établissement.

Ce descriptif de poste est non exhaustif. Le titulaire peut être amené à accomplir d'autres missions.


Exigences en matière d'aptitudes personnelles et de compétences Sens de la confidentialité
* Sang-froid et bon sens quel que soit la situation
* Diplomate
* Physionomiste
* Capacité à travailler dans un environnement international et multiculturel
* Connaissance de la législation du travail, réglementation incendie et de la législation encadrant la sécurité privée (Livre 6 du CSI)
* Connaissance sur les différentes technologies
* Maitriser la prévention et la gestion des risques et situation de crise.

Exigences en matière d'expérience Minimum 5 années d'expérience à un poste similaire dans un hôtel de catégorie équivalente.

Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21) koji u trenutku podnošenja prijave ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava dužni su uz prijavu na natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta iz natječaja te ovisno o kategoriji koja se poziva na prednost pri zapošljavanju priložiti sve potrebne dokaze dostupne na poveznici ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u skladu s člankom 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (NN 157/ 13, 152/ 14, 39/18, 32/20) uz prijavu na natječaj dužni su, pored dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom na temelju koje se osoba može upisati u očevidnik zaposlenih osoba s invaliditetom te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju iz članka 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata (NN 33/92, 57/92, 77/92, 27/93, 58/93, 02/94, 76/94, 108/95, 108/96, 82/01, 103/03, 148/13, 98/19), uz ostale dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, dužni su priložiti i odgovarajuće dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti, kao rješenje ili potvrdu o priznatom statusu iz koje je vidljivo spomenuto pravo, izjavu da do sada nije koristio pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja po toj osnovi te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji je način prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (rješenje, ugovor, sporazum i sl.). Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom, podnose se u roku od 8 dana od dana objave natječaja u Narodnim novinama te na stranici Centra i HZZ-a, na mail adresu liana.brkic@socskrb.hr. Podnošenjem prijave na natječaj kandidati daju suglasnost Centru da kao voditelj zbirke osobnih podataka može prikupljati, koristiti i dalje obrađivati njihove osobne podatke isključivo u svrhu provedbe natječajnog postupka sukladno propisima koji uređuju zaštitu osobnih podataka. O načinu, pravnim i drugim izvorima iz kojih će se testiranje provesti, kao i o vremenu istog, kandidati će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Zadar. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu ili potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom u postupku natječaja. O rezultatima natječaja kandidati će biti obavješteni putem mrežne stranice Centra za pružanje usluga u zajednici Zadar. Ravnateljica: Liana Brkić, univ.spec.act.soc.

jobs.title: UČITELJ/ICA RAZREDNE NASTAVE U PRODUŽENOM BORAVKU
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 107. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine” br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10.-ispr, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22,155/23, 156/23), članka 7. Pravilnika o radu Osnovne škole Luka i članka 6.i 7. Pravilnika o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Luka, ravnateljica Osnovne škole Luka, 10296 Luka, Trg sv. Roka 3, Luka , raspisuje NATJEČAJ za zasnivanje radnog odnosa •Učitelj/ica razredne nastave u produženom boravku, na određeno, puno radno vrijeme, 40 sata tjedno - 1 izvršitelj/ica MJESTO RADA: Osnovna škole Luka, 10296 Luka, Trg sv. Roka 3, Luka (poslovi se u pravilu obavljaju u sjedištu Škole, a prema potrebi i izvan sjedišta Škole) RADNO MJESTO ZA KOJE SE RASPISUJE NATJEČAJ: Učitelj/ica razredne nastave u produženom boravku BROJ IZVRŠITELJA: 1 izvršitelj TJEDNO RADNO VRIJEME: 40 sati tjedno. TRAJANJE UGOVORA O RADU: Ugovor se sklapa na određeno puno radno vrijeme. PROBNI RAD: 3 mjeseca UVJETI ZA ZASNIVANJE RADNOG ODNOSA: Kandidati koji se prijavljuju na natječaj uz opće uvjete sukladno Zakonu o radu, moraju ispunjavati i posebne uvjete sukladno članku 105. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi („Narodne novine” br. 87/08, 86/09, 92/10, 105/10.-ispr, 90/11, 5/12, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22,155/23, 156/23) i uvjete propisane Pravilnikom o odgovarajućoj vrsti obrazovanja učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi („Narodne novine“ br. 6/19., 75/20.). DOKUMENTI I PRILOZI KOJIMA SE DOKAZUJE ISPUNJENOST UVJETA: - prijava na natječaj vlastoručno potpisana, - životopis, - dokaz o stručnoj spremi, - dokaz o državljanstvu, - potvrda ili elektronički zapis o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji HZMO, - uvjerenje nadležnog suda da se protiv kandidata ne vodi kazneni postupak za neko od kaznenih djela iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (ne starije od dana objave natječaja) Isprave se prilažu u neovjerenoj preslici a nakon odabira kandidata, prije potpisivanja ugovora o radu, odabrani kandidat bit će pozvan da dostavi izvornike isprave ili ovjerene preslike. U javnu službu ne može biti primljena osoba za čije zapošljavanje postoje zapreke iz članka 106. Zakona o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi. PRAVO PREDNOSTI PRI ZAPOŠLJAVANJU: Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnom zakonu dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu priložiti svu propisanu dokumentaciju prema posebnom zakonu i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 102. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji (Narodne novine, broj 121/17., 98/19., 84./21., 156/23.) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i sve dokaze o ostvarivanju prava prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja iz članka 103. stavka 1. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihovih obitelji, koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja poveznica: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20ZOHBDR%202021.pdf Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 48. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, broj 84/21.) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i uz prijavu, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta priložiti i dokaze iz članka 49. stavka 1. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata koji su navedeni na internetskoj stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja poveznica: https://branitelji.gov.hr/UserDocsImages//dokumenti/Nikola//popis%20dokaza%20za%20ostvarivanje%20prava%20prednosti%20pri%20zapo%C5%A1ljavanju-%20Zakon%20o%20civilnim%20stradalnicima%20iz%20DR.pdf Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju u prema članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, broj 157/13. , 152/14., 39/18., 32/20.) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, kao i dokaz o invaliditetu. Kandidat koji se poziva na pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema članku 48.f Zakona o zaštiti vojnih i civilnih invalida rata („Narodne novine“, br. 33/92., 57/92.,77/92., 27/93., 58/93., 2/94., 76/94., 108/95., 108/96., 82/01, 103/03., 148/13., 98/19.) dužan je u prijavi na natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta te potvrdu ili rješenje o priznatom statusu kao i dokaz o tome na koji je način prestao radni odnos. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 dana od dana objave natječaja na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog zavoda za zapošljavanje i mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Osnovne škole Luka, odnosno zaključno do 25. kolovoza 2026. godine. Prijave s potrebnom dokumentacijom o ispunjavanju propisanih uvjeta iz natječaja dostavljaju se osobno u tajništvo Škole s naznakom „Natječaj za učitelja/cu razredne nastave u produženom boravku“ ili putem mail adrese natjecaji@os-luka.skole.hr Nepravodobne i nepotpune prijave neće se razmatrati. Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj će se smatrati samo osoba koja podnese pravodobnu i potpunu prijavu te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. TESTIRANJE KANDIDATA: Sukladno Pravilniku o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Luka za kandidate prijavljene na natječaj koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete te čije su prijave pravodobne i potpune provest će se testiranje. Pravni izvori za pripremu kandidata za testiranje su: - Zakon o odgoju i obrazovanju u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN RH 87/08, 86/09, 92/10,105/10 isp., 90/11, 16/12, 86/12, 126/12. - pročišćeni tekst, 94/13, 152/14, 7/17, 68/18, 98/19, 64/20, 151/22, 156/23), - Pravilnik o osnovnoškolskom i srednjoškolskom odgoju i obrazovanju učenika s teškoćama u razvoju (NN 24/2015), - Pravilnik o načinima, postupcima i elementima vrednovanja učenika u osnovnoj i srednjoj školi (NN 112/2010, 82/2019, 43/20, 100/21), - Pravilnik o tjednim radnim obvezama učitelja i stručnih suradnika u osnovnoj školi (NN 34/2014, 40/14, 103/14,102/19), - Pravilnik o odgoju i obrazovanju darovite djece i učenika (NN 71/2025). Vrijeme i mjesto održavanja testiranja bit će objavljeni na web stranici Škole na poveznici: https://os-luka.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao/ VRIJEME I NAČIN OBJAVE REZULTATA NATJEČAJA: Rezultati natječaja bit će objavljeni u roku od 15 dana od dana davanja suglasnosti školskog odbora ravnateljici za zapošljavanje odabranog kandidata. Rezultati natječaja bit će objavljeni na web stranici Škole na poveznici https://os-luka.skole.hr/oglasi-za-posao/. OSTALE NAPOMENE UZ NATJEČAJ: Na natječaj se mogu prijaviti osobe oba spola (čl. 13 st. 2. Zakona o ravnopravnosti spolova). Kandidatom prijavljenim na natječaj smatrat će se samo osoba koja je podnijela pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu na način utvrđen ovim natječajem te ispunjava formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Kandidati koji nisu podnijeli pravovremenu i potpunu prijavu ili ne ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatraju se kandidatima prijavljenim na javni natječaj, o čemu će biti pisano obaviješteni. Način i postupak odabira kandidata na natječaju propisan je Pravilnikom o načinu i postupku zapošljavanja u Osnovnoj školi Luka koji se nalazi na poveznici: https://os-luka.skole.hr/pravilnici-2/ Podatci koje Osnovna škola Luka prikupi od kandidata tijekom natječajnog postupka koristit će se i dalje obrađivati u skladu s propisima koji reguliraju daljnju obradu osobnih podataka, a u svrhu sklapanja ugovora o radu, kontaktiranja i objave na internetskim stranicama i oglasnoj ploči. U skladu s uredbom Europske unije 2016/679 Europskog parlamenta i Vijeća od 27. travnja 2016. godine te Zakonom o provedbi Opće uredbe o zaštiti podataka (NN 42/18.) podnošenjem prijave na natječaj smatra se da je kandidat suglasan da se njegovi podatci obrađuju samo u potrebnom obimu i u svrhu potrebe natječaja od strane ovlaštenih osoba za provedbu natječaja. Sve pristigle prijave biti će zaštićene od pristupa neovlaštenih osoba te pohranjene na sigurno mjesto i čuvane u skladu s uvjetima i rokovima predviđenih zakonskim propisima, Pravilnikom o zaštiti i obradi arhivskog i registraturnog gradiva i odluka voditelja obrade. Natječaj je objavljen na mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči škole i mrežnoj stranici i oglasnoj ploči Hrvatskog Zavoda za zapošljavanje dana 17. kolovoza 2026. godine i traje do 25.kolovoza 2026. Rok za podnošenje prijava je osam dana od dana objave natječaja.
