jobs.title: Surveyor I
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

Notice

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

Other

This job description is not intended, and should not be construed, to be an all-inclusive list of responsibilities, skills, efforts or working conditions associated with the job of the incumbent. It is intended to be an accurate reflection of the principal job elements essential for making a fair decision regarding the pay structure of the job. #ogjs

WE TAKE YOU ABOVE BEYOND

Take your passion to the next level and work alongside other masters of their craft to build a fulfilling and rewarding career at Marina Bay Sands.

Summary Of Job Responsibilities

As a Valet driver, you will be responsible for handling all arrivals, and departing vehicles at the Hotel Valet, Casino Valet, Carpark Valet, MICE, and Hall Parking. Additionally, you are required to perform static duties at the curb to direct traffic, assist in opening vehicle doors and not limited to assist on luggage for arrival at the Hotel driveway. You are expected to deliver the required service standard based on Forbes service standards consistently.

You must perform and support the Valet operations, and under the supervision of Valet Captains, and Managers to ensure that all the tasks are being completed on time and based on the standards set by the department. You should also work in close collaboration with other Valet drivers, traffic marshals and the bellman who are on duty at the driveway to ensure seamless arrival and departure for all guests.

Job Responsibilities

  • Handle valet vehicles within the property of Marina Bay Sands in line with the departmental standards
  • Operate the Valet Management System according to departmental guidelines.
  • Assist in managing the traffic around the property of Marina Bay Sands as well as ensuring and maintaining safety of guests and vehicles.
  • Provide level of service and experience according to the departmental audit standards and work as a team to achieve the departmental KPIs.
  • Direct incoming vehicles to the designated lanes and into specific areas of self-park whenever required.
  • Restrict incoming vehicles and manage taxi queue when required to ease congestion within the property.
  • Manage Hall Parking in the event of self-park overflow.
  • Provide information on valet and self-park related as well as all other guestsâ queries.
  • Understand and execute departmental game plans.
  • Maintain operational equipment in working order and ensure supplies are sufficient to perform duties.
  • Monitor and report any anomalies to Valet Captains for immediate action.
  • Learn and support the team with any other operational and/or departmental duties when required.
  • Assist with any other assignments tasked by Valet Captains

Job Requirements

Education & Certification

  • No formal education required

Experience

  • Possess a valid Singapore Class 3 Driving License with a minimum of 2 years driving experience.
  • Prior experience in a similar role is an advantage.

Other Prerequisites

  • Good interpersonal and English communication skills, proactive and positive attitude
  • Able to work within a culturally diverse team.
  • Able to deploy in environment as required to perform job responsibility
  • Able to perform manual handling duties, including lifting and moving guests' luggage.

Marina Bay Sands is committed to building a diverse, equitable and inclusive workforce, providing equal opportunities as we grow our talent base to match our growth ambitions in Singapore. Our employees are committed to adhere to and abide by all rules, regulations, policies and procedures, including the rules of conduct and business ethics of the Company.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Herning
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få ridser og buler til at forsvinde!  

Har du styr på afdækning, slibning og spartling så bilerne står knivskarpe, før de ruller ind i kabinen? Kan du få selv de mest triste biler til at se ud som nye? Så er det dig, vi leder efter!

jobs.title: PRODUKTIONSTEKNISK LEDER TIL MAYEKAWA NORDIC A/S
jobs.description:
Vær med til at bygge en  ny afdeling op fra bunden

Produktionsteknisk Leder med fokus på at modne udviklingsafdelingens arbejde og gøre det klar til produktion

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har igen bedt os om at finde den rette person til en central rolle i virksomheden. De søger en Produktionsteknisk Leder, der trives i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling, produktion og mennesker.

Mayekawa Nordic A/S har deres domicil i Middelfart og fungerer som nordisk udviklingscenter for den japanske koncern Mayekawa. Virksomheden udvikler industrielle køleanlæg og varmepumper og er særligt kendt for mCHILLER-serien, der bruger det naturlige kølemiddel ammoniak og på den måde opnår høj energieffektivitet og bæredygtighed.

Der skal bygges en helt ny Industrialization-afdeling op i Middelfart, og det er dig, der kommer til at gøre det. I samarbejde med udviklingsdirektøren, finder du ud af hvad afdelingen skal kunne, og du bygger systemerne til det. Du tager de lange møder og forhandlingerne med udvikling og produktion om, hvordan tingene kan gøres bedre, og du sætter retning for, hvordan udviklingens arbejde modnes og overleveres til produktionen, og du bidrager i udførelsen af arbejdet. Det er en rolle med ansvar og ledelse, hvor du selv er med i det faglige udførende arbejde.

Afdelingen kommer til at bygge bro mellem udvikling og produktion. Og med en produktionsenhed i Serbien, som du får en del at gøre med, skal du regne med op til 50 rejsedage om året.

I bliver to i afdelingen: dig som lead og en Produktionsteknisk Supporter, og sammen udgør I fundamentet i Mayekawas Industrialization-afdeling.

Ansvarsområder
I samarbejde med Mayekawa Nordics ledelse, bygger du afdelingen op fra bunden og finder, udvikler og sætter rammerne for, hvordan den skal arbejde.

Ansvaret kommer til at ligge hos dig fra dag ét, og med reference til den danske udviklingsdirektør, omfatter dine opgaver:

  • Opbygning af afdelingens arbejdsgange og processer.

  • At afdelingen sikrer en grundig modning af produkterne, så de kan gå sikkert fra udvikling til produktion.

  • Kontakten til de tre interessenter: udvikling i Danmark, moderfirma i Japan og produktion i Serbien.

  • Sourcingaftaler i samarbejde med strategisk indkøb.

Arbejdsopgaver
Du får det daglige ansvar for at opgaver bliver udført, og du er selv med i det faglige arbejde, hvor en del af af det ligger også på det strategiske plan:

  • CAD-automatisering på tværs af produktfamilier og varianter.

  • Produktvariant-ingeniørarbejde og vurdering af, hvad ændringer påvirker.

  • Design-for-assembly forbedringer.

  • Integration af kvalitetssikring i udviklingsprocesserne.

  • Udvikling af systemer til generering af kundedokumentationspakker.

  • Integration af nye produktfeatures i eksisterende produktlinjer.

Faglige kompetencer
Du har en baggrund som produktionsingeniør, maskinmester, produktionsteknolog eller noget, der ligner. Vigtigst er, at du har stået i krydsfeltet mellem udvikling og produktion før og ved, hvor der kan opstå gnidninger i praksis. Har du ledelseserfaring, er det fint. Har du den ikke, men lyst til at træde ind i en lederrolle, er det lige så fint.

Afdelingen skal samlet set dække en række tekniske områder. Da du bliver den første person i afdelingen, forventer vi, at du allerede har et solidt fagligt fundament og kan dække flere af områderne fra begyndelsen.  Det gælder Vault og Inventor, herunder automatisering og workflows, mekanisk design og montageprocesser, kendskab til produktionsteknologi og erfaring med ERP- og PDM-systemer. Viden om svejsning, pladebearbejdning, rør og fittings er en fordel.

Personlige kompetencer
Du er en person, der tager ansvar, og som er opsøgende på både relationer og viden, og du venter ikke på, at nogen beder dig om noget. Du tager teten, når det kræves, og forstår at give plads til andre, når det er dem, der skal fylde.

Du har drive til at bygge systemer, forbedre dem og holde dem kørende. Du gør opgaver færdige frem for at kaste dig over de næste. Og du kan finde vej i en organisation, der endnu ikke er struktureret. For det er præcis det, du kommer til: at skabe strukturen, der ikke er der endnu.

Det vil være en fordel for dig, hvis du har interesse i eller erfaring med, at arbejde i et internationalt miljø, med relationer og kontakter uden for landets grænser. Derfor er det også væsentligt, at du taler engelsk på et højere niveau.

Mayekawa Nordic tilbyder

  • Et spændende og selvstændigt job med stor frihed i udførelsen af opgaverne og gode muligheder for både personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Du vil være en del af et dynamisk og engageret team, hvor der er en uformel tone og en god atmosfære.

  • En attraktiv lønpakke, inklusive pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring.

  • Fleksible arbejdstider der matcher dine rejseaktiviteter.

  • Mulighed for hjemmearbejde.

Din primære arbejdsplads vil være på kontoret i Middelfart.

Er det dig, der skal bygge afdelingen op?
Kan du se dig selv stå i spidsen for noget, der ikke findes endnu, og selv have hænderne i det faglige undervejs? Så vil vi gerne høre fra dig.

Praktiske forhold
Den optimale tiltrædelse er 1. oktober 2026, men den rigtige kandidat betyder mere end datoen, så vi venter gerne. Der er derfor ingen fast ansøgningsfrist.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og afslutter processen, når vi har fundet den rette.

Så vil du med, er det bare med at sende ansøgningen af sted.

Kontakt
Hvis du har spørgsmål, der vedrører stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte John Pagaard på +45 2090 4970.

Vigtigt: Ansøgning og CV skal sendes via Ansøgningslinket, så vi får dit materiale ind i vores rekrutteringssystem (GDPR).

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Om Mayekawa
Mayekawa er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt af Kisaku Maekawa i 1924. Siden da er den vokset til at være en af verdens førende inden for industriel køling med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere fordelt over hele kloden.

Den første stempelkompressor kom i 1934. Siden har Mayekawa arbejdet videre med MYCOM kompressorteknologien, og i dag står MYCOM som det stærkeste navn i branchen.

Naturlige kølemidler har været omdrejningspunktet fra begyndelsen, fordi hensynet til miljøet vejer tungt hos Mayekawa. Industriel køling er stadig kerneforretningen, men virksomheden arbejder også med udstyr til kødforarbejdning og med robotteknologi.

Om Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Mayekawa Nordic A/S er udviklingscenter for standard chillers og varmepumper under Mayekawa Europe. Det er her mCHILLER Series bliver udviklet. I 2021 kom mCHILLER FUGU, en vandkølet ammoniak chiller, og i oktober 2022 fulgte mCHILLER TAKA, som er luftkølet.

Organisationen er flad. Man spørger, når man er i tvivl, og man hjælper både sit team og sin leder med at få tingene til at lykkes.

Som ny kollega kommer du ind i en virksomhed, der ligger helt fremme i branchen, og som ser på hele mennesket. Der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

Mayekawa prioriterer arbejdsmiljøet og bakker det op med sociale aktiviteter og en fri og ærlig omgangstone, hvor der er plads til sjov og til at være den, man er, blandt kolleger der bliver hængende. De værdier skal gerne passe til dine egne.

Arbejdsadresse

Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Damgårdvej 6,
5500 Middelfart

www.mayekawa.dk

Om Mayekawa
Mayekawa er en familieejet virksomhed, grundlagt af Kisaku Maekawa i 1924. Siden da er den vokset til at være en af verdens førende inden for industriel køling med mere end 4.500 medarbejdere fordelt over hele kloden.

Den første stempelkompressor kom i 1934. Siden har Mayekawa arbejdet videre med MYCOM kompressorteknologien, og i dag står MYCOM som det stærkeste navn i branchen.

Naturlige kølemidler har været omdrejningspunktet fra begyndelsen, fordi hensynet til miljøet vejer tungt hos Mayekawa. Industriel køling er stadig kerneforretningen, men virksomheden arbejder også med udstyr til kødforarbejdning og med robotteknologi.

Om Mayekawa Nordic A/S
Mayekawa Nordic A/S er udviklingscenter for standard chillers og varmepumper under Mayekawa Europe. Det er her mCHILLER Series bliver udviklet. I 2021 kom mCHILLER FUGU, en vandkølet ammoniak chiller, og i oktober 2022 fulgte mCHILLER TAKA, som er luftkølet.

Organisationen er flad. Man spørger, når man er i tvivl, og man hjælper både sit team og sin leder med at få tingene til at lykkes.

Som ny kollega kommer du ind i en virksomhed, der ligger helt fremme i branchen, og som ser på hele mennesket. Der er balance mellem arbejde og privatliv.

Mayekawa prioriterer arbejdsmiljøet og bakker det op med sociale aktiviteter og en fri og ærlig omgangstone, hvor der er plads til sjov og til at være den, man er, blandt kolleger der bliver hængende. De værdier skal gerne passe til dine egne.

jobs.title: Morgenfrisk og ansvarsbevidst? Bliv en del af Oscar Biludlejning
jobs.description:
Hos Oscar Biludlejning søger vi en til to medarbejdere, der trives med ansvar, kan arbejde selvstændigt og sætter en ære i, at tingene er i orden.

Du bliver den person, der sørger for, at vores biler står klar til kunderne – rene, velholdte og klar til afhentning fra morgenstunden. Vores kunder forventer en god oplevelse, og den starter med en bil, der lever op til en høj standard.

Dine opgaver bliver blandt andet at:

  • Tjekke biler ind og ud

  • Registrere eventuelle skader, kilometerstand og brændstofniveau

  • Kontrollere bilernes generelle stand og være opmærksom på rengøring og eventuel røglugt

  • Rengøre og tanke bilerne efter behov

  • Klargøre bilerne til næste udlejning

  • Håndtere nøgler og den digitale nøgleboks

  • Holde øje med dæk, olie og øvrige væsker

  • Hjælpe med at få biler til og fra værksted, når der er behov for det

Hos Oscar Biludlejning udlejer vi primært brugte biler, men derfor skal standarden stadig være høj. Vi forventer, at vores biler er præsentable, driftssikre og klar til brug – hver eneste dag.

Et job med frihed og ansvar:

Du får ansvaret for den daglige drift i en afdeling og planlægger i høj grad selv dit arbejde. Stillingen er på cirka 2–3 timer om dagen, mandag til fredag. Nogle dage tager det lidt kortere tid, andre dage lidt længere.

Arbejdet ligger primært om morgenen, og du skal være indstillet på at starte tidligt, så bilerne er klar til kunderne omkring kl. 08.00.

En del af opgaverne kan følges og planlægges hjemmefra via app og e-mail, og bor du tæt på afdelingen, vil du ofte kunne forberede meget af arbejdet aftenen før.

Derudover vil du hver anden weekend have ansvaret for to afdelinger. Opgaverne vil fortsat ligge om morgenen, og tidsforbruget vil være nogenlunde det samme.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er selvstændig og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Har øje for detaljer og høje kvalitetsstandarder

  • Er praktisk anlagt og kan lide at have orden omkring dig

  • Er fleksibel og hjælpsom over for kolleger

  • Har kørekort til almindelig personbil

  • Ikke er bange for store varevogne (alle biler er max 3.500 kg. til alm. kørekort)

Vi søger først og fremmest en medarbejder, der har lyst til at blive hos os i længere tid. Derfor vægter vi stabilitet og engagement højt.

Stillingen kan være særligt interessant for dig, der er førtidspensionist, efterlønner eller pensionist, og som ønsker et fleksibelt deltidsjob med faste rutiner, ansvar og kontakt til mennesker.

Du vil naturligvis få grundig oplæring, så du føler dig tryg i opgaverne og godt klædt på til rollen.

Kunne det være noget for dig?

Så send os en ansøgning og fortæl lidt om dig selv og din motivation for at blive en del af Oscar Biludlejning.

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette person.

jobs.title: Outcomes Architect
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion is reimagining how customers adopt, expand, and realize value from software in an AI-native world. As an Outcomes Architect, you’ll be the build-beside partner who helps customers turn ambition into working systems inside Notion. You’ll own workflow adoption, value delivery, and renewal outcomes for a book of named accounts, with a focus on customers that are flat, at-risk, or need a stronger path to measurable impact.

You’ll partner closely with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, expansion qualification, and customer success planning, while directly shaping outcomes that strengthen customer partnerships and contribute to predictable revenue. If you’re a builder who loves helping customers solve real business problems—and you want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, customer value, and revenue impact—this is the role.



This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts, ensuring customers expand their use of Notion and as a result, Notion sees high NRR

 - Partner closely with the Solutions Consultant on account strategy for expansion and renewal, including owning the renewal opportunity for flat and at-risk customers

 - Shape customer outcomes, strengthen executive and team-level partnerships, and contribute directly to predictable revenue through retention, renewal, and expansion impact

 - Design and deploy workflows that solve specific business problems as a build-beside partner to the customer, translating goals into durable systems in Notion

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants on account strategy, customer planning, and identifying and qualifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts

 - Co-define, build, and manage against customer success plans that help every customer achieve their desired objectives and realize measurable value

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be the best build-beside partner for customers navigating new ways of working

 - Innovate and iterate on Outcomes Architect programs that retain and grow customers while mitigating churn or contraction risk




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and genuine comfort building live in software—you can co-design, configure, and troubleshoot with customers in the room

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working

 - Fluency in English and a second European language




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based models and the ability to connect adoption patterns to commercial outcomes

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Senior Ecologist
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Do you enjoy balancing technical fieldwork with meaningful ecological impact? Are you ready to lead surveys, mentor early-career colleagues, and deliver high-quality reports? Are you looking for a role that offers variety, autonomy, and the chance to shape your ecological career? We’re looking for a Senior Ecologist to join Woodrow (part of the APEM Group) in Ireland. This is an exciting opportunity to take the next step in your consultancy career—delivering high-quality ecological assessments, leading fieldwork across diverse Irish habitats, and contributing to nationally significant environmental projects. You will work with other ecology professionals in our office in Sligo. Around 50% of your time will involve fieldwork, including travel across Ireland (and occasionally Northern Ireland or the UK), so confidence working in dynamic, outdoor settings is key. As a Senior Ecologist, you’ll lead survey programmes, deliver technical reports (e.g. EcIA, AA Screening, NIS, EIAR), manage small to mid-sized projects, and guide junior ecologists. You’ll also have opportunities to contribute to tender writing, service development, and cross-disciplinary collaboration with experts across the wider APEM Group. To be successful in this role, you’ll need: A third-level qualification in Ecology, Environmental Science, Zoology, Botany, or a related field 3–5+ years of experience in ecological consultancy or similar Strong field survey skills and working knowledge of Irish flora and fauna Experience producing ecological impact assessments and technical reports aligned with Irish planning law A good understanding of Irish and EU legislation (Habitats Directive, Birds Directive, Planning and Development Act) Excellent communication skills—both written and verbal Ability to manage projects independently, including budgets, schedules, and client relationships A full clean EU driving licence and willingness to travel for fieldwork Bonus points for: CIEEM Associate Membership (or eligibility), and interest in progressing toward Full Membership or Chartership Experience managing field teams and mentoring junior staff Familiarity with GIS tools (QGIS, ArcGIS) First Aid or remote fieldwork safety training (training can be provided) You will be offered the chance to work on a variety of projects, many of our employees have worked on projects that have been of personal interest to them. We match this with a commitment to continuous development and learning to support your career. We also offer benefits to look after you, from private medical insurance for all employees, access to mental health first aiders and comprehensive income protection if you cannot work. We also offer superb flexible working options, balancing work with your life.

jobs.title: To lønkonsulenter til lønadministrationen i Albertslund Kommune
jobs.description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde i en kommune med store ambitioner, engagerede medarbejdere og en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer? Så søger vi to nye kollegaer til vores lønteam, der kan arbejde selvstændigt og lide at have indflydelse på løsningen af egne opgaver, men samtidig er en holdspiller, der brænder for den organisation, du bliver en del af. 

Om Albertslund Kommune

Albertslund er en grøn kommune med store ambitioner. Vi er stolte af vores kommune, og gør os umage i vores opgaver og indsatser for borgerne, foreningerne og virksomhederne. Vi er én kommune og én organisation. Vi har engagerede og dygtige medarbejdere samt en samarbejdskultur, der går på tværs af områder og niveauer. Det gør Albertslund Kommune til et godt sted at arbejde. 

Om enheden HR & Løn i Albertslund Kommune
Lønadministrationen er et nyt team, der pr. 1. januar 2026 blev udvidet til at bestå af 7 lønkonsulenter og en faglig koordinator. Dette skete ifm. en centralisering af lønadministrationen. Pt. er de 5 stillinger som lønkonsulenter besat og stillingen som faglig koordinator, så derfor har vi to ledige stillinger som lønkonsulenter hos os. Formålet med centraliseringen er at skabe en professionel lønfunktion og dermed få en driftssikker og bæredygtig lønfunktion på den lange bane. Udover lønteamet er der et team på 3 medarbejdere og en studentermedhjælper, der arbejder med personalejura og 3 kolleger, som arbejder med arbejdsmiljø, MED og udviklingsopgaver. Vores primære rolle er at yde faglig bistand og rådgivning til hele organisationen, både det politiske og administrative niveau, omkring personalejura, HR og løn. Du bliver en del af et stærkt hold. Ambitionerne og det faglige niveau er højt, stemningen er god og man "vil hinanden". Vi tager alle ansvar for opgaverne og anvender digitale værktøjer så meget som muligt.

Om stillingen
Vi drømmer om at få to nye kollegaer, der har vilje, lyst og evne til at arbejde med lønadministration Det er vigtigt for os, at du er nysgerrig, initiativrig og har eller ønsker at få en bred viden om løn- og ansættelsesvilkår inden for det kommunale område. Det er vigtigt, at du har en opsøgende og struktureret tilgang i dit arbejde. Vi bruger KMD Opus. Du vil komme til at håndtere alle personalegrupper, samt alle typer af ansættelser på tværs af kommunen, ligesom du meget gerne må have talforståelse. Du skal derfor have lyst til og interesse for en hverdag med stor bredde i opgaverne. Er dette ikke muligt fra starten, så arbejder vi os derhen sammen.

Stillingen har fokus på klassisk lønadministration. Opgaverne i denne stilling består primært i lønsagsbehandling af forskellig art, såsom:

  • Generel personaleadministration, udfærdigelse af ansættelsesbrev, anciennitetsberegninger for løn og pension, timetalsændring, lønsammensætning, fratrædelse m.v.
  • Rådgivning og vejledning til ledere, administrative medarbejder, lønmodtager og øvrige samarbejdspartner i relation til alle spørgsmål vedrørende løn, ansættelsesvilkår, arbejdstid, barsel, sygdom, refusion og ferieregler m.m.
  • Lønindplacering
  • Overenskomstfortolkning
  • Ansøgning om og behandling af diverse refusioner (dagpenge, flexjob, barsel og AKUT) 
  • Ændringer i E-indkomst og SKAT
  • Afstemninger af lønkonti
  • Håndtering af spørgsmål til KMD Opus
  • Udarbejdelse af skriftlige oplæg/retningslinjer om lønområdet
  • Arbejde med digitalisering/automatisering af processerne omkring løn

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med lønadministration, men det er ikke et krav. Det vigtigste er, at du har mod på og lyst til de beskrevne opgaver. 

Dagene er aldrig ens, men der vil dog være en række tilbagevendende opgaver. 

Vi forventer, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, og tager ansvar for opgaverne på lige fod med dine kollegaer. Du bliver en del af et team og en enhed, der vægter samarbejdet og relationerne højt, har det sjovt med hinanden, og som vil gøre sig umage for, at du kan føle dig hjemme. Du skal trives med månedlige deadlines, og være god til at kunne prioritere både egne såvel som teamets fælles opgaver, for at alle når i mål.

Vi kan tilbyde

  • et spændende og udfordrende job i en bæredygtig by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskabet
  • nogle fantastiske kollegaer, som venter på at byde dig velkommen og glæder sig til samarbejdet med dig
  • deltagelse i udvidelsen af en lønadministration, der skal professionaliseres
  • stor bredde i opgaverne
  • gode muligheder for at præge jobindholdet og sætte dine kompetencer i spil 
  • fleksibel arbejdstid med mulighed for hjemmearbejdsdage.

Ansøgning og tiltrædelse

Stillingerne er faste på 37 timer på overenskomstvilkår med start 1. november 2026. Lønindplacering sker efter forhandling mellem kommunen og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Det er en del af Albertslund Kommunes ansættelsespolitik at fremme mangfoldighed og ligestilling. 

Det er en forudsætning for din ansættelse i Albertslund Kommune, at du har en gyldig arbejds- og opholdstilladelse. 

Albertslund Kommune har røgfri arbejdstid.

Der er ansøgningsfrist onsdag den 31. august 2026. Der kan indgå en case i en evt. 2. samtale. 

Du kan blive klogere på Albertslund som by og arbejdsplads på www.albertslund.dk

Du er velkommen til at kontakte leder af HR & Løn, Maria Sauer på tlf. 20 49 96 75, eller faglig koordinator for lønadministrationen Elena Høgskær på telefon 60 56 24 09, hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Velkommen til Albertslund - den bæredygtige by for børnene, det grønne og fællesskaber. Albertslund Kommune har mange kvaliteter, som skaber fantastiske rammer for hverdagslivet – både for borgere og medarbejdere. Midt i naturen og med et rigt forenings- og kulturliv, som børn og voksne cykler til og fra på byens mange kilometer cykelstier, der er adskilt fra bilerne på vejene. Der er S-tog lige til døren og flere supercykelstier, bl.a. mellem Albertslund og Vesterport i hjertet af København. Desuden skaber letbanen gode forbindelser til hele hovedstadsområdet. 

I Albertslund Kommune har vi samme tilgang til vores opgaver, som vi selv ville ønske at opleve som borgere. Vi er vidt forskellige, men er fælles om vores opgave for borgere, foreninger og virksomheder. Du kan møde nogle af vores dygtige medarbejdere på www.albertslund.dk/indefra og få et indtryk af bredden af arbejdsområder, opgaver og fagligheder i Albertslund Kommune. 

I Albertslund Kommune er der højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder - vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Job Description Thindi Phibsborough is seeking an experienced and enthusiastic Chef de Partie to join our dynamic kitchen team on a full-time, permanent basis. Candidate Requirements Essential Relevant qualification in Culinary Arts, Professional Cookery, Hospitality, or equivalent practical experience. Strong knowledge of food preparation techniques, kitchen operations, and commercial cooking methods. Strong organizational, communication, and time management skills.

jobs.title: Project & Business Coordinator
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy turning plans into action and bringing structure to complex, cross-functional initiatives?  

Avincis is looking for a Project & Business Coordinator to join our Nordic organisation. This is a broad and highly collaborative role where you will work closely with our Nordic management team and colleagues across Sweden, Norway, Finland and Denmark. 

You will be at the centre of projects, business improvement initiatives and management activities that span functions and countries. From coordinating strategic projects and Management of Change processes to supporting business cases, contracts and performance reporting, you will help ensure that priorities move forward and that decisions are translated into action. 

For the right person, this is an excellent opportunity to gain broad exposure to a complex, international aviation business and work closely with senior management.

Location: Stockholm, Tromsø or Esbjerg

Reports to: Managing Director Nordics

The role

As our Project & Business Coordinator, you will support and coordinate strategic initiatives and cross-functional projects across the Nordic organisation. 

You will bring structure, follow-up and momentum to projects and business activities, while also supporting the Nordic management team with analysis, reporting, contracts and decision-making material. 

Your responsibilities will include: 

  • Coordinating cross-functional projects and strategic initiatives across the Nordics 

  • Developing and maintaining project plans, milestones, budgets, risk registers and progress reporting 

  • Coordinating Management of Change (MOC) processes and ensuring appropriate documentation and follow-up 

  • Supporting the preparation of business cases, investment proposals and cost-saving initiatives 

  • Facilitating project meetings, workshops and steering group meetings and following up agreed actions 

  • Supporting contract administration, negotiations, renewals and amendments 

  • Supporting commercial activities and tender processes 

  • Preparing management reports, presentations and decision-making material 

  • Analysing operational and financial performance and supporting KPI and dashboard reporting 

  • Identifying opportunities to improve, simplify and standardise processes across the Nordic organisation 

  • Supporting strategic planning, organisational development and change initiatives 

  • Acting as a connecting point between management, operational teams and support functions across countries 

Who are we looking for?

We believe you are a structured and proactive person who enjoys working in an environment where priorities can change and where collaboration is essential. 

You are comfortable coordinating several activities at the same time and know how to create clarity and progress without losing sight of the bigger picture. You enjoy working with people across different functions and levels of an organisation and are confident interacting with senior stakeholders. 

You probably have experience from project coordination, project management, business support, business development or a similar role. 

We would also like you to have: 

  • Strong organisational and project management or coordination skills 

  • An understanding of financial analysis and business cases 

  • Good analytical and problem-solving capabilities 

  • Experience or understanding of contract administration and commercial processes 

  • An understanding of risk management and governance 

  • Strong communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language 

  • Experience supporting management teams and senior stakeholders 

  • Experience from aviation or another regulated industry, tender or procurement processes, Management of Change and/or SAP is an advantage, but not a requirement.

What will make you successful? 

You are someone who takes ownership and makes things happen. You enjoy creating structure where there are many moving parts, following up on actions and ensuring that projects continue to move forward. 

At the same time, you are curious about the business behind the projects. You want to understand why we are doing something, not just what needs to be done. 

You are collaborative, pragmatic and comfortable working across different countries, functions and cultures. 

Why join Avincis? 

At Avincis, our work has a clear purpose. We provide critical aviation services across Europe, supporting missions where aviation makes a real difference. 

In this role, you will have the opportunity to work across our Nordic organisation and gain insight into many different parts of the business. You will work closely with Nordic management while collaborating with colleagues in operations, finance, safety, HR, procurement and other functions. 

It is a role with broad exposure, significant variety and the opportunity to influence how we work across the Nordics. 

If you are looking for a role where you can combine projects, business, analysis and collaboration – and where no two days are quite the same – we would love to hear from you. 

Ready to take the next step? Apply and become part of Avincis Nordics.

Gestire la governance dell'obsolescenza: monitoraggio del ciclo di vita, pianificazione Last Time Buy (LTB), ricerca di soluzioni Fit-Form-Function (FFF) alternative, analisi degli impatti d'uso e report di chiusura. Realizzare dashboard e monitoraggio KPI per le performance RAMS/ILS; pubblicare report periodici e supportare i review di progetto (SRR/PDR/CDR). Mantenere un solido controllo di configurazione in PLM/ERP; garantire la conformità a qualità (ISO 9001/EN 9100), HSE e alle politiche di sicurezza delle informazioni/export-control. jobs.title: Principal Program Manager, Go-To-Market
Workplace Experience Manager
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.



ROLE OVERVIEW

Replit is looking for an experienced Workplace Experience Manager who thrives in fast-paced, high-growth environments and is passionate about creating exceptional workplace experiences. You’ll be the heartbeat of our office operations—managing day-to-day facilities needs, coordinating vendors and landlords, owning events and F&B programs, and leading office planning and moves as we scale.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. You will build processes where there are none, improve those that exist, and ensure our physical workspace reflects the speed, creativity, and ambition of Replit. You will manage multiple office events throughout the year from start to finish.  You will also support the needs of smaller regional locations to ensure that all our Replit team members have a great experience.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Oversee daily office operations, ensuring a clean, safe, and productive environment for all employees and visitors.

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for building management and landlords; manage communication, access, maintenance requests, and building compliance.

 - Develop and maintain workplace policies, procedures, and documentation.

 - Partner with internal stakeholders (People, Sales, Leadership) to plan and execute year round in-office events, such as team offsites, community meetups, celebrations, all-hands, and external guest visits.

 - Manage event logistics including space planning, A/V coordination, catering, and vendor oversight.

 - Oversee daily Food & Beverage operations including snacks, beverages, catered meals, and special event catering.

 - Evaluate usage patterns, manage budgets, and optimize programs for employee satisfaction and efficiency.

 - Support workspace planning, including seating arrangements, space optimization, and future layout needs.

 - MAC experience: lead office moves, expansions, and reconfigurations—from vendor selection to scheduling and day-of coordination.

 - Collaborate with IT and People Ops to ensure smooth onboarding/offboarding processes.

 - Source, negotiate, and manage relationships with vendors across facilities, F&B, cleaning, office supplies, security, and workplace services.

 - Monitor service levels, budgets, and contract terms to ensure high performance and cost-effectiveness.



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 7+ years of experience in office management, workplace operations, or facilities roles in a startup or similarly fast-paced environment.

 - 7+ years of experience and expertise in event planning and execution (small to large-size corporate events).

 - Experience managing F&B programs, including vendor evaluation, budgeting, and procurement.

 - Direct experience coordinating with landlords/building management and handling facilities-related issues.

 - Proven track record of vendor sourcing, negotiation, and ongoing relationship management.

 - Strong project management skills with the ability to juggle multiple priorities and move quickly with limited direction.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

 - Comfortable with ambiguity, proactive, solutions-oriented, and able to anticipate operational needs.

 - Ability to work on-site 5 days per week and support occasional early/late hours for events.

 - Experience supporting  regional offices in international locations.



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Familiarity with workplace software (e.g., Envoy, Notion, Asana, or similar tools).

 - Experience using AI tools.

 - Background supporting hybrid or distributed teams.

 - Experience overseeing workplace budgets.

 - Passion for Replit’s mission and familiarity with startup culture, developer tools, or community-centric tech companies.

 - Ability to create scalable processes and documentation from scratch.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - A seamless office experience where employees feel supported, energized, and productive.

 - A well-run workplace with strong vendor performance, clear processes, and predictable costs.

 - Events that strengthen team connection and reinforce Replit’s culture.

 - Office operations that scale efficiently as Replit grows.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

Accounting Junior Advisor
Location:  Luxembourg, LU
Company:  Deloitte Luxembourg
Job Function:  Audit & Assurance
Seniority:  Junior
Contract Type:  Open-term
On site Full time

Your future team

The Accounting & Reporting Advisory (ARA) Service is a dedicated team providing accounting & financial reporting advisory services, specialising in IFRS, US GAAP and LUX GAAP. The team assists clients by providing expert input to challenging transactions, performing critical reviews of financial statements, providing trainings amongst others.
ARA is a dynamic, multicultural and young team, assisting both external clients and audit teams with complex accounting matters and the practical application of accounting & financial reporting standards. Accustomed to being the expert in the room, ARA has at the core of its objective the development of its members both technically and non-technically, aiming to make them experts in their subject but as well all-rounders in terms of soft skills. ARA is also a strong supporter of diversity. ARA team members therefore benefit from extensive trainings both internally designed by ARA Luxembourg and as well from the Global firm, on-the-job coaching and career coaching & development. New ARA members are welcomed with an extensive onboarding program with dedicated learning time prior to navigating the waters. As part of ARA, you will be developing experience across different industries and will benefit from a network of expertise. You will be interacting frequently with team members from other departments including Audit, Advisory and Tax. You will also be exposed to a network of expertise locally and internationally from which you will learn.  

Your advantages of joining us

• Be part of this dynamic team of experts
• Make the most of the support and trainings you get to develop both your technical and soft skills
• Get an exposure to different sectors
• Develop your competence and grow with us in your career
• Benefit from a complementary health insurance, conciergerie services, car leasing possibilities and much more
• Enjoy and promote diversity in our multicultural teams
  
How you'll contribute to our success

• Conduct research and analysis on specific operations (M&A, restructuring, financial instruments, etc.) to advise clients and/or support audit teams with accounting and financial reporting requirements
• Perform reviews of accounting policies and financial statements under IFRS, Lux GAAP, and US GAAP
• Assist with consolidation accounting challenges
• Prepare training materials to educate clients and Deloitte teams on recent accounting and financial reporting updates, and participate in presentations, articles, and non-technical activities to contribute to the growth of the service line
• Develop a strong network with peers, colleagues from other departments, and clients, and assist in preparing proposals to respond to clients' needs

Your skills

Must have

• Holding a Master's degree in economics, finance, accounting, or a similar field or holding an internationally recognised professional qualification (ACCA, ACA, US CPA, DSCG, DEC, Luxembourgish IRE)
• Fluent in English
• Passion for performing research work on accounting topics under multiple GAAPs
Nice to have
•
• Fluency in French and/or German and/or Luxembourgish
• Ability to think outside and beyond the box
• Being a strong team player who can also work independently, and enjoying both technical accounting and building relationships/networks

Interested? Please submit your resume in English

Job Description:

Reporting to the Conducting Officer, the role encompasses oversight of distributor due diligence, product registration, marketing delegation/branch oversight, contract management, and distribution support, with a primary focus on distribution governance and oversight. A key aspect of this role is the oversight of delegated and outsourced services, whether these are managed internally or with external vendors. The Distribution Governance team is based in Luxembourg and India, reflecting JPMAME's commitment to a multi-location operating model.  The role is designed for a highly autonomous, business-oriented professional with strong market presence, combining leadership, client development, and technical expertise in funds distribution, while remaining selectively involved in complex operational matters.


Job Responsibilities:

Foster a positive team environment ensuring open communication
Promote a culture of compliance, ethical behaviours and effective risk management
Lead the strategic direction and governance of distributor oversight, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and firm standards.
Maintain hands-on involvement in complex or strategic fund distribution matters, particularly in relation to cross-border fund registrations and distribution
Ensure appropriate horizon scanning - monitor regulatory developments, market practices, and distribution trends impacting the global funds industry with a particular focus on Luxembourg and Ireland fund domiciles
Monitor compliance by the firm and its delegates with the distribution strategy approved by the Board
Monitor arrangements with distributors so that marketing activities are consistent with both the strategy and agreements
Ensure effective oversight of 3rd party distributors with adherence to distributor onboarding and oversight procedures.  Undertake appropriate initial/periodic and ongoing due diligence so distribution risks are identified and managed appropriately  
Manage frameworks for product registration, marketing delegation, contract management, and distribution support across EMEA and other regions.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal clients as well as third-party providers, overseeing their deliverables effectively.    
Contribute to the evolution of  the team, with a focus on innovation, scalability, and efficiency.
Identify opportunities to leverage digital tools, automation, data analytics, and Artificial Intelligence in processes.
Position the firm as a key market player through participation in industry forums, events, conferences, and targeted networking initiatives.
Supervise and manage appropriate reporting to key stakeholders including Management Information (MI) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Ensure timely and accurate reporting to regulatory authorities
Assist with Due Diligence calls, providing support to Client Advisors as required
Deputies for the Conducting Officer as required


Required Experience, Competencies, and Skills:

Extensive experience in investment funds distribution, regulatory advisory, or asset management, within a focus on Luxembourg/Irish domiciled funds in an international context.
Deep understanding of UCITS and AIF distribution regulations and cross-border marketing frameworks.
Proven leadership managing teams across locations and stakeholder relationships with internal and external partners.
Strong controls mindset, audit readiness, and experience with challenge, escalation, and remediation.
Proven ability to leverage digital tools and data analytics in a governance context
Excellent analytical, communication, and organizational skills; ability to present to senior stakeholders.
High integrity and commitment to compliance.


Preferred Experience, Competencies, and Skills:

Fluency in English; other languages a plus.

jobs.title: Remote Office Assistant
jobs.description:
Coalition Technologies is seeking a reliable, detail-oriented, and highly organized Remote Office Assistant to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, data entry, and internal operations tasks. This role is ideal for someone with strong communication skills, discretion, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn and grow within a fast-paced remote work environment.

As an Office Assistant, you will help support daily administrative operations, assist with entry-level bookkeeping, organize client documents, support internal reporting, and help maintain accurate company records. This position offers strong growth potential for the right candidate, including opportunities for advancement within the Accounting team or other departments.

We are looking for talented and diligent candidates who perform well on our skills assessments. Strong skills test performance may be considered even if a candidate does not meet every preferred experience or educational background requirement.

 

Why Join Coalition Technologies?

Coalition Technologies is committed to delivering high-quality work for our clients while providing our team with a fun, thriving, innovative, and growth-focused work environment. We offer:

  • 100% remote work with a company that has supported remote team members for more than a decade
  • Competitive profit-sharing bonus plan, with up to 50% of company profits paid to full-time employees each month
  • Competitive Paid Time Off plan that supports work-life balance
  • Subsidized gym memberships
  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance packages for eligible US-based team members
  • International Health Insurance Reimbursement Program for eligible international team members
  • Device upgrade and learning reimbursement programs
  • Career development plans with clearly defined goals and rewards
  • Additional job-specific incentives and bonuses

 

Office Assistant Responsibilities

As an Office Assistant, your duties will include:

  • Answering phones and emails
  • Completing entry-level bookkeeping tasks, including recording expenses, organizing receipts, and maintaining transaction records
  • Resolving billing issues with clients and internal team members
  • Providing account access, usage reports, data analysis, and other ad hoc support for team members
  • Supporting quality assurance checks for internal and client-facing reports
  • Organizing new client contracts, creating invoices, and processing client payments
  • Contributing to internal database maintenance, upkeep, and data entry
  • Researching, ordering, and distributing company-wide gifts two to three times per year
  • Organizing company events, competitions, and special projects throughout the year
  • Facilitating company holiday calendars, time-off calendars, and schedule variation calendars

 

Required Skills and Qualifications

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Willingness to learn, grow, and collaborate with the team and company as a whole
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • High level of discretion, ethics, and trustworthiness
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to support administrative, bookkeeping, billing, reporting, and data entry tasks
  • Innovative thinking and willingness to challenge existing methods when improvement is possible
  • Availability to work 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, 9:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. Pacific Time
  • Reliable remote workspace with a fast computer, quality internet, camera, microphone, and speakers

 

Preferred Skills

  • The following experience is preferred but not required:
  • Intermediate spreadsheet skills
  • Experience with bookkeeping or financial record keeping
  • Experience with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, QuickBooks Online, and Google Workspace
  • Experience supporting billing, invoicing, reporting, data entry, or administrative operations

 

Remote Work Environment

Coalition Technologies is a fully remote company. Our team works remotely with the support of time tracking software, structured communication, and a company culture designed to help remote team members succeed. We have supported remote team members for more than a decade and welcome qualified applicants from around the world.

 

Growth Opportunity

This position offers a strong opportunity for growth. Successful Office Assistants at Coalition Technologies have advanced quickly and earned promotions within the Accounting team and across other departments.

 

Compensation

For candidates located in California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, the starting base pay for this position ranges from $15 to $25 per hour. Compensation may vary based on factors such as experience, qualifications, skills test performance, geographic location, and seniority of the position offered. For candidates outside of California, New York, Washington, and Colorado, compensation may fall outside the listed range.

Toateenindaja vastutab külalistubade, heaolualade ja ühiskasutatavate ruumide puhtuse, korra ja esindusliku välimuse tagamise eest kõrgel tasemel. See roll toetab üldist külaliskogemust, tagades, et kõik retriidi alad on puhtad, hügieenilised ning järjepidevalt esitatud vastavalt kehtivatele tööstandarditele ja protseduuridele. Heaolualad ja ühiskasutatavad ruumid • Koristada ja hooldada heaoluruume, hoolitsustube, termilisi alasid ning ühiskasutatavaid ruume kogu päeva vältel. •Tagada, et kõik alad on hügieenilised, korras ja külalistele ohutud, teavitades hooldusvajadusest vastavalt vajadusele. • Seada ja taastada ruumid vastavalt päevakavale ja tööprotseduuridele. Pesumajandus ja voodipesu • Koguda, sorteerida ja töödelda pesu vastavalt kehtestatud protseduuridele. • Tagada voodipesu käsitlemine vastavalt majapidamise standardtööjuhenditele. Tervis, ohutus ja hügieen • Järgida kõiki töötervishoiu- ja ohutusnõudeid, sealhulgas puhastusvahendite ja -seadmete korrektset kasutamist. • Teavitada viivitamata hooldusprobleemidest, ohuteguritest või puudustest. • Hoida majapidamiskäru ja laoruumid puhtad ning korrastatud. Suhtlus ja meeskonnatöö • Suhelda tõhusalt majapidamisjuhi, majapidamise vahetusevanema ning laiema meeskonnaga. • Edastada täpselt teave tehtud tööde, pooleliolevate ülesannete ja külaliste soovide kohta. • Teha koostööd kolleegidega, et tagada sujuv igapäevane töökorraldus. • Säilitada alati professionaalne ja lugupidav käitumisviis.

Omalt poolt pakume: Meie inimkultuur
EHA pakub läbimõeldud ja kõrgetasemelist töökeskkonda, mis põhineb autentsusel, hoolivusel ja isiklikul vastutusel. Väärtustame koosloomist ja vastutuse võtmist ning julgustame iga meeskonnaliiget töötama oma tugevuste ja loomuliku andekuse tsoonis. Sind toetatakse järjepideva professionaalse arengu ja koolitustega, mis panustavad sinu pikaajalisse karjääriteekonda. Töötad koos meeskonnaga, kes on pühendunud taastavale külalislahkusele – kontseptsioonile, mis on üles ehitatud teadlikkuse ja vastastikuse austuse põhimõttel seestpoolt väljapoole. Tasu ja hüved Pakume konkurentsivõimelist töötasu ja hüvesid, toetavaid töötingimusi ning meeskonnakultuuri, kus sinu panust siiralt hinnatakse. See ametikoht sobib inimesele, kes tunneb end hästi külalistele suunatud meeskonnatöös, on motiveeritud pidevast arengust ning väärtustab kuulumist meeskonda, mis on pühendunud järjepidevale täiustamisele.

Muud nõuded: Kogemus ja nõuded
Kirjalik ja suuline inglise keele oskus. Palume arvestada, et kuigi tehakse mõistlikke kohandusi, toimub kohapealne meeskonnasisene suhtlus inglise keeles. Võime töötada kõrgete puhtus- ja hügieenistandardite järgi. Hea ajaplaneerimis- ja organiseerimisoskus. Täpsus ja järjepidevus. Võime töötada iseseisvalt ning meeskonna osana. Professionaalne välimus ja käitumine. Varasem kogemus toateenindajana hotellis, retriidis, spaas, majutus- või külalislahkuse valdkonnas või kõrgema taseme majutusasutuses. Tööalane kogemus puhastusseadmete ja professionaalsete puhastusvahenditega.

Oleme valmis värbama ka alaealisi alates 17. eluaastast

Tööülesanded: Wagenkülli ajalooline lossikompleks otsib oma meeskonda hoolikat ja kohusetundlikku puhastusteenindajat.
Sinu peamised ülesanded: • hotellitubade koristamine; • spaakeskuse ja saunaala korrashoid; • üldalade (koridorid, trepid, vastuvõtt jm) puhtuse tagamine; • voodipesu ja rätikute ettevalmistamine; • puhtuse ja korrasoleku jälgimine kogu majas.

Omalt poolt pakume: • Tööd kaunis ja ainulaadses lossi- ja spaakeskkonnas;
• sõbralikku ja toetavat tiimi; • stabiilset ja motiveerivat töötasu; • arenguvõimalusi ja koolitusi; • töötajate soodustusi (spaa, restoran jpm); • vajadusel ööbimisvõimalust tööpäevadel.

Muud nõuded: Ootame Sind, kui:
• oled korrektne ja kohusetundlik; • märkad detaile ja hoolid kvaliteedist; • oled valmis liikuvaks ja füüsiliseks tööks; • sobid meeskonda ja oled samas iseseisev; • oled paindlik graafiku osas (sh nädalavahetused). Kasuks tuleb varasem kogemus sarnasel tööl.

Kodus töötamise võimalus: Ei

jobs.description:

jobs.title: Merchandising Execution Associate MARLBOROUGH
jobs.description:
Are you someone who thrives on helping others succeed, enjoys making an impact, and takes pride in guiding customers to the right solutions for their projects? If youâre also naturally curious and eager to keep learning, consider starting or growing your career with us at The Home Depot.

Position Overview

Merchandising Execution Associates (MEAs) perform in-store merchandising service activities such as merchandising projects, planogram maintenance, overhead organization, and display/signage maintenance designed to enhance the customer experience. MEAs execute merchandising strategies and ensure product is displayed correctly to drive sales and maximize inventory turns. MEAs work in teams with on-site supervision, and provide service to multiple departments in the stores. These associates execute approved general bay service, tasking, projects and resets safely, accurately and efficiently. MEAs must build and maintain strong relationships with store associates and provide superior customer service to both internal and external customers.

Key Responsibilities

Merchandising: General Service, Tasking, Packdown, and Projects

  • Read and interpret directions to ensure merchandise is set to the planogram, project instructions, program service requirements and general service guidelines
  • Straighten, clean and merchandise product to ensure merchandise is presented in a visually appealing manner
  • Maintain copy of most recent planogram inside upright beam adjacent to product set
  • Build displays and fixtures using basic hand tools
  • Maintain, order, and install display material/signage/brochures
  • Follow directions and processes to conduct accurate price and label changes. Replace incorrect, damaged, or missing price labels.
  • Maintain aisle
  • Utilize store systems to access key merchandising reports. Read, interpret, and execute action based on findings.
  • Maintain bay service records and other documentation as directed.
  • Execute one off projects as required by store, district, and regional leadership.

Customer Service

  • Maintain aisle cleanliness so that merchandise is accessible and customers are able to move throughout the aisles easily
  • Partner with store leadership to markdown all damaged or un-sellable merchandise
  • Answer questions regarding the store and products for the customers.
  • Partner with store associates to find necessary products to fit the customer's needs.

Other

  • Partner with store representative to conduct inspections of returned and damaged items for Return to Vendor.
  • Follow standard operating and safety procedures.
  • Complete assigned training curriculum
  • Other duties as assigned

Competencies

  • Action Oriented
  • Collaborates
  • Communicates Effectively
  • Customer Focus
  • Decision Quality

Skills

  • Basic computer skills with knowledge of web based applications.
  • Interpersonal skills, working on teams, with heavy reliance on team to accomplish goals.
  • Follows safety policies and procedures. Identifies and corrects safety hazards.
  • Attention to Detail: Stays attentive and aware, catches errors before completing assignments, and maintains high quality standard for work.
  • Drives Execution & Self Motivated: Demonstrates the ability to deliver results without close supervision despite a large workload, competing demands, and fast paced environment. Ensures tasks are completed on time, without error, and meet quality standards.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports

  • Reports to Merchandising Execution Supervisor (MEAS)

Travel Requirements

  • No travel requirements for this role

Physical Requirements

  • Bending, stooping, reaching, twisting, lifting, pushing, pulling, and moving items

Working Conditions

  • Working within a flexible schedule that typically starts early in the morning
  • Warehouse environment that can be dusty and noisy
  • Doors are frequently open, causing drafts and interior temperature changes

Minimum Education

  • GED
  • Highschool Diploma or Equivalent

Minimum Years Of Work Experience

  • N/A

Minimum Leadership Experience

  • N/A

Certifications

  • N/A

Other Requirements/Assets

  • 1 year of relevant working experience

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, SSCS: Supply Chain
User Researcher, Growth
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We’re seeking an experienced User Researcher to shape growth-related product decisions by delivering insights that fuel AI experiences. This role blends traditional growth research, such as adoption, monetization, and pricing and packaging, with fast-evolving AI features like Notion Agent and Chat that permeate experiences like onboarding and Workspace creation. It requires a unique mix of user research expertise, strategic foresight, and technical fluency in AI and AI product development.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Design and execute studies that evaluate how people experience Notion with AI in the loop, including how users discover, trust, and get value from AI, and identify barriers to adoption and willingness to pay.

 - Run mixed-methods research (qual + quant), including interviews, concept testing, prototype/usability testing, diary studies, surveys, and advanced quantitative pricing studies — leveraging AI tooling to scale your research process and work.

 - Deliver actionable insights that enable us to deeply understand our customers, identify business opportunities, and drive decision-making — leveraging AI to scale your reporting, sharing, and overall impact.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - AI fluency: You’re curious and hands-on with AI products — and can reason about how AI behavior shapes product experience.

 - Systems thinking - You can understand complex user journeys and growth engines (including the parts users don't see), and identify where experiences breakdown across the system.

 - Business mindedness: You connect research to business outcomes and can articulate why an insight matters for strategy, growth, and/or revenue.

 - Data fluency: You know how to understand and leverage experimentation, and how to use behavioral data to sharpen research questions and interpret results.

 - Pragmatism: You have experience prioritizing and doing research in fast-moving 0→1 environments, and are comfortable navigating ambiguity and taking initiative.

 - Communication: You evolve how your share research according to the audiences and like getting creative in how you share your insights (ex: videos, podcasts, workshops, etc.)

 - Experience: 5+ years doing UX research in industry




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience researching AI-enabled products (especially agentic/workflow automation), growth journeys, and B2B products

 - Expertise conducting research with AI research tools (Outset, Listen Labs, Dovetail, etc.)

 - Masters or PhD Degree in Human-Computer Interaction, Psychology, Behavioral Economics, Anthropology, Sociology, or similar.

 - Experience communicating research to executive stakeholders.

 - You’re familiar with the work of computing heroes like Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, Bret Victor, etc. — and understand why we're big fans.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $196,000 - $230,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.
